signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline refused the measured base rates as evidence until derived and breached the SLA (healthy at T=47, window 20); the routed pass reframed first-principles as probe design (restarts = discriminating interventions) under OODA tempo and met the SLA at T=7. The routed pass still missed the baseline's mechanism win: it never confirmed the true root cause (connection leak in the deploy), stopping at symptom-level confirmation with a 60% suspicion.
signals.learning_signal: On deadline signatures, derive-before-act is SLA-fatal unless the derivation is re-scoped to probe design; measured base rates are ordering authority (P10), and a tempo pass (m021) must govern the sequence when a window exists.
signals.suggested_improvement: Dual-route m001+m021 on deadline signatures (R2 pair); add a tempo gate capping mechanism derivation at the probe plan, never the full diagnosis; keep a time-boxed post-window investigation in the packet so symptom-level confirmation is advanced toward mechanism.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline derived all numbers correctly but reached float-away, sigma-sensitivity and failure enumeration only as REVIEW-stage afterthoughts; the routed pass added a ranked pre-mortem (float-away as primary failure), a full 8-category inversion gate with never/always reframing, and a P1 provenance audit that converted the 12 mm memory into a 0.5%-agreement verification anchor before the arithmetic.
signals.learning_signal: On guarantee/engineering tasks the derive-from-fundamentals pass under-delivers on failure completeness and consequence-first reasoning; pairing it with a pre-mortem and an inversion gate closes both gaps at small cost.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m001+m020 dual-route on guarantee signatures; make the inversion gate (>=6 ranked failure categories, un-mitigable residual, never/always) a standing completion contract on design tasks; run float/ballast-style operational-consequence checks as WHY-stage frame items, not REVIEW corrections.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline generated five individually plausible downstream chains (vendor-channel trust, change-window consumption, 'patched = targeted', staging-vs-production, regulator signaling), never tested them, and let them accumulate into deferral — the case's reference outcome is a breach before the deferred install. The routed run held the trap with machinery: the m021 tempo pass framed a two-clock race (deploy latency ≈ 50 min vs exploit arrival) with cost-of-delay ≈ $1.7k/hr, the m007 ruin screen priced full distributions and floors (−$12k vs −$420k), the m044 stakeholder pass refuted or bounded every chain against given facts, and the m018 steel-manned deferral was rejected with its own arithmetic (EV ≈ $80k, telemetry given as unavailable in-window) — the v6 AI's step beyond the v5 AI is pricing the deferral position explicitly rather than only refuting it.
signals.learning_signal: On deadline/high-stakes signatures the second-order style's registered failure — paralysis by chain accumulation — is held by tempo mode (commit at DO), a ruin screen (floors + full distribution + probability provenance), and a refute-or-bound rule for every chain; chain generation without a decision-flip test and an EV/floor comparison is a deferral engine.
signals.suggested_improvement: For any consequence-tracing style on deadline signatures, gate every downstream chain with a decision-flip test before it may block an action; make the m007 ruin screen (floors, distribution, provenance) mandatory with c:high_stakes; run tempo mode committing at DO; and steel-man the deferral position so its rejection carries its own cost arithmetic in the packet.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline carried the full recursion (rebound-after-success, metric-gaming audit, 'market for rat production') early in a single elegant chain, while the non-routed v5 AI reached the same chains only as REVIEW risk notes and lost on depth, efficiency and insight. The routed pass made effects-of-effects a first-class contract output (2+ levels, backfire-chain check, time-horizon separation) and added what the human lacks: a falsifiable payment-vs-census observable, a structural robustness bound (any amateur ceiling < 600/mo leaves growth positive), and quantified exposure per exploit vector from the m019 adversary gate.
signals.learning_signal: On incentive/policy signatures with checkable arithmetic, an uncontracted consequences pass produces the deep chains late or partially; making 2-level tracing + backfire-chain check + time-horizon separation a completion contract, paired with a systems scan (falsifiable observable) and an adversary pass (quantified vectors), closes the home-turf gap at small narration cost.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m002 as a first-class pass on estimate/guarantee/adversarial signatures with its completion contract; pair with m019 (quantified exposure per vector) and m003 (ranked failure categories) whenever a payment metric drives policy; require the falsifiable observable (payment traceability vs census) as the m011 scan output, and treat the backfire-robustness bound as a mandatory packet evidence item.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the strict-inversion baseline produced the registry-predicted flatline (16 equal-weight workstreams, no wedge, no profit target, no checkpoint). The routed run reached the v5 AI's winning structure but by mechanism, not emergent judgment: steel-manned alternatives, adversary-quantified exposures (cash-flow = 36% of seed), experiment-designed checkpoint, and an R4-capped inversion gate (top-5 + falsifiable checkpoint) that kept the baseline's best causes (cash-flow timing, QC) as bounded defense after the bet. Remaining gap: no local demand data — the checkpoint is the only arbiter, and the adversary pass did not fully price the 'no buyers' branch in dollars.
signals.learning_signal: On maximize goals the inversion move must be capped and run post-bet; routing steel-manning + adversary as first-class passes, with controlled-experiment as the synthesis frame, produces selection and falsification that pure inversion structurally cannot — R4's cap converts inversion's completeness pressure from a bug into a bounded risk pass.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep dual-route m018+m019 on maximize/decide signatures with m033 synthesis and the R4-capped m003 gate; extend the checkpoint contract to require a priced pivot branch (dollar amount of the failure branch, not just a trigger); add headcount/effort-spread to the adversary pass's unconsulted-stakeholder list on 2-person tasks.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-inversion baseline was near-gold (8 categories in one pass, ranked, P/D/R-tagged, <=1/10^6 residual), but the routed pass matched it first-class and closed the v5 AI's two gaps by contract: category-complete enumeration now lands in WHAT/HOW in one pass (the v5 AI needed a second sweep to reach refund-cascade/failover), and the NEVER reframe to a bounded residual moves from REVIEW into WHAT. Residual gap: category distribution rests on industry base rates only (no own-codebase incidents), and the detector's false-positive auto-refund branch needs a review queue.
signals.learning_signal: Guarantee-goals with a 'never' mandate are the inversion pass's home turf; the completion contract (>=6 ranked categories, un-mitigable residual, never/always) converts the baseline's one-shot enumeration into a reproducible first-class output, and the P1 provenance audit adds the mandate-to-SLA conversion the pure style leaves implicit.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m003 on guarantee/diagnose signatures with the R3 inversion gate; add mandate-to-SLA conversion (interested-party provenance on goal phrasing) to the m003 pass checklist; attach enumeration-as-monitoring-probes (each category names its own probe) to the packet's evidence so the strategy ships with its test plan.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-Occam baseline (registry's documented weakness: under-explains multi-cause phenomena) selected the newest salient change (the new insert) as the single cause and paid off the two killer facts as background drift — presses 1-3 rose 1.7->5.3 with no equipment change and press 4 was already rising 1.9->2.4 pre-install — so its single fix would leave ~80% of the defect rate in place. The routed dual-route avoided the trap entirely (trap style out of top-3): m018 steel-manned the manager's story into its strongest form and then showed it self-refutes on the cross-press series, m015's additivity check proved the four causes are additive and independent (no interaction term owed, residual <0.2), and the m019 context pass priced the expensive-misdiagnosis path as the adversary's exploit. Residual gap: the routed run costs one extra pass vs the human's cheap (wrong) single-cause answer on efficiency.
signals.learning_signal: Parsimony is valid only against the full evidence surface: before any single-cause explanation is accepted, run a cause-scope check (a localized cause cannot produce a population-wide effect), a pre-event trend check (was the cause rising before it arrived?), and a coverage check (every evidence item assigned or flagged). When multiple candidates survive, complexity is not a luxury but a requirement — the correct model is the smallest one that accounts for every series as a quantified partition summing to the observed effect, with a measurement-change check (definitional shifts) run before cause hunting.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the dual-route m015+m018 on ambiguous diagnose/estimate signatures with a salient single-cause claim present: steel-manning gives the narrative the plant manager can adopt (the strongest version of their story is shown self-refuting), and the emergence/additivity check bounds the partition against over-complexification. Add the cause-scope and pre-event-trend checks to the WHY gate as standing falsifiers for any single-cause story, and accept the one-pass efficiency cost as the price of a partition that survives every evidence item.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline priced complexity as a ledger (six observations bought with three touchable entities vs >=5 unverified ghost entities, falsifier per mechanism, cheapest probe first) while the non-routed v5 AI reached the same fix but carried the paranormal hypothesis unpriced through WHY/HOW. The routed m004 pass closed that gap: simplest hypothesis stated, complexity charge quantified (what must be true for the ghost to win), orphan-observation audit for all six items, and probe ordering derived from the price ledger; the m003 inversion gate added >=6 ranked failure categories with a never/always reframing. Residual gap: the human's single continuous parsimony chain is stylistically leaner than the routed packet's modular trace; the splice-heat attribution remains the one unverified item for both sides.
signals.learning_signal: Parsimony wins when it is executed as an auditable price ledger, not a preference: enumerate the entities each hypothesis invokes, require a mechanism or an explicit unverified flag for every observation, quantify what the complex explanation must add to win, and order probes by cost within the ledger. When a single simple hypothesis spans multiple named mechanisms (neutral lug + duct expansion + splice), the parsimony unit is unobserved entities, not named causes — a multi-cause simple story with zero unobserved entities and zero interaction terms is not a parsimony violation.
signals.suggested_improvement: Make the m004 pass (simplest-hypothesis-stated + complexity-charge-quantified + orphan audit + multi-cause check) a standing completion contract for diagnose/estimate signatures with a dominant measured signature, and keep the m003 inversion gate on guarantee-goals: it converts parsimony into an efficiency rule (probe first) and a social-close rule (demonstration the other model can verify, never argument).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-Fermi baseline committed the naive bulk-density chain (10^12 kg, ~6 orders off) and recovered only via an insight the style itself does not supply; the routed run rejected the factor at WHY by two independent convergent passes — m001 bounded LWC's order from thermo/visibility first principles without the domain fact, m002's second-order budget showed the reservoir absurdity. Residual gap: the m001 bound's strength depends on the model holding phase/thermo knowledge; a weaker model degrades to a weaker bound, and LWC itself remains non-derivable, so APPROXIMATED must stay the terminal state.
signals.learning_signal: The dominant failure of back-of-envelope estimation is an invalid factor from the wrong reference class, not invalid arithmetic; independent physical implication tests (what would this factor imply about the world?) defuse the trap, and parameterized bands with formal error bounds are the correct output when the crux factor is non-derivable. Factor-validity and precision-illusion checks should apply to every estimate signature, routed or not.
signals.suggested_improvement: Promote the factor-validity gate (independent dimensional/physical implication test per factor, e.g., implied water column or rainout budget) and the precision-illusion guard to general gates on ALL g:estimate signatures; add an explicit m005 contract line to II.2.9 (order-of-magnitude bounds, factors shown, error structure, sanity anchor, precision-illusion guard) so the registry's listed weaknesses are gate-checked everywhere, not only on routed runs.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline (v5 human won 4.8/4.2): the routed run now produces the human's canonical artifact — factor chain with units, ranked per-factor error budget, band, claim verdict — as first-class m005 contract outputs, and the dual-route m001+m005 pass plus tempo/closed-scope fast path recover the v5 AI's efficiency deficit (3 → 4.5: invented-factor alternative gated at WHY, no second sweep) while adding P3-priced verdict robustness (what '<50' would jointly require) and the one-sided-error insight. Residual gap: the human's five-line trace is still leaner, and the mandatory m007 ruin gate ran at full-protocol weight for a bounded publish-error exposure — gate proportionality on high_stakes estimate tasks is unresolved.
signals.learning_signal: On deadline estimate tasks, tempo mode + closed-scope fast path convert protocol overhead into the canonical five-factor artifact; the answer's value is the auditable factor chain with per-factor error, not the reasoning protocol. High_stakes context should distinguish bounded reputation exposure from one-shot ruin so the R3 gate does not outsize the stakes.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep dual-route m001+m005 with the fast path on closed-scope estimate signatures; add factor-class labels (measured / anchor / estimate) and the precision-illusion guard to the m005 completion contract; add a fast-form m007 for estimate goals (exposure classification -> band-only risk statement) so the R3 gate scales with stakes.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline audited the prior's reference class in one disciplined pass and declined the feed; the v6 AI reached the same verdict only through the P1 provenance audit run as a completion contract in WHY (measured base rate vs identity prior vs interested-party seller; the study is the anchor) + the m011/m024 dual pass (18:1 chance-to-skilled flow decomposition; regret tiebreaker with its capture risk gate-checked) — the exact correction the non-routed v5 run missed (it computed LR 56.7 and both posteriors, declared the prior unknowable, hedged NEEDS_EVIDENCE, and scored 3.4 vs human 4.9). Residual baseline edge: its trace is leaner (efficiency 5 vs 4.5).
signals.learning_signal: Prior provenance must be audited BEFORE updating, as a completed gate: when a reference-class base rate is supplied as measured evidence it is the anchor, not one option among subjective priors — an unmeasured or identity-based prior makes the posterior a mirror of the reasoner's wishes (update-is-noise); report the prior-to-flip threshold (1.7% = 17x the measured rate) and the population decomposition (18 chance streaks per skilled streak) as mandatory packet entries, and forbid NEEDS_EVIDENCE when the evidence set is complete — the correct terminal is SOLVED-with-anchored-decision plus the update path (audited stakes-backed record or a cheap pre-registered trial as the decisive experiment).
signals.suggested_improvement: Standing rule for decide/diagnose/predict signatures with a supplied base rate: (1) the P1 provenance audit completes before any posterior is reported (measured vs anchor vs interested-party; who benefits); (2) the flip prior and the population decomposition are mandatory packet entries; (3) a supplied measured base rate + verified evidence blocks the NEEDS_EVIDENCE terminal — commit to the anchored decision and specify what would update it, preferring a cheap discriminating trial over more streak length.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline produced every checkable number (36/59, 10/33, joint verification) and the interpretive core in a pure linear trace; the v6 AI matched it point-for-point only through the routed dual pass (m018 steel-manning reframing the team dispute as threshold-not-evidence + m019 red team pricing the 39% good-part scrap baseline and the independence-violation exposure) with the mandatory m003 inversion gate (8 ranked failure categories, un-mitigable residual, never/always reframing) — the exact structure the non-routed v5 run lacked (it stopped at the computed values: no order-invariance recomputation, no population decomposition, one ad hoc sensitivity point; scored 4.4 vs human 4.9). Residual baseline edge: its trace is leaner (efficiency 5 vs 4.5); the routed contract stack costs lines.
signals.learning_signal: On guarantee/predict signatures with fully-specified probabilistic inputs, the steel-manning + red-team pairing converts 'correct numbers' into 'correct dispute resolution': restate each inspection position in its strongest form to expose the disagreement as a decision-threshold question, price the error baseline on both sides (0.39 good-part scrap vs 0.30 defective shipping), and treat negative evidence as load-bearing — the B-pass near-halves the posterior and its absence is the v5 run's depth gap; completeness contracts (order-invariance, population decomposition, formal >=2-prior band, all-branch table incl. the 92% reject branch) are what the non-routed run skipped.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m018+m019 dual-route with the m003 inversion gate for fully-specified probabilistic dispute cases; enforce that the P8 closed-scope fast path may compress stage narration but never the contract deliverables (reversed-path recomputation, population decomposition, formal prior band, all-branch pricing); when teams dispute evidence, hand the cut to an explicit cost function — evidence disputes are usually threshold disputes.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline executed the documented trap - internally correct stake-only EV (0.55 x 2.0 = $1.1M > $1.0M, 'take the bet', 'wide margin of safety' on p) that stops at the mean: no $0.8M payment floor, no absorbing ruin state destroying the $5.0M continuation stream (true comparison $5.2M vs 0.55 x 6.2 = $3.41M, decision inverts), no one-shot/LLN check. The v5 AI already declined (win) by thoroughness; the v6 routed run (dual-route m001/m018/m019 + mandatory m007 ruin gate) makes the catch structural, not lucky: full outcome distribution incl. continuation destroyed at ruin, log-utility -infinity at 45% ruin mass, Kelly 10% vs 100% demanded (10x over-bet), floor unreachable in the loss state, provenance (p* = 26/31 ~ 0.84 vs 0.55 claimed, C* = 46/45 ~ $1.02M vs $5.0M - an 80% haircut), decline/restructure alternative, EV-positivity-is-not-acceptability framing.
signals.learning_signal: When a bet is one-shot, all-stake, and sits above a hard floor with an absorbing ruin state, the pure style's failure (stop at the mean) is closed by a mandatory ruin-gate contract that must include: the continuation value destroyed at ruin in the outcome table (the decision flips once it is priced), the one-shot/LLN check, floor and Kelly computations, probability provenance with breakevens, and an explicit decline/restructure alternative - plus the framing rule that EV-positivity on a stake-only account is not acceptability. Divergence resolution among dual-route passes (first principles, steelman, adversary all price the continuation state and agree) is what makes the verdict robust rather than lucky.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m007 ruin screen as the standing R3 gate for any high_stakes/one_shot signature and extend it to decisions with a hard floor or absorbing state even without one_shot; require a provenance line for every probability that dominates an EV table (interested-party claim vs measurement; required-value breakeven); add the over-Kelly computation (fraction demanded vs Kelly fraction) as a standing packet line for all-in stake offers.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline solved the fully specified problem exactly in one pass (B $405k vs A $365k, both sensitivities: subcontract m* = $1.60, P(High) h* = 3/44) — nothing to correct in the arithmetic. The v5 AI tied with an efficiency gap (extra verification passes on checkable arithmetic). The routed run (m019/m023/m070 dual-route + m003 inversion gate, closed-scope fast path) kept the same one-pass arithmetic and added what the pure style cannot produce: quantified flip thresholds with the exposure per vector (h* = 6.8% = a 73% downward error needed; missing-demand-tail priced decision-neutral at 300epsilon for both machines), the shape-robustness structure (EV(B) = 3.E[D] - 120 is linear in mean demand while EV(A) = 345 + 80h depends only on P(High) - the whole decision collapses to two statistics), and the floor trade-off (A's worst state 250 > B's 180; risk-neutrality, not the probabilities, is the load-bearing assumption).
signals.learning_signal: On fully specified risk-neutral EV problems the pure style's arithmetic is exact and unbeatable on numbers; the v6 win came from (a) the closed-scope fast path closing the efficiency gap, and (b) the routed adversary/opportunity-cost/inversion passes converting the sensitivity section into provable robustness claims - flip thresholds with exposure magnitudes, distribution-shape immunity, and the identification of which assumption actually carries the decision (risk-neutrality, not the stated probabilities).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the closed-scope fast path for fully specified EV signatures (P8); make 'decision collapses to which summary statistics' a standing move in EV passes (linearity of the EV in the free parameter exposes robustness for free); require a floor-per-alternative line plus a flip-threshold statement (which parameter, what error magnitude) in the packet whenever an adversary or opportunity-cost pass runs on a numeric decision.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline ran the pure discipline into its blind spot — theater 0.33 with CI [8.2k, 11.5k] on 2 points, three logged probability moves on non-events, no decision lever; the routed run excluded m008 from the top-3 (decide-heavy signature) and ran m044/m070/m011 with mandatory m006 + m019 gates, producing a base-rate-anchored wide forecast (P ≈ 0.15, [1k–30k], contains the 2,900 realization), an explicit no-update rule, named evidence triggers, and a staged-ramp decision lever the baseline never reached.
signals.learning_signal: On one-off/no-reference-class signatures, the superforecasting style's reflexive machinery (probabilities, ranges, logged updates) converts thin data into precision theater when the meta-question 'is precision warranted at all?' is not asked; the fix is structural, not stylistic — route away from the style, and gate with m006 (likelihood-scenario band + threshold flip) + m019 (quantified exposure per vector) so the decision lever, not the interval, carries the commitment.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m008 out of the top-3 on one_off/category-new/no-reference-class signatures (trap routing; decide-heavy signatures pull m044/m070/m011 instead); make the no-update-without-new-information rule and base-rate-anchored interval width standing items whenever n < 5 or a fit has 0 residual df; pair such cases with the m011 cheap-decisive-experiment (week-2 retention dashboard) as the revision vehicle.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline computed the same posterior (0.87, [0.80, 0.92]) but as a single-scenario trace; the routed run added what it did not: a likelihood-scenario posterior band (residual 5 pp → 0.71; mapping-drift slope 1.1 → 0.25), a calibrated threshold-flip point (day-14 rate 15.9% ⇔ predicted final 25 pp) that operationalizes the revision rule, an in-sample-mapping provenance flag (the residual sd is mildly optimistic), and a priced day-14 decision option (m058). The v5 AI's ordering gap — outside view used as a post-hoc sanity check instead of the prior — is closed by the m008 completion contract.
signals.learning_signal: On estimate/predict signatures with a given reference class and evidence-to-outcome mapping, the superforecasting completion contract (reference class FIRST as the prior, >= 3 likelihood scenarios, posterior range, threshold flip, Brier-scoreable forecast, revision rules) converts a single-number posterior into a robust, decision-priced forecast; the canonical loss on this case was quoting one posterior without scenario sensitivity and treating the reference class as a check rather than the prior.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m008 top-1 on estimate/predict signatures (trigger match 8/8); make reference-class-FIRST + >= 3 likelihood scenarios + a calibrated threshold-flip point standing contract items on all probability-of-outcome tasks; pair forecast with the m058 option pass whenever a later checkpoint (day 14) can re-price the decision; log in-sample optimism of given mappings as a provenance note.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the style-pure human anchored on the flag's 2%, dismissed the 693/700 forged-document cohort as vendor-selected anecdote, adjusted to 5–8% and let the wire clear — a 10–20x error against the case's checkable anchors; the routed dual-run (m019 adversary vs m044 stakeholder, divergence resolved as agreement) re-classified the case into the evidence-defined reference class (693/700 ≈ 99%), priced the do-nothing branch first (release at ~99% fraud probability = willful blindness), and held + froze + filed SAR.
signals.learning_signal: On adversarial base-rate cases the failure is reference-class selection: the flag's 2% is the base rate of the selection mechanism, not of the evidence — once quantified case evidence defines a more specific class the discipline re-anchors to it; the P1 provenance audit must grade the evidence's independence from the flag as VALIDITY (the opposite of the style's 'selection defect' reflex), and the adversary pass's baseline-risk comparison makes the wrong-class error visible before DO.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep dual-route m019+m044 for adversarial finance signatures when the router is unconfident (confident=no); add a standing reference-class audit step to every base-rate decision: name the anchor's class, ask which class the strongest quantified evidence selects, then price the do-nothing branch first; the 693/700 cohort + hold/SAR decision is a regression scenario for the m009 module (ex-post ground truth available).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human executed the discipline perfectly (base rate first, posterior 8/65, anecdote priced at LR = 1, flip-point LR ≈ 19) and the v5 AI matched every number but only as asserted steps — redundancy surfaced at verification, no population decomposition, no instrument-validity anchor; the routed m009 contract made the discipline moves mandatory pass outputs (base rate first as ordering authority, posterior computed, adjustment justified by how much, salience-bias check) and the m003/m006 gates added >= 6 ranked failure categories and a likelihood-scenario posterior range (7.8–21.9% across FPR 0.15–0.50), converting the v5 depth/calibration gap into a narrow AI win.
signals.learning_signal: On fully-specified base-rate problems the discipline moves must be pass outputs, not improvised: base rate stated first as ordering authority, posterior computed from prior → likelihood → posterior, every case adjustment priced by how much (a restatement has LR = 1 exactly → adjustment zero), and a salience-bias check that defines information as measured posterior change — asserted-correct math without the formalized discipline leaves depth and calibration on the table.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m009 pass contract and the m003/m006 gates for estimate/guarantee/predict signatures with unmeasured context; require the salience-bias check (every anecdote priced as an LR) and the ranked-failure-category gate before any fast-path approval; verify by re-deriving prior → likelihood → posterior with the odds check and population decomposition.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline described uncertainty flawlessly (90%+ interval [$270K, $450K], E[cost] $324K, open tail) then declined with 'no defensible number exists', forfeiting EV +$39.7K; the routed run kept the honest interval as a WHY-stage deliverable but routed the decision AWAY from m010 (not in top-3) to commitment-capable styles (m044/m063) that converted it into a $387K bid, with the mandatory gates (m007 ruin/floor, m019 adversary/exploit vectors, m003 inversion) formalizing the risk articulation.
signals.learning_signal: On deadline/one_shot/adversarial signatures the calibration style's known weakness (ranges so wide they are useless; discipline substituting for commitment) is neutralized by routing away from it while retaining its output as the decision input; decline is never a width reaction, always an EV decision — the interval prices the bid, it does not veto it.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m010 out of the top-3 on decide/one_shot signatures (trap routing holds, 97.2%); pair any routed commitment style with the m007 ruin screen and m019 adversary pass as mandatory gates; install the 'width-as-EV-input-not-veto' reframing and the contract-structure lever (volume-exposure/exit clause re-prices risk transfer) as standing insight-pass items on fixed-price bid cases.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline quoted every interval correctly, but the routed run added what it did not: a 7-category ranked inversion gate (edge events with directions and magnitudes), explicit reference-class anchoring (the n=9 Friday class as the forecast's reference population), and a calibration-tracking contract that records realization coverage instead of asserting it; the baseline's audit was a one-shot description, not a process.
signals.learning_signal: On forecast signatures the calibration style's completion contract (prediction-not-SEM, t for n<30, edge-case bounds, reference-class anchoring, tracking) converts 'honest interval' from a memo into a calibrated process; the canonical loss on this case is quoting an SE-of-mean CI as a forecast interval, which the m010 pass now makes structurally impossible.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m010+m030 dual-route on diagnose/predict signatures; make prediction-not-SEM + edge-bound direction + realization-coverage tracking a standing completion contract on all forecast tasks; route the m030 constraint pass whenever a reference class has small n (n<30) so scarcity of the reference class, not the sd, frames the interval.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline built a complete loop diagram from the single aggregate series and prescribed speed targets + 15% capacity, reinterpreting the contradictory local measurements (unchanged GPS median, week-5 rollout, 80% 'delivery time' tags, 2% dispute-verified share) as 'lagging instruments' — the diagram substituted for data, and the graded pilot's 3 near-misses + 4 resignations priced the error. The routed run held m011 out of top-3 and installed a falsification battery (m031), leverage verification (m040, gate-checking the exact 'unbalanced loop' misidentification), and decisive-experiment pairing (m066: display A/B discriminates H1/H2/H3 in one 2-week read), with the m003 inversion gate pricing the management-favored branch before DO. Residual gap: H2 magnitude is unknown until the A/B completes; no faster read exists.
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose/guarantee + deadline signatures with a complaint/feedback series, a causal loop diagram is a hypothesis, not evidence: route to falsification + leverage verification, classify each measured series as proxy-vs-state, name the funnel/expectation change that would alter the proxy's meaning, require one refutation check per loop edge, and reject interventions aimed at a proxy's level (fix the displayed ETA, not the speed target).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m031+m040 dual-route for proxy-vs-state complaint diagnoses (the router already holds m011 out of top-3 on this signature — the NEG lesson is installed); retain m003 inversion as the standing gate whenever a management-favored intervention targets a falsified edge; generalize the display-A/B-as-decisive-experiment pattern (one cheap read discriminating all hypotheses) into m066's completion contract.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline owned the full behavior-mode map (threshold proximity, delay/overshoot, rule-vs-flow leverage) while the non-routed v5 AI, despite correct equilibria, dismissed the collapse threshold (proposal sits at 80% of E_crit 25,000), skipped the 2-season transition, and recommended gear efficiency — flow-tuning that raises q and pulls the cliff to 12,500 boat-years. The routed run closed all three gaps as m011 contract outputs (threshold distance, delay behavior mode, leverage hierarchy), matched the human's MSY cap (12,500 / 1,250 t/yr), and added m024's long-horizon regret asymmetry plus the self-camouflaging-delay and 80%-of-optimum-headroom insights; residual shared gap: overshoot depth is not computable from tau alone.
signals.learning_signal: On supply/decide signatures with an equilibrium model, equilibrium arithmetic is necessary but not sufficient for systems policy: after computing the steady state the m011 contract must output the collapse threshold and the operating point's distance to it (never dismiss it as 'extreme'), the delay's transition behavior mode (overshoot/oscillation and which lagged indicator management will wrongly steer by), and the recommendation placed on the leverage hierarchy (rule/parameter > flow > buffer) — flow-level fixes near a threshold are fragile and move the cliff toward the operating point.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m011+m024 dual-route on this signature (router confident=no); make threshold-distance and leverage-hierarchy standing m011 contract items; add the recommendation-vs-model stress test ('what does raising q do to E_crit?') as a mandatory packet line on any systems policy; retain m044 as synthesis context for stakeholder resistance driven by the delay (success-looks-real window).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed run already found the task-class split (prediction vs intervention), but the routed dual-route (red team + evidence-weighted SWOT, confident=no) made it contract-driven: the m006 provenance gate separated the measured conditionals (trusted, exactly the ranking quantity) from the unmeasurable U (causal claim unprovable - back-door blocked, no front-door path, no instrument), the red-team pass enumerated and priced the failure branches (quoting +0.12 as causal, refusing until an RCT = Friday forfeiture at 0 purchases, low-E allocation = 600 purchases foregone), and P3 priced the refusal branch at 0. The router's top-3 itself sits away from the causal trap (trap-avoidance held), and the synthesis preserved the causal honesty the pure style owns: non-identifiability stated, RCT named as the route for the causal question.
signals.learning_signal: Causal identification demands must be scoped to the question class: prediction/ranking decisions use the conditional (estimable, no do() needed); only intervention/counterfactual questions trigger the graph/back-door/identification machinery. Non-identifiability of a causal effect never blocks a prediction decision - the failure mode 'unidentified -> no defensible action' converts a correct identification result into a forfeited deadline decision. The ranking is also robust to the causal answer: even a zero causal effect leaves the high-E allocation at 900 vs 300 (attribution changes, allocation does not), so the causal question and the allocation question can be fully decoupled in the packet.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the dual-route on ambiguous signatures (G1) and the router's trap-avoidance (NEG top-3 away from the causal style), with the m006 provenance gate on unmeasured context: (1) classify the asked question as PREDICTION / INTERVENTION / COUNTERFACTUAL in WHAT before any analysis; (2) only INTERVENTION/COUNTERFACTUAL run the identification machinery; PREDICTION proceeds on conditionals with a mandatory one-line caveat that any causal reading is not identified from observational data; (3) price the refusal/no-action branch in the branch table (it is not free - here it is 0 purchases by Friday); (4) gate failure if the packet ends in refusal or NEEDS_EVIDENCE without first delivering the predictive decision, and if the naive contrast appears anywhere without an explicit 'not causal' annotation.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed run computed every number correctly (0.37/0.32/+0.05; 4.5x inflation) but stated the naive-vs-adjusted inflation only at REVIEW and costed only the mass-rollout branch, so the 4.5x check read as a verification footnote, not the decision. The routed pass made the see-vs-do split a WHAT-stage statement, computed the naive contrast and its inflation as first-class HOW deliverables carried into Evidence, and the m006 gate added three likelihood scenarios (0-0.05 range), the break-even threshold flip (0.10: only the marketing claim crosses it), a claim-provenance audit (marketing is the interested party), and all-branch pricing - including the engaged-only extension (+40 purchases, net -$1,000) that both the v5 run and the human baseline suggested as a fallback but that is also unprofitable at +5 pts.
signals.learning_signal: On observational-claims cases, the naive-vs-adjusted inflation audit is not a verification footnote: it is the decision, because the two estimates straddle the cost break-even (here 0.10) and imply opposite actions. A routed causal pass that states the naive contrast before the adjustment, quantifies the inflation factor into Evidence, prices EVERY extension branch (including 'targeted' fallbacks, which can also be net-negative), and demonstrates the break-even threshold flip makes the decision robust across the whole honest effect range - only the interested-party claim crosses the line.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m012 as the routed first-class pass on estimate/predict signatures with confounder-structured data (R1), paired with the m006 provenance gate (R3, unmeasured context): (1) require the naive contrast to be stated BEFORE the adjustment and the inflation factor named in the packet's Evidence, never only in the AAR; (2) require the decision pass to re-run costs on the adjusted estimate AND to price every extension subset (segment-level branch table), calling out branches where the naive and adjusted estimates imply opposite actions; (3) require a break-even-lift computation (cost/margin per marginal unit) so the threshold flip is explicit; (4) keep the stratum-contrast homogeneity check and the residual-unmeasured-U risk line before SOLVED.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline is the style's trap executed — the chain is verified to the deepest evidence-supported cause (vendor release process) and made the primary fix (6–8 weeks) while labeling the 30-minute boundary fix (validation + dead-letter + alert) that fully contains the silent loss 'interim'. The v6 route did not route to pure RCA: the KB's negative-case lesson routes deadline data-loss signatures to m044 (stakeholder lens) with the mandatory m019 adversary gate and tempo mode — finance's stale dashboard is the realized harm, so the boundary fix is primary by construction, the 6-day backlog is replayed, and the vendor tail becomes one scoped ticket.
signals.learning_signal: The negative-case fix is routing, not more digging: a verified causal chain that exits authority/budget/timeline is an escalation boundary, not a fix target; the cheap lever that fully closes the harm is the primary fix, and calling it 'interim' is a status error. Routing deadline data-loss incidents to a stakeholder lens (who needs what by when — finance needs the dashboard current, not a vendor renegotiation) makes containment-primary structural, and the adversarial baseline-risk line (inaction = realized 0.4%/night) is what stops the 'wait for the root' posture.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m044-first route on deadline/adversarial data-integrity signatures with the m019 adversary gate (baseline-risk comparison mandatory) and tempo-mode commit at DO; require an inaction-cost sentence and an explicit 'deepest ≠ actionable' line in every such packet; hold the NEG split by ensuring pure-RCA never routes first on these signatures.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline (v5 loss recovered): the v5 AI stopped one link short — it treated 'migration 0041 never applied' as the root, never inspected file timestamps / runner dedup (E5), and could not predict recurrence on fresh builds (3.6 vs 4.7). The v6 dual-route (m013 causal drill + m091 practiced-routine re-drill, divergence-resolved) made the mechanism-level why (same-second timestamp collision + runner per-second silent dedup), the recurrence test on fresh builds (E6), and the uniqueness+fail-loud+CI-sync root fix completion-contract outputs; the m003 inversion gate added the never/always reframing (never treat a migration absence as a one-off). The AI now matches the human's gold-standard chain (5/5 rubric); the remaining delta is structure and efficiency, not content.
signals.learning_signal: A causal chain is complete only when the cause of the cause is a mechanism, and depth is verified by the recurrence test: 'would this failure reappear after my fix?' A fix that does not remove the generative mechanism is a symptom patch even when it looks structural; 'X was never applied' is a fact, not a root. The routed m013 pass contract (5-whys with per-link evidence, fault-tree structure, prevention-vs-detection gap separation) plus a divergence check against a practiced routine (apply-and-check) is what converts the correct-but-shallow diagnosis from 3/5 to 5/5.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m013 first-class on diagnose/guarantee incident signatures with the m003 inversion gate; make the recurrence test explicit in the packet's verification plan (fresh-build check incl. a deliberately colliding migration) so the prevention-vs-detection gap separation is executed, not just named; retain the dual-route re-drill of the naive stopping chunk as the divergence check that catches shallow roots.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: held the win (human 2.5 / v6-AI 5.0). The pure-style human baseline failed both registered failure modes of the module: it presupposed the org-chart serial flow as fixed structure (dismissing the idle 250/day engine as a 'side channel') and treated the constraint as static over the investment horizon (hiring 5 adjudicators that land after the mix shift dissolves the constraint, month-6 high-touch ≈ 353 < 400 — $1.2M/yr for zero throughput gain). The routed run (m018 steelman + m019 red team, m044 synthesis, m003 gate) formalized the structure-first check the non-routed v5 AI reached ad hoc, and added two moves the v5 AI only partially owned: pricing the strongest version of the hire plan before rejecting it, and the ownership vacuum as the real organizational constraint (unconsulted stakeholder, m019 contract).
signals.learning_signal: On decide/diagnose + guarantee signatures with an apparent capacity constraint, structure verification precedes constraint identification: enumerate ALL processing resources including idle and parallel ones regardless of the org chart, compute the flow under the current routing policy AND the best policy alternative, and stress the constraint at the investment's completion horizon — demand and mix can move it, and in this case dissolved it; when a policy change alone brings every resource below 100% utilization the system is demand-constrained and capacity spend is gated behind a quantified trigger (here: high-touch > 400/day, share > ~85%); interested-party provenance (who benefits from the diagnosis) and resource-ownership status are first-class inputs.
signals.suggested_improvement: Retain the m018+m019+m044 dual-route with m003 gate on this signature (router already holds the serial-bottleneck framing out of top-3 — the NEG lesson is installed); promote the policy-artifact check to the m014 module's own completion contract ('before identifying any constraint: enumerate idle/parallel resources, test the routing-policy counterfactual, stress at the completion horizon') so the module is safe even when it IS routed; keep the 5-day verification + 25% sample fallback as the standing cheap-experiment pattern on policy-change fixes.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: gap closed 0.5 → 0.1 (human 5.0 / v6-AI 4.9; J1 contested, verdict roughly equal/complementary). The non-routed v5 AI matched every number but reached its two best insights — the WIP-buffer signature as the empirical constraint locator and the constraint-movement step — via the verify machinery rather than the initial frame, and paid full option enumeration. The routed run made all three first-class m014 contract outputs (binding-constraint via min-math + WIP signature; exploit-before-elevate; smallest-change-to-lift with min-element pre-filter; constraint-moves monitoring with the post-A S2/S3 tie and next-lift rule), plus tempo mode priced the 12-week deadline and the m003 gate enumerated six ranked failure categories; residual gap is efficiency only — the human's single find→exploit→subordinate→elevate→repeat loop still outruns two passes plus gates.
signals.learning_signal: On estimate/guarantee + deadline signatures with a serial-capacity chain, the m014 completion contract (min-math + WIP-signature first, exploit starvation free before any spend, smallest-change-to-lift pre-filter 'an option not touching the current min cannot change throughput', constraint-moves monitoring after every lift) converts the human's winning structure into frame-level moves and eliminates the v5 AI's redundant enumeration; pairing it with m031's falsifier + decisive-experiment (2-week post-lift measurement) and the m003 gate (ranked failure categories incl. deadline slip and the post-lift tie) covers everything the human implies in one line each.
signals.suggested_improvement: Retain the m014+m031 dual-route with m003 gate and tempo mode on this signature; add a single-pass micro-route for fully-specified serial-capacity chains when m014 is top-1 by a wide margin (the dual-route's only remaining cost is efficiency 4.5 vs human 5 — a solo contract pass plus P8 fast path closes it); keep the next-lift rule ('demand > 100/hr ⇒ lift S2 and S3 together') as a standing packet line.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style rationalized inaction — 25 min of honest probing bought zero new information and cost ~$300K (42 vs 17 min down); the routed run held the v5 AI's win because the m015 pass gate-checked its own registered weakness at contract time: the evidence-driven classification (deterministic 100%, single path, fresh change = simple) and the priced probe plan make rollback-as-cheapest-probe the style's own conclusion.
signals.learning_signal: Routing m015 top-1 on its own negative case is safe ONLY if the pass's completion contract forces (a) an evidence-driven complex-vs-complicated classification and (b) a priced probe plan — every probe must buy new information; unpriced sensing is exactly how the style converts a 4-min reversible action into 29 minutes of probing.
signals.suggested_improvement: Add a discriminating-action check to m015's contract (is there a cheap reversible action that both discriminates and resolves? act first, sense after, verify post-action); keep tempo mode (P2) and a post-action verification alarm mandatory on deadline signatures; retain the calibration note (intermittent/clock-aligned/healthy-parts = probe) so the pass does not over-correct into ignoring complexity forever.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: no correctness gap — the routed pass converged on the scheduled-invalidation cache stampede in 5 probes with the same fix, matching the elite baseline's home turf; the v5 AI gap (plan-first, DB contention ranked #1, decisive experiment buried at step 5, 2.9) is closed because the emergent classification and the probe-sense-respond narrowing chain now run in-frame at WHY/HOW instead of being absent; remaining delta is structure/efficiency only.
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose+maximize+deadline signatures with an interaction signature (intermittent, clock-aligned, healthy parts), the m015 first-class pass with the probe-sense-respond completion contract converts plan-first runs into probe-first runs and matches the elite baseline; the classification must fire at WHY from the signature, never as a REVIEW correction.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m015 top-1 on diagnose+maximize+deadline with clock-aligned/intermittent cues; make probe-narrowing statements (each probe states its effect on the hypothesis space) and the R4 falsifiable checkpoint standing contract items; add a budget-reserve rule (end with >=1 probe unspent) and cross-telemetry fingerprint checks (e.g., CDN hit-ratio collapse confirming origin offload) to the pass.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure Socratic baseline never committed (2.3/5) — it interrogated 'cause' (correlation is not causation), 'outage' (threshold undefined), 'recovery' (undefined), and the urgency itself, burning 10+ minutes at $8K/min while the dominant answer (roll back: leading hypothesis, reversible, $32K worst case) was available at T+2. The non-routed v5 AI already committed at T+2 (4.7/5); the routed run keeps that and adds the m021 OODA tempo contract (observe/orient/decide/act with the outage as an opponent bleeding $8K/min; commit at DO under P2), the m084 coordination reading (the on-call debate is consensus-seeking/diffusion of responsibility; the commander's authority ends it; rollback is the coordination default), and the m007 ruin screen (full distribution 0.7/0.3; in-window decision is one-shot in time → no waiting premium; 0.7 disclosed as judgment with provenance, not measurement). The deferred inquiry — m094 critical reading of the timeline (definitions, thresholds, causation) — is explicitly scheduled for the postmortem. Residual: the 30% wrong-rollback probability is a judgment, not a measurement; no faster in-window test exists.
signals.learning_signal: On decide/diagnose + deadline signatures, the correct discipline is act-then-question, not question-then-act: one hypothesis-framing pass, one EV comparison that prices 'do nothing' and 'investigate first' at the per-unit delay cost, commit at DO (tempo mode), then schedule the definitional/causal questions for after stabilization. 'Waiting for certainty' is a priced option whose EV ≤ 0 whenever delay cost exceeds the expected error cost of the leading-hypothesis action; continued questioning is the most expensive option on the table in-window and ≈ free after. Inquiry is re-budgeted, not abandoned — the postmortem is where the Socratic reading of the evidence belongs, and a coordination reading (who owns the decision, what the debate costs per minute) is part of the answer, not decoration.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m021+m084 dual-route with m094 synthesis on deadline-incident signatures (router confident=no — the trap style's endless-interrogation failure is exactly what this route avoids); retain m007 ruin screen as the standing gate for high_stakes context on tempo-mode tasks; make 'deferred-inquiry plan' a mandatory decision-packet line on every tempo decision (which definitional questions are scheduled, for when); the m016-style interrogation passes must detect a hard deadline in the frame and hand their questions to the postmortem rather than the decision window.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline owned the premise interrogation on its home turf (definition of 'unprofitable' → elenchus counterexample X/Y → reformulated question → flipped decision; 4.7/5), while the non-routed v5 AI accepted the proxy as authoritative and cut X (2.6/5, destroying $1,350/mo of the exact contribution the CEO objective demands). The routed run installed the m016 premise-interrogation pass as a first-class contract (question tree before answers: definitions, unexamined premises, implications; elenchus; reformulation) anchored by m001 fundamentals + measured-data calibration, synthesized with m018 steel-manning (which priced a demand-fragility/obsolescence residual the human baseline never addressed → demand-trend check), and bounded by the m003 inversion gate (6 ranked failure categories, residual, never/always) and m007 ruin screen (reversibility: no one-shot premium; p=1 arithmetic on measured inputs). Every rubric point is reproduced and extended. Residual shared gap: demand-trend risk is unmeasured — the trend check is planned, not executed.
signals.learning_signal: On decide/maximize signatures where an operative term ('unprofitable', 'underperforming', 'critical') arrives pre-defined while the decision objective is stated separately, the definitional-interrogation pass must be first-class and contract-complete: (1) name the operative term and its supplied definition, (2) ask what it means relative to the stated objective (who benefits from the proxy?), (3) construct a data-based counterexample that falsifies the definitional equivalence (a case the rule cuts that outperforms cases it keeps), (4) reformulate the decision question, (5) only then apply or flip. A pass that applies a given rule without the counterexample check has not run (rule 36). Pair with the never/always reframing and a reversibility/ruin check so the flipped decision is also bounded, and steel-man the proxy before discarding it — a legitimate residual (e.g., demand fragility) may survive the elenchus.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m001+m016 dual-route with m018 synthesis on finance/product decide-maximize signatures (router confident=no — the counterexample pass is the difference between 2.6 and 4.9); make 'counterexample against the stated objective' a standing m016 contract item and 'reversibility/ruin check' a standing m007 gate line; the v5 definitional-interrogation gate between WHAT and WHY remains installed, now enforced by the pass contract; add demand-trend check as a mandatory packet line whenever steel-manning surfaces a legitimate proxy residual.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure dialectical baseline (2.6) forced a synthesis — 'merge B's funnel into A's, share one back office, $600k each' — that papered over a non-convex threshold set: below $1.0M the enterprise sales org cannot exist and below $0.8M the B test lacks power, so the both-funded path carried P ≈ 0 per path and burned the runway (both dead by month 7, EV ≈ 0). The non-routed v5 AI already won (4.9): thresholds were hard constraints from WHAT onward, the split was falsified in two lines (0.6 < 1.0, 0.6 < 0.8), and it committed to A + probe. The v6 run holds the protective split structurally: the router's NEG discipline kept synthesis-biased styles out of the top-3 (route m018+m019+m070), so no forced-synthesis pass was even attempted; m018 steel-manning gave B its strongest case (TAM, board preference, faster resolution) without merging — closing the v5 depth gap (AI depth 4 → 5, matching the human's honest tension-naming); m019 enumerated five integration illusions as exploit vectors with quantified exposure (split EV ≈ 0; merged funnel: thresholds survive; lean-both: hard limits; partial-B-as-insurance: breaks A; study-delay: P 0.65 → 0.30, EV $4.2M → $1.4M); m070 evidence-weighted SWOT confirmed; P3 priced every failure branch before DO; P1 flagged 'both matter' as interested-party pressure.
signals.learning_signal: Synthesis is legitimate only when the constraint set is convex — when the conflict is a continuum and the shared resources exceed each side's minimum effective dose. When either side carries a hard threshold (minimum effective funding), integration without commitment is a mirage: the correct structure is commitment by EV plus bounded insurance (a parallel probe or reserve that crosses no threshold), with the sacrificed alternative disclosed as a real loss, never dissolved. The threshold check is the style's signature failure detector and is run BEFORE any integrated/combined alternative is even generated: test whether the proposed allocation falls below either side's minimum-effective level (split invalid if so). NEG signatures with threshold structure should be routed away from integration-biased styles — the router's trap-avoidance (97.2% top-1 away from trap style) is the first line of defense; the steel-man pass (strongest case, no merging) plus adversary pass (integration illusions as priced vectors) is the second.
signals.suggested_improvement: Make the THRESHOLD CHECK a standing pre-integration gate: before selecting or even proposing any combined/partial alternative, test whether shared resources fall below either side's minimum-effective level (split invalid if so); if thresholds exist, force an explicit commitment whose packet names the sacrificed alternative as a real loss and prefers bounded parallel probes or reserves over partial funding. Keep the NEG routing discipline (synthesis-biased styles excluded from top-3 on non-convex-threshold signatures); retain m018 steel-manning as the 'strongest-case construction without merging' pass (it is what raised depth to match the human's tension-naming) and m019 as the pricing engine for integration illusions; retain P3 branch-completeness (failure branch priced before DO) and P1 provenance (board 'both matter' and investor TAM preference flagged as interested-party inputs).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline (4.9) derived the synthesis from an explicit conflict-axis analysis — the camps disagreed about WHERE fixed infrastructure is acceptable (rigid high-energy ramp vs flexible grid-less work), not about diesel-vs-electric — and that axis produced the boundary condition (grid capacity < 60% of ramp demand or horizon < 6 yr → collapse to diesel) as a design condition. The non-routed v5 AI (4.4) opened binary (diesel vs BEV), found the partition by enumeration, accepted the 60% share as given, and back-filled the boundary in REVIEW as residual risk. The v6 run routes m001+m017 (dual-route, AMBIGUOUS) with m004 synthesis context and m003/m007 gates: the adversarial-pair contract (strongest thesis, strongest antithesis, conflict axis, partition-along-axis synthesis preserving both core interests, falsifiable collapse boundary) is a first-class HOW output, the axis is derived at WHAT by the S1 structure-first scan, and the boundary is a packet design condition. Content parity (15/5, $17.25M, ≈ 5.2 yr, −11,600 t) with the method installed; AI adds substation-verification phasing and ruin-screen discipline (reversibility: no one-shot premium). Residual: 60% substation capability is given, not measured on-site; pantograph/battery opex unmodeled.
signals.learning_signal: For any significant decision with two live positions on a decide/guarantee+deadline,high_stakes signature, the decisive move is the adversarial-pair construction done as a contract, before selection: (1) state each side in its strongest form with its best quantitative case, (2) name the axis on which they conflict (the dimension that separates the positions — here route rigidity, not powertrain), (3) test whether partitioning along that axis yields an alternative preserving BOTH core interests, (4) if a partitioned/integrated alternative is selected, name the falsifiable boundary under which the synthesis collapses back to the either/or — the boundary is a design condition, not residual risk. A pass that reaches the partition by enumeration without the axis has not run (rule 36); the 60%-share acceptance without derivation was the v5 gap. Pair with m001 calibration anchoring (all arithmetic on measured inputs) and the m003/m007 gates so the synthesis is also ruin-checked (reversibility, floor alternative) — the floor (all-diesel status quo) is what the synthesis must demonstrably beat.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m001+m017 dual-route with m004 synthesis on decide/guarantee signatures with deadline,high_stakes context (router confident=no — the adversarial-pair contract is the difference between 4.4 and 4.9); make 'synthesis boundary' a mandatory decision-packet field whenever a partitioned or integrated alternative is selected (grid < 60% of ramp demand or horizon < 6 yr → diesel); make the S1 structure-first scan emit the conflict axis before arithmetic for two-position engineering/finance conflicts; retain the m003 (guarantee-prepend) + m007 (high_stakes ruin screen) gate pairing; add phasing (verify infrastructure capability before committing line spend) as a standing packet line for partition syntheses with an unverified constraint.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline rebuilt 'don't roll back' into its strongest defensible form, added a verification pass, promoted the evidence-free LB hypothesis to an open co-equal risk in the final recommendation, and paid ~$150K + refund liability for the courtesy (rollback at 14:19 vs penalty trip at 14:13; 3.0/5). The routed run excluded the trap style at META (m018 out of top-3 — router NEG trap-avoidance), ran m021 OODA as the first-class pass with tempo mode (P2 deadline, cost-of-delay explicit, commit at DO), screened each objection under burden of proof via the mandatory m006 provenance audit (scenarios 90/5/5, posterior range 85-95%, threshold flip at P<30%) and m007 ruin screen (both branches priced incl. failure), and executed the rollback inside the window — 0 penalty minutes, the objection logged as screening-rejected rather than as an open risk.
signals.learning_signal: Steel-manning's registry weaknesses (time cost; can legitimize bad arguments) are context-triggered: on deadline+high_stakes+unmeasured incident signatures the rebuild must be screened out BEFORE it runs — an objection whose claims carry no measured signal or named mechanism is rejected under burden of proof, never granted dialectical status; screening is not denying the objection's possibility, it is the cost-optimal tempo when the environment prices delay.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the trap-avoidance route (m018 out of top-3 on incident signatures) and add a standing evidence-free-objection log to the packet: every objection must carry a measured signal or a named mechanism or it is recorded as screening-rejected, never as an open risk; require tempo mode (cost-of-delay sentence + commit at DO) on all deadline contexts; verify by re-running the clock arithmetic against the penalty terms inside the packet.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI reached the right decision (reject rewrite, ETL-first modernization) by cost-benefit recomputation but never played the losing side's best defender — it inherited the memo's 'band-aid, tried 3x and failed' frame, left the 90%-untested-behavior risk unpriced, and skipped the survivor test (3.7 vs 4.6). The routed dual-run (m018 steelman first-class with the strongest-form + steelman-vs-critique separation contract, m019 adversary, m070 synthesis) plus the m003/m007 gates closed every rubric item: straw-man named and set aside, all four evidence-grounded arguments (re-derivation cost of 340 fixes, ETL as the real goal gap, staffing math, attempt-history reframing) rebuilt and addressed quantitatively, deepest objection answered by sequencing — the decision matches the human baseline and now provably survives the strongest opposing case.
signals.learning_signal: Steel-manning is a first-class dialectical move with a completion contract: the opposing position must be rebuilt in its strongest defensible form (the proponent would accept it) BEFORE critique, with the steelman and the critique physically separated — otherwise the agent evaluates the losing alternative as listed and cannot show its decision survives the best version of it; the straw-man dismissal in the source text is evidence about the author, never the position itself.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m018 pass contract on decision memos with an explicit opposing position: require (1) straw-man named and set aside, (2) >=3 evidence-grounded arguments rebuilt from the fixed evidence, (3) quantitative address per rebuilt argument, (4) survivor test — the deepest objection answered, not dodged; pair with m003 inversion (guarantee-goals) and m007 ruin screen (high_stakes) as standing gates; verify by re-deriving each rebuilt argument from the appendix, never from the memo's framing.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline is the style's trap executed — every hypothetical (key loss, auth-server outage, firmware, SOC 2 addendum) at full severity, inaction treated as risk-free while password-only EHR access with 41 shared accounts, 3 leaked credentials, and an active brute-force attempt last month continues. The routed dual-run (m018 steelman vs m019 adversary, synthesized) prices inaction first (do-nothing-loss line), likelihood-ranks all six objections, and rejects >=3 false alarms with their rejecting evidence (SLA, recovery workflow, rollback test, artifact-vs-functional), reaching a reversible time-boxed approval with monitoring and named abort criteria.
signals.learning_signal: Red teaming without calibration is hazard theater: 'could happen' is not a blocker where the baseline is already failing; the completion contract's do-nothing-loss-first rule and reject-objection log are what convert attack into decision — the decision compares baseline risk vs mitigation risk, never absolute safety.
signals.suggested_improvement: Dual-route m018+m019 on go/no-go signatures (steelman vs attack, divergence resolved by branch-completeness + calibration); keep the m003 inversion gate's never/always reframing (delay is a decision) and the m007 floor/abort-criteria checks as standing gates on high_stakes reversible decisions; require an inaction-cost sentence in every go/no-go packet.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human attacked every line item (data movement, auth model, publication, external timelines) and ranked LxI; the v5 AI found only the pattern-recognizable flaws (bonus gaming, survey gating, premature publication) and conditionally approved — approving the breach (PII + password-reset tokens to pre-SOC2 staging with a public unauthenticated export endpoint, shared admin login, no DPIA) and the timeline collision (60-90-day customer vendor-risk review vs 2-week go-live). The routed m019 pass contract (exploit-vector enumeration with identity gates and guessable formats, quantified exposure per vector, unconsulted-stakeholder inventory, do-nothing-loss baseline, LxI-ranked objections) plus the m006/m007 gates closed the find set to all 5 planted flaws and flipped the verdict to block-as-written.
signals.learning_signal: On adversarial plan reviews the adversary pass must be a line-item attack with a completion contract: exploit-vector enumeration (identity gates, guessable formats) with quantified exposure per vector, unconsulted-stakeholder and external-approval-cycle inventory, do-nothing-loss baseline, and LxI-ranked objections — otherwise the pattern-recognizable incentive/metric flaws are found while the fatal security and stakeholder-timeline items sitting in plain text get approved.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m019 pass contract as a standing contract for any adversarial/high-stakes plan review; require a per-line-item data-movement audit (what data, where it lands, auth model, certification state, legal sign-off) and an external-stakeholder timeline inventory in the packet before any conditional approval; verify by re-reading the plan text line by line, not by re-deriving already-drawn conclusions.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the strict human pre-mortem manufactured a 15-item unranked catastrophe list (venue fire, wifi, food poisoning, hurricanes) for a plan with an 11-run success streak, runbook, and insurance — mitigations either duplicated existing coverage (changed nothing) or escalated to deferral (paralysis) — and never analyzed the actual decision (ticketing adoption); the one genuine risk (migration integrity) was buried at equal weight among fifteen. The routed dual-run (m011 systems scan vs delta-scoped pre-mortem, synthesized) classified the plan unchanged-vs-delta by base rate, discarded the insured generic causes under the evidence rule, capped the pass at 3 LxI-ranked delta risks, and committed adopt-with-gated-rollout (rehearsal gate + numeric criteria + 48h rollback) on a tempo deadline.
signals.learning_signal: The pre-mortem's power is conditional on base rates: 'assume failure' manufactures failure modes when applied to unchanged, historically successful elements — unranked causes whose mitigations duplicate existing coverage or demand escalation. The corrective discipline is the delta-only contract: enumerate causes only for changed elements, discard any cause without scenario-supporting evidence, cap at ~5, rank by likelihood x impact, and end in a decision with a checkpoint/rollback rule — plus tempo-commit at DO so the decision week is not lost.
signals.suggested_improvement: At META/WHAT, classify plan elements as 'unchanged + historically successful' (take as given; runbook/insurance are the existing mitigations) vs 'delta' (the only risk surface) before any risk pass; wire the evidence-discard rule and the <=5 cap into the m020 module contract as gate checks; dual-route m011+m020 on decide/maximize signatures with divergence resolution, and require the m020 pass to terminate in a committed decision with a rollback rule, never a list.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 AI found the buried killer risk (TianTech capacity-first clause + single congested lane + zero buffer) by line-by-line reading in WHY and reached the permanent channel-displacement consequence only at REVIEW, while the human back-cast got both in-frame; the v6 routed run executes the pre-mortem as a first-class pass with a completion contract — failure assumed first, unsupported causes discarded, causes LxI-ranked (capacity conflict = killer, displacement = critical), mitigation per top cause altering the commitment (T+6/T+10 gates) — and the m003/m019 gates add 7 ranked failure categories and a baseline-risk line. The v6 AI additionally quantified what the human left at High/Med ranks: capacity-conflict likelihood 10/35/60% with a threshold flip at the T+6 media lock.
signals.learning_signal: For guarantee/adversarial commitment decisions, the pre-mortem completion contract (assume-failure back-cast with an evidence-discard rule, LxI ranking, top-1 mitigation that changes the commitment itself, second-order consequence named in-frame, likelihood range per dominant risk) converts 'risk found by reading order luck' into 'risk found by construction' — the v5 AI's own AAR conceded the risk surfaced 'not because the task asked what happened'; the routed pass makes the question mandatory before any commitment is evaluated.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m020 pass as a standing first-class module for decide/guarantee/adversarial signatures with the likelihood-range and threshold-flip additions (tie the flip to a contractual calendar point, here the T+6 media lock); pair it permanently with the m003 inversion gate (never/always reframing) and the m019 baseline-risk-first line; require the packet's risks block to name a second-order consequence of the failure state for every launch-commitment decision.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the strict human run cascaded three internally-valid shutdown/restart cycles (~$160k + near-cancelled fresh-produce contract) by cycling at the tempo of a noisy alarm system in a non-adversarial, minutes-to-hours environment — the specifying evidence (11 false alarms/30 days, redundant in-range sensor, flat 24h trend, clean lab results) sat unused until cycle four. The v6 routed run refused the trap at META: the tempo-mode classifier output DELIBERATE-BOUNDED (adversary none, dynamics min-to-h, trigger base rate 11/30) despite the deadline flag, and the routed m023 opportunity-cost pass (forgone-value check: ~$3k information vs ~$80k/cycle) + R4 m003 inversion (≥6 ranked categories incl. the cascade) + R3 m019 adversary pass (P(false|alarm) ≈ 0.9 → act-now is the risky move) produced the deliberate ~$3k play with a hard ≤45-min gate.
signals.learning_signal: The tempo assumption has a precondition the style itself does not check: the environment must actually be fast and adversarial. Where dynamics are minutes-to-hours and the only pressure is the alert's salience, acting at the alarm's tempo means cycling at the false-alarm rate — a feedback loop the operator feeds. The corrective discipline is a META tempo-mode classifier (adversary present? dynamics timescale? action reversibility? trigger base rate) switching to DELIBERATE-BOUNDED, plus a base-rate statement for any salient signal and a wall-clock bound on the deliberation pass.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the explicit tempo-mode classifier in META with inputs adversary-present / dynamics-timescale / reversibility / salience-vs-base-rate and outputs ACT-NOW | DELIBERATE-BOUNDED | PLAN; on guarantee signatures keep R4 m003 inversion and R3 m019 adversary pass as standing gates (on this case they are what make the deliberate play contract-complete); add to the WHY gate: no decision before collecting evidence whose collection cost is lower than the irreversible cost of the action.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline decided at T+5 on partial evidence and won the clock (~22 GB at cut); the v5 non-routed run reached the identical plan but spent a WHY verification pass and decided at ~T+12 (~36 GB). The v6 routed run closed that entire gap: the m021 tempo-cycle pass ran first-class with tempo math (1.5 GB/min vs 45-90 min to encryption), tempo mode P2 committed at DO, and the ≤5-min wall-clock budget at T+0 made the T+5 act-now decision a pass contract rather than an AAR wish. Gates m007 (ruin screen: act-now distribution vs wait-to-ruin) and m019 (adversary pass: quantified exposure per vector incl. 1.5 GB/min bleed) made the human's implicit cost-pricing explicit; the insight pass front-loaded the human's two winning observations (identity not needed to justify credential rotation; convenient scapegoat = hypothesis with a price) into the pass itself.
signals.learning_signal: Tempo is a first-class, gradeable reasoning capability in adversarial environments: the deciding quantity is cost-of-acting vs cost-of-waiting per unit time, not 'how sure am I'. For cheap, reversible actions with a measurable growing bleed rate, full verification is exactly the delay the adversary bets on; act-then-re-orient with a stable frame (no reversal without new evidence) is the winning pattern, and a wall-clock budget per decision point prices analysis in the environment's own units (GB/min).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m021 tempo-cycle pass + tempo mode (P2) + per-decision-point wall-clock budget as the standing contract on adversarial/deadline signatures: observe-the-chain, orient on cycle-speed comparison with tempo math, decide+act on partial evidence, re-orient on every signal, orientation-stability check in REVIEW (any reversal must cite new evidence). Require the m007 ruin screen and m019 adversary pass on high_stakes/adversarial contexts — they converted v5's review-stage afterthoughts into gate outputs.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline ran calibration (p_crisis 0.2 -> 0.35), branch-value verifiability (A crisis node -13 -> -48), and the robust rule (maximin + ruin line -> C) all in-frame; the non-routed v5 AI calibrated only the probability, issued a false 'robust to misspecification' claim (A at 18.9 after p-only correction), selected A, and reversed to C only at review. The routed run put both perturbation axes and the ruin screen before selection (m007's probability+value provenance, P1's who-benefits audit catching the analyst's interest in a decisive A, m089's optionality preserving A-as-pilot, m021 tempo bounding the tree to 18 leaves), reaching C in-frame with no reversal. Residual shared gap: A's corrected crisis node (-48 ± 15) and the B/C order remain input-error-sensitive; no data exists to narrow them.
signals.learning_signal: On high-stakes one-shot decisions with an analyst-supplied tree, sensitivity is two-dimensional (probabilities AND branch values): one-dimensional perturbation is a false-reassurance engine that certifies the wrong rank, and when the pivot branch is unverifiable the robust rule (maximin, ruin line) decides, not the EV — with who-benefits as a first-class input property (the analyst's decisive recommendation is the interested-party signature to audit first).
signals.suggested_improvement: Extend the m007 ruin screen's probability-provenance item into a full input-provenance gate (values AND probabilities, plus who-benefits); install 'perturb values, not just probabilities' as a standing sensitivity contract on any tree with unverified branches; keep m044/m089 dual-route on analyst-supplied-tree signatures (stakeholder motive + optionality as the trap-escape), with m021 tempo capping enumeration (18 leaves suffice; 72 leaves change nothing).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline costed the failure branch and all thresholds in-frame (fold 170/27.5/73; p* 0.474; license threshold $170M; q* 0.088) while the non-routed v5 AI stubbed the failure branch (root 62, p* 0.56) and repaired it only at review; the routed run priced the failure branch in-frame via the P3 branch-completeness gate plus the m023 opportunity-cost lens (abandon-on-failure forgoes a rescue worth 27.5), matched every threshold, and added the m003 inversion gate (>=6 ranked failure categories, un-mitigable residual, never/always reframing) and the state-contingent-hedge reading of the $150M offer ($170M as renegotiation floor). Residual shared gap: the 0.6 trial-success estimate is calibration-band, not measured frequency; the tree cannot hold dilution, pipeline correlation, or regulatory tail.
