signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m024+m039+m041 triple on high-stakes guarantee/predict planning signatures; make the clause-to-stream coverage matrix a WHAT-gate artifact (any goal clause with no claiming stream blocks progression); require critical path + float and a named merge-back in the decision packet BEFORE selection; treat a coverage sweep found in REVIEW as a process miss; keep the one-shot ruin floor with a dated trigger for external-gate dependencies (venue here) so P8 fast paths stay governed.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style fell into the registry's own weakness — ladder drift, lost concreteness (02:14 pool exhausted → climbed to change governance, scheduled the descent for Monday, treated the exact value as 'an incidental token,' leaving ~60% of payment requests failing at $6K/min). The routed run holds the v5 AI win because the router itself refuses to route m042 on the deadline signature (its learned triggers are unmeasured-context) and dual-routes m015+m021 as contract-checked passes: the m015 classification (single fault mode + single fresh change + reversible snapshot = simple) plus the priced probe (restore-as-cheapest-discriminating-action) and the m021 OODA tempo commit force restore-before-climb; v5's E5 stabilize-first was a situational route, v6's restore-first is contract-enforced.
signals.learning_signal: The abstraction ladder has a floor: the task's time horizon sets the abstraction level — minutes means the exact key, value, scope, and timed verification ARE the deliverable, and climbing (capacity policy, change governance) is a post-stabilization REVIEW item, never a pre-restore plan; a reframe that cannot name key/value/scope/verification within the task's horizon is drift, not abstraction. Deadline+diagnose signatures must never single-route the laddering style; tempo styles (m015 act-first, m021 OODA) are the protective pairing.
signals.suggested_improvement: Enforce the anti-drift floor check at META/WHAT: when the signature is deadline + diagnose/estimate with a known recent change and a reversible snapshot (simple/chaotic domain), (a) DO the concrete restoration before any WHY climb with the descent naming exact identifiers, values, scope, and a timed verification (<2 min); (b) cap pre-action diagnosis at the ~30-second check that points the first action; (c) move every class-level climb to REVIEW after verification; (d) keep tempo mode (P2), P3 failure-branch pricing (escalation staged if verification fails), and the KB trigger that refuses the drifting style on deadline signatures.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: no correctness gap — both sides converge on the habit-rung reframe and plan (week-1 activation instrumentation, onboarding to the aha event, T−45 re-engagement at >40% decay, page work only for the non-decayed cohort, +8–12 pts in 2 quarters). The v5 AI gaps are closed by the routed pass: the climb (renewal page → mechanics → value realization → habit; 'the subscription is bookkeeping for continued usage') is now the m042 contract's first move at WHAT instead of a level-check afterthought, and the re-climb falsifier (quarter-1 cohort study: no activation→renewal correlation → abandon habit, re-test price) is wired into the plan's go/no-go with a numeric threshold from the m006 provenance gate (activated cohorts must renew >=65% vs <55%) instead of sitting in the packet; remaining delta is structure/uncertainty only.
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose+maximize metric-regression signatures with a decay-concentration pattern (c:unmeasured), the m042 first-class pass — climb to the goal rung first, select the rung by which abstraction the evidence concentrates under, descend to concrete Monday actions with owners and time scales, anchor every line back to the ledger metric — converts frame-late runs into frame-first runs and matches the elite baseline on its home turf; the R3 m006 gate (unmeasured) prices the expectation as >=3 likelihood scenarios with a posterior range and a demonstrated threshold flip.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m042 top-1 on diagnose+maximize with metric-regression/unmeasured signatures; make the climb mandatory-first in WHAT (rung chain recorded before any optimization, one rung per step); require rung selection to cite the discriminating concentration evidence (80%/>40% decay vs <15% retained, flat elasticity, win-back failure); require the descent to name at least one concrete action per rung with an owner and time scale; wire the falsifier as the plan's go/no-go with a numeric threshold (not only a packet note); keep the ladder-drift guard (each line returns to the ledger metric) as a standing contract item.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline anchored on the 10-year horizon (800 jobs, plant survival), declared the near-term costs 'the price of the future,' computed $4.5M/yr only to dismiss it as tail-event noise, and never noticed the stated causal fact that an incident shuts the plant and destroys the 10-year goal itself. The v6 routed run ran the CEO's narrative as a claim to test (P1 provenance: interested-party anchor), applied the certainty×recurrence discounting rule (certain recurring harm at face value vs P = 0.25 speculative gain), added the m085 depletion frame (10 years of 0 incidents = silence of a working guard), and the m003 inversion gate enumerated 6 ranked failure categories including irreversibility and the self-defeating shutdown link before DO.
signals.learning_signal: Long-termism's failure mode is asymmetric discounting — speculative long-term gains weighted at face value while certain, recurring near-term harm is discounted away. The corrective is the intertemporal-honesty guard as a first-class pass (certainty×recurrence audit; probability attached to the speculative term; 'does the present harm defeat the future goal?' causality check) plus an inversion gate on guarantee signatures; with both, the trap the pure style fell into is gate-checked by construction.
signals.suggested_improvement: For any temporal trade-off narrative, route the horizon-separated pass with the honesty guard and pair it with m003 inversion (R4 guarantee): require (1) near-term EV vs near-term gain computed before long-horizon framing dominates selection, (2) a probability attached to every speculative benefit, (3) the incident-kills-the-goal causality check whenever a present sacrifice is proposed, (4) ≥6 ranked failure categories with the un-mitigable residual named.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline's whole trace WAS the horizon table (verdict + weight per horizon, flip identified, 6-month cost mitigated in the plan); the non-routed v5 AI reached the same decision but horizon separation arrived only as a verification device, named the 6-month suffering a 'transition cost' (corrected in REVIEW), and weighted horizons by intuition. The v6 routed run closed every gap first-class: the horizon-separated pass produced the 1-day/1-year/10-year verdict+weight table with the stated primary-endpoint rule (10-year survival) before selection, the honesty guard priced months 1-6 as a mitigated plan item, and the m007 ruin screen added probability provenance, a one-shot check, and the priced S-with-fallback alternative.
signals.learning_signal: On time-staggered decisions the routed horizon-separated pass (1 day / 1 year / 10 years evaluated separately, per-horizon verdict + weight, discounting rule explicit, intertemporal-honesty guard) executes the style's winning moves as a first-class contract — no horizon collapsed, near-term costs priced rather than rationalized — and matches the pure-style baseline on every rubric line (a)-(e), where the non-routed run failed three of the five structurally.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the horizon-separated pass routed for decide/estimate signatures carrying stated time horizons; make the per-horizon verdict+weight table and the discounting rule ('a later benefit never erases a certain near-term cost; it appears as a mitigated plan item') completion-contract outputs; pair with the m007 ruin screen whenever high_stakes; the insight pass should name the horizon flip itself as the analysis.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline hit all three registry failure modes simultaneously (inflation to 120 households/regulators/future customers, paralysis via a 6-month task force + bridge subsidy, empathy-as-decision 'the social cost exceeds the financial gain'), never making a call inside the 2-week window. The non-routed v5 AI won by sidestepping the style; the routed run wins WHILE running it: the m044 pass completed its matrix with the weaknesses gate-checked (inflation bounded by decision relevance, every keep-voice countered in transition design, empathy routed to implementation), the m031 dual pass falsified the 6-month study on the calendar (it cannot report before the 60-day take-or-pay binds), and the m003 inversion gate ranked the take-or-pay/task-force trap as the top failure category (near-certain x severe) before DO — the trap was priced as branches, not dodged. Residual gap: family governance friction is named but not fully priceable.
signals.learning_signal: Stakeholder analysis is a design tool, not an authorization tool: at frame time separate decision right (owner alone — no stakeholder holds veto) from impact, bound the stakeholder set by decision relevance inside the window (regulators, households, future customers excluded), and treat hard deadlines (take-or-pay clauses, budget cycles) as converters of 'study more' into 'default decision by expiry' — falsify any delay option on the calendar before weighing it. Empathy is an implementation input (severance, continuity, outplacement), never a go/no-go criterion; when a style's registered failure modes match the situation, the pass must gate-check them explicitly, and an inversion gate must price the trap branch before DO.
signals.suggested_improvement: For decide/guarantee + deadline signatures, keep the m031+m044 dual-route (the router's confident=no ambiguity flag is correct) and make the weakness gate-checks (inflation bound, paralysis counter-map, empathy-routing) explicit completion-contract items of the m044 pass; keep m003 inversion as the standing R4 gate when guarantee goals meet hard deadlines — the 'never let the deadline decide' reframing and ranked failure categories (take-or-pay-by-inaction first) should be mandatory packet lines; add a calendar-falsification check to the m031 contract: any option whose horizon exceeds the earliest binding deadline is excluded before valuation.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline owned the full stakeholder map first pass (want/capability/move rows for 8+ parties including resellers and burned accounts), while the non-routed v5 AI found the comp perversity only through an explicit WHY pass and missed the reseller channel (18% of affected revenue) until a HOW premortem. The routed run's m044 completion contract made the want/can-do/will-do/hidden-requirements/reactions matrix a first-class HOW output: sales comp and reseller margin were found first pass, hidden requirements (burned trust, renewal windows, rescue play, support drowning) derived from incentives, and second-order reactions (credit-bonus Goodhart on the comp fix, competitor acceleration from repair visits, mid-market deprioritization) exceeded the baseline's depth; the m019 gate quantified per-vector exposure (25% ARR, 18% channel, announcement-as-tripwire timing) and tempo mode committed the sequence at DO. Residual shared gap: reseller margin-neutrality is assumed, not tested — week-1 channel check required.
signals.learning_signal: On rollout/org-change decisions (decide/estimate/predict + adversarial/deadline), the failure surface is stakeholder incentives, not engineering: a first-class stakeholder pass must produce want / can-do / will-do / hidden-requirements / reactions per party (customers segmented by renewal window, sales, reseller channel, support, CS, finance, competitors — not just 'the customer'), hunt perverse incentives (any party paid to preserve the status quo) and hidden requirements (renewal windows, trust debt, capacity shortfalls) from incentives rather than the brief, then check every predicted move has a counter-move and every counter-move has a second-order reaction (who benefits from gaming it? — Goodhart on comp fixes, tripwires on announcements) before sequencing by stakeholder risk, never by contract size.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m044 as the confident single-route first-class pass on this signature with the full matrix contract (want/can-do/will-do/hidden/reactions + second-order reactions) as the module's completion contract; keep m019 as standing R3 gate for rollout signatures (quantified exposure per vector, announcement-as-tripwire timing, baseline-risk comparison); add a 'counter-move second-order' item — for each counter-move, ask who is paid to game it — to the m044 contract; retain tempo mode (P2) on deadline context so the sequence commits at DO.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-framework baseline performed its registered failure pair at full fidelity — it applied all three lenses earnestly, demonstrated (unwittingly) that each can justify either candidate, declared the choice 'a value judgment the frameworks cannot make,' and handed the CEO exactly the certification document he ordered; it never questioned the premise that a review commissioned after the economics were fixed is ethics-washing. The non-routed v5 AI already won by running a framing screen before lens analysis; the routed run wins WHILE making the screen structural: the dual-route (confident=no) ran m011 + m044 as first-class passes — m011's causal-direction check (the deliverable sits downstream of the decision, so its only content variable is which name the conclusion favors) and m044's incentive matrix (the CEO's hidden requirement is a justification for either choice; 'justify whichever' mandate = confirming loop) independently falsify the certification before any lens runs, the falsifiable invariance test (swap the records; 'both defensible' invariant ⇒ the document certifies, not analyzes) makes the smoking-gun checkable, and the m020 pre-mortem priced the discovered-post-hoc branch (leaked leaning + minuted contradiction = firm liability). Residual gap: the memo's reception by the board (non-certifying record accepted?) remains untested — the decision table is handed over, not verified.
signals.learning_signal: Ethical frameworks cannot rank conflicting values; expecting them to is what makes framework shopping possible. The first move on any 'ethics review' is a framing screen that is structural, not a vibe: check causal direction (was the review commissioned AFTER the economics were fixed? then it is downstream of the decision and cannot inform it), and check the requester's incentives (a 'justify whichever we choose' mandate is a confirming loop whose deliverable's content is pre-set). Falsifiable test: if the review's defensible-conclusion set is invariant under swapping the candidates' records, the document certifies rather than analyzes. When the lenses are outcome-insensitive, the honest output is a memo that separates economics from ethics, demonstrates the shopping risk, states the no-ranking result as the finding, and forces the decision-maker to minute the prioritized value on the record.
signals.suggested_improvement: For decide/maximize + deadline signatures with an ethics-washing pattern (review ordered to justify a fixed choice), keep the m011+m044 dual-route (the confident=no ambiguity flag is correct — the trap style must stay out of top-3) and add a 'framing screen' item to the m011 contract: causal-direction check (deliverable downstream of decision?) with the invariance test as the falsifiable observable; add the confirming-loop check (mandate wording 'whichever we choose') to the m044 contract's hidden-requirements row; retain the m020 pre-mortem as standing context so the discovered-post-hoc liability branch is priced before DO; the memo deliverable (economics/ethics split, CEO's priority minuted) should become the standard packet format for certification-request signatures.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline was the gold standard the case was built for — three lenses with distinct content, the utilitarian reading run to its conclusion (under the company's optimistic prior the calculus licenses (c)), the duty/virtue prohibition named, the regulator rule shown to delete the 'middle path' (b), and the 30/30 sample quoted as a ~10% 95% upper bound. The non-routed v5 AI reached the same decision (a) and found the trap, but processed obligations as constraints inside a consequentialist frame: it never let the utilitarian lens run to (c), never stated the consequence-vs-duty conflict, and quoted the sample as 'clean.' The routed run closes every gap: the m045 completion contract made the three-lens pass with explicit priors, the conflict statement, the no-framework-shopping choice-by-argument, and accountability (Priya's signature) + dual-use checks (sample as reassurance vs laundering use of the accelerated protocol) mandatory HOW outputs; the m003 inversion gate ranked the failure surface (silent-leak tail risk, regulator discovery of the logged drift, sample over-read, post-hoc signature exposure) with the residual (postponed-surgery harm is certain) named; the P1 audit flagged the 0-1/400 estimate as company-authored (interested party), and tempo mode committed disclosure at DO with the accelerated-protocol approval requested in parallel. Residual shared gap: the true leak rate of the 370 remains unknown until retest — the decision's residual cost is admitted, not removed.
signals.learning_signal: The elite move in ethical reasoning is to let the lenses disagree on purpose: run each lens to its verdict with priors stated, then decide against the named conflict and admit the cost of the non-chosen values. Consequence analysis is prior-dependent (an optimistic prior licenses the wrong answer on a clean sample); duty/virtue constraints bound the option set and collapse fake middles (disclosure makes the hold mandatory, deleting the 'compromise'). The completion contract must require: each lens run to its conclusion with explicit priors; the conflict stated as the case's core whenever verdicts differ; a choice-by-argument rule (duty bounds the option set, welfare maximizes inside it) to prevent framework shopping; and accountability (who signs) + dual-use (sample/protocol as reassurance vs laundering) checks. Sampling evidence must be quoted as confidence bounds (Clopper-Pearson ~10% at 30/30), never as point estimates.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m045 as the confident single-route first-class pass on this signature with the full completion contract (3 lenses to conclusion + explicit priors + conflict statement + choice-by-argument + accountability + dual-use) as the module's contract; keep m003 inversion as the standing R4 gate when guarantee goals meet evidence gaps (the ranked failure categories incl. 'clean-sample over-read as rationalization channel' and 'signature exposure post-hoc' should be mandatory packet lines); add the confidence-bound rule (Clopper-Pearson upper bound at n/0) to the m045 contract's evidence quoting; retain tempo mode (P2) so the accelerated-protocol request is committed in parallel with disclosure rather than serially.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: same verdict as v5 (transactional RDBMS ledger retained, S3 log demoted to archive) but the catch moved from the v5 WHY falsification stage to the opening pass: the router's trap-avoidance excludes the style whose proposal is on trial and routes to an evidence-graded SWOT (strength items graded low-relevance against the non-binding throughput constraint and dropped), a strongest-form steelman of the derived design (which still fails the crash-between-append-and-apply test), and an adversary pass with quantified exposure and baseline-risk comparison. The inversion gate then makes failure enumeration complete (7 ranked categories, residual, never/always) before selection — v5's correct-but-late catch is now a first-pass check, and the ecosystem-experience check is explicit rather than an afterthought.
signals.learning_signal: A derivation that omits binding constraints (crash atomicity, auditable per-mutation truth) while optimizing an enumerated non-constraint (throughput) is caught fastest by routing AWAY from the deriving style and through evidence-graded SWOT + strongest-form steelman + adversary pass: the evidence grading exposes 'true but irrelevant' strengths, the steelman exposes the attribution gap in the strongest form, and the inversion gate guarantees complete ranked failure enumeration before selection.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the trap-avoidance routing on negative signatures where the proposing style lost historically (m046 absent from its own NEG route); make the ecosystem-benchmark question a standing completion output on any high-stakes design pass — 'what failure mode does the rejected pattern encode, and have I enumerated it?' — and require the crash-window test (state between steps N and N+1, attribution, repair cost as a function of partitions) as a gate for every derived multi-step write path, not a WHY-stage discovery.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: verdict and every number identical (monolith + Postgres batched upserts for locations, transactions on assignment state, write-through cache; pattern rejected). v5's gaps — the AI opening with the team's pattern as the working hypothesis and needing a WHY falsification stage (throughput math vs 20k+ tps, async-hop latency) to reach the same design — are gone: the routed constraint-derivation pass enumerates data loss-consequence first (ephemeral vs durable), then scale, latency and change rate, with units carried, a calibration anchor (20k+ tps Postgres, 1 s bound, <50 ms cache), and an ecosystem-experience check that names why the pattern exists and why it targets the wrong data class here. The inversion gate added ranked failure completeness and a stated residual the baseline never enumerated.
signals.learning_signal: On fully-specified architecture settlement tasks, the constraint-first derivation order (data loss-consequence → scale arithmetic → latency bound → change rate) plus a calibration anchor and an ecosystem check is sufficient to reach the baseline's design at first sight; the v5 cost of pattern-falsification disappears once the pass is first-class rather than a review-time retrofit.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m046 first-class pass and m003 inversion gate as the standing contract on guarantee/engineering architecture tasks: enforce the fixed constraint order, the units-carried and calibration-anchor checks, and the ecosystem-experience check (state what the rejected pattern encodes and for which data class it is correct) as completion outputs, not style flavor. Retain the loss-consequence classification before any pattern vocabulary enters the pass.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline audited the prior's reference class and the likelihoods' provenance in one disciplined pass and refused point precision; the v6 AI reached the same content only through the mandatory m006 provenance audit (unmeasured context) + m007 ruin screen, which forced the likelihood band (1.5%-5.1%), the 92.3% wrong-prior harm floor, and NEEDS_EVIDENCE terminal status — the exact correction the non-routed v5 run missed (it treated quoted Se/Sp as validated exacts, reported SOLVED with false precision, and scored 3.9 vs human 4.9).
signals.learning_signal: Likelihoods need provenance audits exactly like priors: enriched development cohorts (50% prevalence by construction), single-center samples, and missing CIs make Se/Sp hypotheses about likelihoods, not likelihoods — recompute the posterior over credible bounds, label the point estimate 'unvalidated', and forbid point-precision terminal status: SOLVED requires validated likelihoods, otherwise NEEDS_EVIDENCE with the safe decision still delivered.
signals.suggested_improvement: Standing rule for unmeasured/high_stakes medical signatures: keep m006 + m007 gates mandatory and map terminal status to likelihood provenance — (1) any posterior whose likelihoods lack target-population validation terminates in NEEDS_EVIDENCE with the band, the wrong-prior extreme as cautionary floor, and the validation pathway stated; (2) the m007 ruin screen's probability-provenance check (FALLS -> no point estimate trusted) runs before any disposition is committed.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline produced every checkable number and the interpretive core in a pure linear trace; the v6 AI matched it point-for-point only through the routed dual pass (m047 test-characteristics ordering + m091 chunked verification) with P3 branch pricing — the exact structure the non-routed v5 run lacked (it stopped at the positive branch, never priced LR-, ran sensitivity as an ad hoc spot check, and scored 4.0 vs human 4.9). Residual baseline edge: its clinical translation was more economical (one line per move); the routed pass needed its contract stack to reach the same depth.
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose/decide signatures with medical domain and fully-specified inputs, the m047 completion contract (test-characteristics ordering with criterion stated + population decomposition + >=3 likelihood scenarios + decision-threshold flip) combined with branch-completeness (P3) is what converts 'correct numbers' into 'correct decision support': the negative branch of the selected test (LR-) is load-bearing in low-prevalence screening and can move the disposition more than another positive would.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m047/m091 dual-route as the standing route for fully-specified medical posterior problems; enforce that the P8 closed-scope fast path may compress stage structure but never the contract deliverables (negative branch priced, formal >=2-prior band, LR+ ranking stated, threshold flip) — speed applies to narration, not to completion.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style over-modeled (registry weakness 'data-hungry, over-modeling'): it mapped the store→DC→supplier chain, requested 12 weeks of POS data, simulated an order-up-to model, and prescribed a 3-4 week safety-stock/reorder-optimization/S&OP program for a visible 5-minute cause — reorder qty 40 vs 400, changed 14 days ago (exactly the onset window), deficit 400 − 40 = 360/day matching the OOS exactly, manager's day-1 log reading 'check reorder qty', DC 99.7% fill ruling out upstream in one line, flat POS ruling out demand. The human's own simulation reproduced the OOS only with 'effective supply ~40/day' — the parameter screen it never opened (v5: human 16/40, AI 36/40). The non-routed v5 AI already won this case with cheap-checks-first triage; the routed run held the win and hardened it: m091 chunking made the onset-audit + one-line falsifications first-class; the m003 inversion gate (R4, guarantee goal) priced 8 ranked failure modes of the systemic program BEFORE DO (reorder optimization inherits Q=40; safety stock sized on the wrong effective supply; $650/day bleed; program metric — fill rate — unchanged by definition); m020 pre-mortem priced the program's no-mechanism-touches-the-parameter failure branch; restore-as-decisive-experiment named the 5-minute fix as the cheapest discriminator; tempo mode (P2, deadline) committed at DO. Residual gap shared with both baselines: why the parameter changed remains un-mitigated (no change control) — the v6 run names it as the explicit process follow-on.
signals.learning_signal: On decide/guarantee + deadline signatures with a sharp-onset deficit, the onset-window audit + two one-line falsifications (fill rate, demand stability) + exact arithmetic (400 − 40 = 360/day) outrank the full chain model: a deficit that (a) matches the onset window (a setting changed 14 days ago), (b) is arithmetically explained by a single parameter, and (c) has upstream/demand causes ruled out in one line each, has the parameter restore AS the fix — and any honest chain model needs that same parameter in its calibration ('effective supply ~40/day' IS the parameter screen). Structural programs (safety stock, reorder optimization, S&OP, collaborative forecasting) are justified only after cheap checks fail; before proposing one, invert it (≥6 ranked failure modes — the program inherits the corrupted rule and has no mechanism touching it) and price its failure branch (weeks of bleed, unchanged metric). The cheap restore is also the decisive experiment: if the deficit were not from the parameter, the OOS would not end within ~1 day.
signals.suggested_improvement: The trap-avoidance is installed (router keeps the systems style out of top-3 on this signature — m048 never routed; the NEG lesson is live). Keep m003 inversion as the standing gate whenever a data-hungry program is proposed against a visible local cause with a guarantee goal; add restore-as-decisive-experiment to the cheap-fix completion contract (m091 chunking), and generalize the onset-window cheap-checks-first triage as a WHAT-stage item on any anomaly diagnosis; add change-control/4-eyes on parameter edits as the standing follow-on process item so the residual is closed by process, not by the next model.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline mapped the chain as stocks/flows/delays plus the inventory-correction and information loops and named the leverage (rule and information flow, not the factory) at first sight, while the non-routed v5 AI opened sympathetic to the CEO's capacity frame and rejected the $2M flexible-production CAPEX only after the variance-ratio gate — correct, but one structural pass late (v5: human 37.5/40, AI 36/40). The routed run closed both gaps as contract outputs: structure-first scan at WHAT (loop map, delay inertia), the m048 completion contract (bullwhip check with multiplier 1 + 2L/p + 2L^2/p^2 = 5 / 1.625; echelon variance trace 100 → 500 → 2,500 → 12,500 with the distributor's '5x' explained at echelon 1; policy lever = decision rule, not capacity — CAPEX absorbs but does not remove manufactured variance), plus falsifiable observable (factory order variance must fall toward ≤ 500/~162 after the rule fix), local-data-first (model reproduces observed distributor sigma 50 before predicting), and cheap-fix-as-decisive-experiment (the ~$50-100k rule change discriminates the compounding model; the $2M CAPEX is the expensive experiment). m044's stakeholder provenance re-framed the CAPEX as an interested-party solution pre-arithmetic and surfaced the hidden requirement (a visible sigma 112 → ~13 story plus a deferral path, not a refusal). Residual shared gap: cross-echelon compounding is approximate under serial correlation — both sides flag simulation verification, neither runs it in-trace.
signals.learning_signal: On supply/decide signatures with a volatility complaint and a capacity proposal, the bullwhip is manufactured by the decision rule and the information flow, not by demand or production: before any capacity investment, compute the variance multiplier of the governing ordering rule (1 + 2L/p + 2L^2/p^2) and trace variance through every echelon (100 → 500 → 2,500 → 12,500); a downstream 'demand is 5x more volatile' claim is explained at the first echelon, before production exists. The leverage hierarchy is rule/parameter > information flow > capacity: information sharing (all echelons forecast end-customer demand) and forecast smoothing (p=4, multiplier 5 → 1.625) beat capacity additions by ~9x on sigma because capacity absorbs variance without removing its source; a capacity proposal on this signature is an interested-party frame whose arithmetic must be demanded before discussion. Every systems-style pass on this family must output the falsifiable observable and the cheap-fix-as-decisive-experiment so the fix is verified, not asserted.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m044+m048 dual-route on this signature (router confident=no, gap 0); the m048/m011 contract gains: structure-first scan at WHAT entry, echelon variance trace with the 'first-echelon explains the complaint' check, leverage-hierarchy statement (rule > information > capacity) with the CAPEX-absorbs-but-does-not-remove line, falsifiable observable, and cheap-fix-as-decisive-experiment — all standing items, not REVIEW afterthoughts. Make interested-party provenance (P1) of any capacity proposal a mandatory packet line on supply-chain variance signatures; retain m011 as corroborating scan context and P8 fast path when the case is fully specified.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline was arithmetically flawless and strategically wrong — it recommended the across-the-board raise and never modeled the rival (the registry's registered weakness 'ignores competitive response'). The routed run steers away from the trap style (single-route m070, top-3 keeps m002/m019) and makes the competitive-response check structural: the evidence-weighted SWOT graded Valtech's threat STRONG-credible and dropped the baseline's unverified 'no competitor at that price'; the adversary pass priced both response branches (hold $110 -> $35M, match $95 -> $35M, both −12.5%); the inversion gate enumerated 6 failure paths; the segment-aware plan (raise only the contract-locked 40%, +$4M, ≈ $44M/+10%, worst case ≈ parity) replaces the +6.25% mirage. Residual gap: Valtech's response probability is unmeasured — the $100 spot tripwire is the arbiter.
signals.learning_signal: Unit economics are conditional on the competitive environment — a demand function is not a game: before any pricing recommendation, name the credible responder (cost advantage, idle capacity, precedent), compute the plan under both match and hold branches, and reject any plan whose response-conditional contribution is below status quo; segment by switching cost and price only where switching is contractually impossible (elasticity −0.3, +$4M) while holding where a credible undercut would be answered; the evidence-weighting pass converts 'no competitor at that price' vibes into an unverified-assertion flag.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m070 on pricing/adversarial signatures with m003+m019 gates; add a mandatory credible-responder screen to the m019 adversary pass checklist for any pricing/strategy recommendation (name the responder, its cost advantage, idle capacity, and precedent; price both branches; set a tripwire metric such as a rival price threshold that triggers re-modeling).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline derived retention physics first-pass (lifetime = 1/churn, LTV $195, CAC ceiling from LTV) and won v5 (4.6/4.4) on the AI's framing lag; the routed run matches the baseline's first-pass physics and passes it — P1 provenance splits measured cohort data from interested-party playbook anchors, the R3 ruin screen bounds the one unmeasured parameter (8% post-fix churn) as a gated bet, the R4 inversion gate enumerates 6 failure categories of the board plan, and the competitive-response check treats peer CAC as an equilibrium-moved target. Residual gap: post-fix churn 8% and peer CAC drift remain unmeasured — the cohort gate is the only arbiter.
signals.learning_signal: On high_stakes growth-strategy decisions the m049 pass must run before any spend framing: compute churn -> lifetime -> LTV -> CAC ceiling from own cohort data, recompute every benchmark number under own retention physics (peer LTV/CAC is a property of peer churn), locate the binding constraint inside the cohort curve (months-1-3 churn, channel-invariant), and gate any scale-up on a falsifiable cohort metric; the inversion gate converts the near-breakeven scale plan into an explicit failure list and the ruin screen makes the retention program a Kelly-style gated bet rather than a commitment.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m049 on growth/strategy POS signatures with m003+m007 gates; add CAC-drift pricing to the m049 pass checklist (peer CAC is set by playbook adoption — treat it as a moving target with a tripwire re-derivation rule); attach the cohort-churn falsifier (monthly cohort churn < 12% for 3 quarters) to the packet's evidence so the strategy ships with its test plan.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human shipped all 12 enumerated countermeasures (BOM €43.5, retail €79, launch T+12) — the registry-documented feature-bloat failure from equal-weight enumeration; it never triaged severity x likelihood x exposure and treated the IEC 60335-2-15 mandated controls as insufficient by default. The non-routed v5 AI already won via threshold triage (4.8 vs 3.0); the routed v6 run keeps the win and makes it defensible: the trap style was never routed (out of top-3), m044's stakeholder pass converted the decision into preorder/window terms, m023 priced the forgone margin per euro, and m019 named the consultant's completeness pitch itself as the exploit vector with quantified exposure and baseline-risk comparison. Residual gap: the routed packet costs more passes than the human's cheap (wrong) answer.
signals.learning_signal: The bloat trap is defeated by routing, not by resisting it: when the signature is adversarial+deadline with hard cost constraints, exhaustive-inversion should NOT be the first-class style — route stakeholder + opportunity-cost passes instead, and gate inversion (m003) with a feature-bloat guard that caps kept items at a priced threshold and forces a risk-aversion-vs-value decision per item. The double-counting check is decisive: every mitigation must be priced against the risk it removes AFTER the mandated controls are counted (items 4, 5, 8 duplicate IEC 60335-2-15), and the smart layer's worst case (a dumb kettle) bounds all app-failure severity.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the trap style out of top-3 on cost-constrained guarantee signatures (router NEG property held on this case); make the feature-bloat guard (keep <= 2 cheap hedges, defer the rest with trigger conditions) a standing part of the m003/m050 gate; add the stakeholder map and exploit-vector naming (who benefits from the bloat) as standing m044/m019 outputs so the rejection memo is board-defensible, and let tempo mode commit the final set at DO on deadline signatures.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human's edge in v5 was exhaustive FIRST-PASS coverage — the gas path into the living space and counterfeit-cell authenticity were first-class in the opening enumeration, where the non-routed v5 AI promoted them only at REVIEW (4.3 vs 4.6). The routed v6 pass closed that gap by contract: the m050 first-class pass enumerated all 8 categories in HOW with the non-obvious ones first-class, the m007 ruin screen priced the catastrophic tail (one-shot UL 9540A gate, ruin distribution, €3 traceability floor, decline/restructure alternative), and the m003 gate added the never/always reframing and un-mitigable residual. Residual gap: the human's single continuous category walk is stylistically leaner than the routed packet's ledger; both rely on the same industry base rates for likelihood provenance.
signals.learning_signal: On high-stakes safety briefs, exhaustive inversion is a completion contract, not a posture: every credible harm/failure category must be enumerated and ranked in the FIRST pass with the non-obvious categories (gas path, supply authenticity, firmware) first-class — a category promoted later by review is a latent miss at the certification gate. Pair it with a ruin screen: certify the one-shot gates, name the ruin distribution, set a non-negotiable floor (the cheapest item with a one-shot ruin property), hold spend headroom for a margin decision instead of spending to zero, and define the decline/restructure alternative before DO.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the m050/m003 first-class contract (enumerate-all + rank + design-against-each + safety-completeness + feature-bloat guard) as the standing HOW pass for product/security/supply signatures with guarantee goals, and keep the m007 ruin screen mandatory on high_stakes: the €3 traceability-as-floor and gas-flow-test-as-falsifier moves ('certification coverage ≠ safety coverage') should be standing insight candidates, not discovered per-run.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style recommended investing $10M on a claimed EV of $12.75M — 78.4% of it in an asserted 2% $2B probability with an empty reference class — treating an interested-party assertion as a measurement and calling a 27.5% margin robust against ±4x estimation error on the dominant parameter. The routed pass caught it with three independent mechanisms: m019 exploit vectors (false precision, reference-class substitution, interested-party benefit, fund-level rationalization), m006 provenance scenarios (p = 0.2-0.8% → EV $3.75M-$6.75M, all losses; threshold flip at p* = 1.45%), and the breakeven-ownership inversion s* = 78.4% > 50%.
signals.learning_signal: When a single low-probability bucket dominates an EV table, probability provenance is the decision, not the arithmetic; the style's documented failure (false precision on unmeasurable probabilities rationalizing a bad bet) is structurally caught by the unmeasured → m006 gate plus the m019 adversary pass, and the ownership-inversion breakeven (s* > 50% at the claimed price) is a cheap decisive diagnostic.
signals.suggested_improvement: Make provenance-audit-before-EV-table a standing completion contract for any EV pass whose dominant bucket has no measurement channel (extend R3 'unmeasured' to decision cases); add the breakeven-ownership inversion diagnostic to m007/m051 passes; keep token-sizing (bounded error ~$0.6M) as the tail-optionality fallback with a reference-class evidence gate before any repricing.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline solved the arithmetic exactly (B $215M vs A $185M, f* = 0.625, p* = 2.7%, counterfactual) but never established floor/dominance or input provenance. The routed pass added the ruin-screen floor analysis (A floor $0 vs B floor $50M — stochastic dominance), isolated the 1% tail as the single judgment input with the decision proven invariant to it (B−A = $30M at every p), and named target-reachability (3x unreachable by construction at the modeled tail).
signals.learning_signal: On fully specified power-law portfolio problems the style's arithmetic is exact and unbeatable on numbers; the v6 win came from floor comparison across alternatives plus provenance isolation of the one judgment parameter, not from better math.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m007 ruin screen and P1 provenance audit on high_stakes portfolio signatures; add floor-per-alternative as a standing move in portfolio EV passes (A $0 vs B $50M, stochastic dominance check); make target-gap reachability an explicit packet line so a 3x-vs-2.15x gap is stated as a sourcing requirement, not an allocation failure.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline thrashed — five probes converted into five same-week counters (20 bps given on all new signups, two engineering quarters on payroll parity, one on dev-portal parity, six months of reader hardware, a marketing counter) while churn held flat at 1.2% and the POS-vendor integration project (the only moat bridge) fell three quarters behind. The v5 AI only won by an emergent mid-run re-route (META re-framed from response to structure). The routed run never faces the failure: protective routing kept the reactive style out of top-3 by rule (m052 is absent from m044 m088 m011), the m088 pre-commitment pass installed the anti-thrash mechanism (reactive-spend ledger ≤ 1, engineering allocation protected by rule not judgment, T+9 engagement calendar), and the m003/m019 gates priced the failure branches (subsidy leak, wrong cohort, T+9 dates unverified, hidden equilibrium move) with the churn data as the falsifying observable.
signals.learning_signal: The style's documented failure — reactive thrash against a structurally moated position — is now prevented by ROUTING (trap style excluded from the top-3, anti-reactivity style routed, mandatory inversion + adversary gates) rather than by the agent's emergent self-correction: the moat screen and the response cap that v5 had to notice in-episode are installed as first-class mechanism, converting a 5.0-vs-2.4 win from a lucky re-route into a repeatable contract; the residual risk that no gate removes is the unverified T+9 expiry date, which is why verification-before-window must gate any scheduled engagement.
signals.suggested_improvement: Preserve NEG trap-avoidance in the router (reactive/tempo styles out of top-3 on moated signatures with guarantee goals); promote the moat-screen + probe-vs-equilibrium classification from the m052 weakness checklist into the m019 gate so ANY routed pass on a moated signature must name the moat's mechanisms and cite churn/flow falsifiers before a response is drafted; add 'ledger + pre-commitment' as a standing output for weekly-cadence adversarial signatures (response budget, protected engineering allocation, switching-event calendar); gate every scheduled engagement window on contract/certification date verification.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline already nailed the tempo move — 72h decision at ~60% info, targeted time-boxed counter (top-60, 90-day 15-20% + onboarding credit), T+30 re-observe, and the 'first mover sets the frame' insight — the v5 AI lost this case (4.1 vs 4.3) purely on timing because WHY/HOW verification consumed the tempo budget (decision landed T+6). The routed pass (m044 + m052 dual-route, m019 gate, tempo mode) closed that gap and added what the loop lacks: tempo advantage quantified as a completion contract (absolute ship deadline T+8 derived from the market clock, study EV = 0 past the frame, 72h @60% arithmetic), adversary branches the pure loop never prices (feint < 25%, coverage rule for cohort misidentification, rival's extension-option negative-EV from the 90-day cap), and an explicit structural-moat escalation check (tempo not the only weapon — move to moat economics at T+30 if the rival extends).
signals.learning_signal: On the style's home turf (tempo market, adversarial deadline) the loop's core move — decide at the information level the market clock allows, ship before the frame is set — is necessary but no longer sufficient for the agent to WIN: the v6 edge came from making tempo a quantified contract (deadline arithmetic + study-EV-zero rule), not from running the loop faster; the human still wins the efficiency dimension because one pure loop outruns a dual-route + gate + packet, so the contract must be measured in ship-date, not process size.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep tempo mode (P2) and the m052 completion contract on adversarial+deadline signatures; add 'absolute-deadline-from-market-clock' as a standing line in every OODA pass (derive the last ship date from the counterparty's calendar — conversation/renewal dates — not from analysis time); add the feint-probability baseline comparison, the coverage rule (any touched account qualifies), and the extension-option negative-EV check as standing outputs; keep the moat-escalation line (tempo not the only weapon) so the pass names when pricing stops being the right battlefield.

signals.human_model: Root Cause Analysis in Incident Response
signals.key_gap: vs baseline (held): the human baseline is the trap executed — timeline + 5-Whys + full action-set (12 items, org-culture whys) with restoration subordinated to analysis (T+45 min, 2.4). The v6 route does not route to the incident-RCA style at all: the KB's negative-case lesson keeps the trap style out of the top-3 (m015 m021 m028 instead) — the fix is routing, not a template exception inside the style. m015's mechanism-boundary (simple failing system vs complex unfalsifiable org) and m021's tempo make restore-first and the ≤2-item cap structural rather than a lucky general-route gating as in v5; the m003 gate's never/always reframes the template's ≥3-item mandate itself as the amplifier, and the insight pass adds the watcher-as-detection-gap insight the non-routed run lacked.
signals.learning_signal: The negative-case fix is routing + boundary, not more discipline inside the style: when the cause is visible in the log, diagnosis is a checkpoint, not a goal; why-chains that leave the evidence horizon (org culture, staffing, urgency) are stories, not analysis, and each story branch has a cost the incident pays in real time. The mechanism layer is the correct action boundary — deeper is deferred with trigger conditions written at DO — and the template itself (mandated minimum item counts, mandatory deep dives) can be the incident's amplifier: compliance cost must never exceed incident cost.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep RCA off deadline/diagnose-with-visible-cause signatures to hold the NEG trap-avoidance rate; pair m015+m021 with the m003 inversion gate on restore-first incidents; make the evidence-cutoff line ('chains stop where evidence stops') and trigger conditions for every deferred item mandatory packet entries; add 'template compliance cost <= incident cost' as a standing check so the style's known sprawl weakness is gate-checked, not trusted.

signals.human_model: Root Cause Analysis in Incident Response
signals.key_gap: vs baseline (v5 loss recovered): the non-routed v5 AI found the correct root but ran ONE chain — it reached the detection chain (August threshold raise, wrong rotation → 42-min MTTR) and the same-class meta-point (the threshold raise is itself a config change of the trigger's class) only as REVIEW-stage afterthoughts (4.1 vs 4.7). The v6 dual-route (m053 incident-RCA + m091 practiced-routine re-drill, divergence-resolved) makes the two-chain walk (failure + detection) and the prevention/detection gap split first-class completion-contract outputs; the m091 re-drill catches the naive revert-only chunk on the class recurrence test; the m003 inversion gate adds the control-lens reframing (never auto-promote a config-class change without a canary; a control change belongs to the class it controls). The AI now matches the gold-standard chain first-pass; the remaining delta is efficiency (dual-pass vs one pass), and it wins on structure and uncertainty handling.
signals.learning_signal: Incident RCA is TWO chains, not one: a failure chain running to the pipeline heuristic (the root is the classifier that rated the config 'low-risk', not the config — provenance: who benefits from the classification) and a detection chain running to the alert budget and rotation ownership. Detection gaps are themselves uncontrolled config-like changes, which is why the fix that prevents the incident and the fix that would have detected it are the same fix class. Depth is verified by the per-item recurrence test ('catches same-class incident: yes/no'); a fix that fails the class recurrence is a symptom patch even when it restores service.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m053 first-class on decide/diagnose/guarantee incident signatures with m091 as the divergence re-drill of the naive stopping chunk and the m003 inversion gate as the standing completion contract; make the two-chain walk, the per-item recurrence test, and the classifier-provenance step (who benefits from a low-risk classification) mandatory packet items so prevention-vs-detection gap separation is executed, not named; attach an alert-budget review to any threshold change so control changes inherit the class they control.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline (v5 AI won 4.8/3.0): the pure style validated its registry weakness — an invented 10% penetration became crisp 'TAM ≈ $4.5B', which then set the revenue target and the Series A narrative. The v6 routed run keeps the v5 AI's range-only answer (p = 2-30% -> $0.9B-$13.5B, 15x span) and adds first-class passes that harden it: the m019 adversary gate (R3, adversarial) quantifies the exploit vectors of a point figure (target mis-setting ~3x hiring, narrative anchoring), m044 maps each stakeholder's exposure to false precision, m070 weights the evidence toward the only supported end (today run-rate $1-3B), and the 0.07% required-penetration inversion shows the go/no-go is capacity-governed. Residual gap: dual-route + m019 gate cost a pass vs the v5 single route (efficiency 5 -> 4.5), and the range's midpoint remains quotable if the memo's lead (inversion first) is skipped.
signals.learning_signal: When the dominant factor of a sizing chain carries no anchor, a point estimate is a preference, not a finding: output the range with the carrying factor's span named, state decision sensitivity explicitly (go/no-go unchanged across the full span -> say so), invert (compute the penetration the target requires) instead of deriving the target from TAM, label TAM vs SAM vs obtainable before any comparison, flag pre-existing beliefs as anchors, attach an evidence plan as the stated precondition for any point figure, and quantify each stakeholder's exposure to the false-precision figure. A market size that cannot change a decision is theater; producing it crisply is a calibration failure even with perfect arithmetic.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the adversarial -> m019 gate on sizing signatures and add 'lead with the evidence-supported end of the range' (run-rate first, unmeasured upside second) to the m054 contract's deck shape; extend the m019 'quantified exposure per vector' line with the required-penetration inversion on every decision-relevant target; NEEDS_EVIDENCE stays the terminal state for unanchored-dominant-factor sizings until the evidence plan delivers pilot/base-rate data; add the stakeholder map (m044) to the packet's risks whenever the memo is decision- or narrative-consumed.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline (v5 human won 4.6/4.4): the routed run now installs the human's decisive first-pass moves as WHY-stage contract items — animals-not-households revenue unit, penetration anchored to the published 5-6% base rate with the UK/Sweden lag-vs-ceiling bound, two independent cross-checks (~10% agreement) — so the v5 AI's only flaw (a guessed 20% 'software-like' penetration candidate it had to screen out in HOW) is class-gated before arithmetic; the closed-scope fast path recovers the efficiency gap (v5 AI 4 → 4.5) and the m011 growth-loop + dominant-factor sensitivity statements add depth. Residual gap: the human's five-line trace is still leaner and its insight phrasing ('insure the animal, not the household') is cleaner than the AI's machinery-mediated equivalent.
signals.learning_signal: Fermi market sizing wins when the dominant factor is anchored BEFORE alternatives are generated: revenue unit chosen explicitly (insured animals, not households; seats, not companies), penetration held to a published base rate with an international bound, >=1 independent cross-check within ~2x, order-of-magnitude stated, and the decision readout (what share is buildable) derived from the size rather than embedded in it. The v6 m054 chain contract (TAM/SAM/SOM from population x segment x penetration x price, every factor shown, dominant-factor sensitivity stated, penetration-guess caveat) plus the P1 factor-class gate turn the human's first-pass discipline into a standing requirement, and the compounding-growth line makes the number quotable against the right time base.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m054 chain contract + P1 factor-class gate (estimate-without-anchor is gated at WHY) on all g:estimate sizing signatures, with the excluded unanchored guess named in the packet's risks; add a growth-loop line (compounding base rate) to the dominant-factor sensitivity statement so the share readout is tied to today's base; keep the P8 fast path on fully-specified sizing briefs; the m011 falsifiable observable (insured-pet census year-over-year) should ship in the packet's evidence field as the re-check trigger.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline completed the identification audit (cross-section dead on selection, time series dead on no-counterfactual, RDD dead on manipulation, no IV, no baseline) and refused the causal claim everywhere, then separated the decision and made it fund the missing identification (staggered adoption, pre-registered outcomes, pre-set effect-size bar, 24-month revisit). The non-routed v5 AI ran the same audit but leaked the confounded +5.3 pp into the renewal justification as a 'modest positive signal' and conditioned renewal on a generic monitoring mandate (3.9 vs 4.9). The routed pass makes the quarantine structural (m019 adversary pass enumerates the leakage vector with its exposure; P1 provenance flags who benefits from the number; a leakage check scans the justification), rejects the conditional branch as monitoring theater via divergence resolution + P3 branch-completeness (a monitoring mandate with no comparison structure never identifies the effect), and delivers the baseline's signature move — the decision funds the identification design — as the m024/m018/m007 pass ensemble rather than an emergent REVIEW-stage insight; the m007 ruin screen adds the one-shot school-year window and the floor argument (food-security goal met with certainty).
signals.learning_signal: When identification is impossible and an action is externally forced, the causal claim and the decision claim must be decomposed into separate packets: the causal estimate stays 'not established' in every sentence (a correlation from a dead design is never support for a decision — require an explicit leakage scan of the justification), and the decision proceeds on decision-theoretic grounds (explicit error-cost asymmetry: which error is irreversible, which revisable; operational certainty) — never on evidence that does not exist. The decision itself should fund the future identification design (staggered roll-in as a natural experiment, pre-registered outcomes, effect-size bar set before results, revisit date): an unavoidable evidence gap becomes a scheduled experiment, and a conditional-on-monitoring renewal with no comparison structure is a dead design that must be priced and rejected. Registry weakness 'identification often impossible' is handled by refusing the causal claim, never by refusing the decision.
signals.suggested_improvement: Standing gate for NEEDS_EVIDENCE/INFEASIBLE + forced-action signatures: (1) decision/evidence decomposition into two packets; (2) leakage check scanning the decision justification for any confounded statistic used as support — reject on hit; (3) explicit irreversibility statement (which error is irreversible, which revisable) + one-shot check; (4) the decision must attach a funded identification design (natural experiment, pre-registered outcomes, pre-specified effect-size bar, revisit date) — conditional-on-monitoring alternatives without a comparison structure are rejected by branch-completeness; (5) a communication rule keeping 'not established' in all public language. This gate subsumes the v5 'decision/evidence decomposition' suggestion and adds the ruin screen and the dead-design rejection.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline's threat-class confounder audit (time-invariant -> absorbed; common time shocks -> absorbed; time-varying x region-specific -> SURVIVES) ran before any estimator, so the Region-A-only retraining program forced window restriction on the first pass; the non-routed v5 AI ran estimators first, passed a parallel-trends placebo on the full-window DiD, and recovered the confounder only via a verification round-trip (4.1 vs 4.9). The routed pass installs the audit as the m055 identification-first contract (natural experiment named, confounder audit, 'what survives the strategy' stated, estimator-vs-structure ordering, do-vs-see), so the restricted estimate (+0.7 pp; naive +4.3 pp, cross-section +1.8 pp, full-window +1.7 pp all rejected before any estimate is presented) is produced first-pass; the m044 dual-route additionally named the press trap and the co-claimant problem (the retraining agency owns the same +1.7 pp), and the packet now states the identification ceiling (post-2023 windows can never separate subsidy from retraining).
signals.learning_signal: On causal-estimation signatures, identification-strategy-first with a threat-class confounder audit closes the 'confounder seen only via verification' failure class: enumerate (a) time-invariant differences (absorbed), (b) common time shocks (absorbed), (c) time-varying x unit-specific shocks (survive — must be designed out by window restriction, never by robustness checks), before any estimator; a parallel-trends placebo cannot catch a post-period unit-specific confounder because it loads exactly where the treatment loads. A dual-route synthesis pass adds policy-claim stakeholders (press trap, co-claimant) at zero marginal cost, and every estimate must be paired with its surviving-threat list and its identification ceiling.
signals.suggested_improvement: Standing m055 completion contract for causal-estimation signatures: (1) name the natural experiment/identification strategy before any estimator; (2) threat-class confounder audit with the class-(c) list required empty or window-restricted before an estimate is attributable; (3) estimator-vs-structure ordering (choose the estimator from the surviving-confounder structure, not the other way); (4) do-vs-see separation (correlational/SEE numbers never stated as intervention/DO claims); (5) packet entry for the design's identification ceiling (which future windows are structurally unidentifiable) and a falsifiable observable (same-month placebo). Keep the identification-first contract on the deep-gap module list; it converts the v5 round-trip failure into a first-pass output.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style failed by design — user words as requirements, physics never entered the loop, and the verbatim quote ('it cools down while I pour') was re-transcribed into the wrong 'hotter' frame. The dual-route (m094 critical reading + m033 controlled experiment design, m100 falsification frame, tempo mode for the deadline) made the reframe structural: the 73% claim interrogated as a survey artifact, the verbatim quote decoded at the measurable-variable level (decay, not max temperature), the 'hotter' spec falsified as untestable with this hardware (100 °C ceiling, 15 A breaker), and the final cycle pre-registered as an experiment (intervention, control, blinding, exact thermocouple outcome ±1.5 °C) with the element-upgrade branch priced and rejected.
signals.learning_signal: On physics-bound consumer products, technical constraints are the decision driver and must be screened before any empathy/prototype loop spends a cycle (P5 constraint screen); a stated need that maps to an infeasible spec ('hotter') is framing evidence, not a requirement — decode user language at the measurable-variable level; the dual-route of critical-reading + experiment-design is the correct synthesis for survey-vs-physics conflicts, and the m100 move (the stated need is unfalsifiable with this hardware) is what kills the trap cleanly.
signals.suggested_improvement: Make the constraint screen a standing gate before any prototype-cycle spend on physical products; pre-register the acceptance rule for the final cycle (m033 contract: intervention, control, randomization, blinding, exact outcome measure) so the last cycle is decisive either way; keep tempo mode on deadline decisions — the verdict commits at DO, not re-litigated at review (the human-style failure is exactly the re-litigation against the user's words).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human reads the O6 hedge ('good knife but I'm careful') as the decisive fear cue and lets O1 falsify the survey's 'sharper' claim directly, all in one empathic pass; the v5 AI reached the same P2 decision but parked O1's edge-geometry implication as a secondary check and leaked survey weights into its criteria. The routed run (m070 evidence-weighted SWOT first-class + m003 inversion gate + m019 red-team check + insight pass) graded the survey as weak proxy evidence before any criteria were set, promoted O1 to a first-class failure category with an instrumented re-sharpen co-measurement, and reached the same decision plus comparable reframes (I1: 'sharper' and 'dull by week 2-3' are the same complaint in two languages; I2: the redesign risk is the handle). The residual gap is only the human's single-pass empathic synthesis.
signals.learning_signal: On user-observation cases with conflicting evidence, the survey-vs-observation conflict must be graded as evidence BEFORE any decision criteria are set (m070 move: stated preference = proxy/weak, behavior-coded rows = strong), and the observation row that contradicts the survey (O1: re-sharpen complaints despite a sharp factory edge) must become a first-class hypothesis with an instrumented measurement, not a parked check — the routed gate structure is what converts the reframe into a testable spec rather than a narrative.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m070-style evidence grading as the standing first move on any product redesign with conflicting evidence sources; require that the contradiction row (O1-class) is either a testable hypothesis or an explicit residual in the packet (m003 inversion item 5 + m019 vector 1 deliver this); the insight pass already generates the reframe the human produces by empathy — keep S2 mandatory as the packet gate.

signals.key_gap: vs the human baseline: the pure style fell into its registered trap pair (attacker-obsession + false confidence in controls), invented new attack paths beyond the closed assessment, dismissed insurance as non-prevention, and prescribed option (a) — €900k + guaranteed €150k/mo penalty, the only guaranteed-loss option. The v6 route excluded m057 from the top-3 on decide/adversarial/deadline signatures (trap-avoidance) and ran m019+m023 as first-class passes with the m003 gate and tempo mode: the residual was quantified (€50–150k/yr EV vs 6–18× EV for (a)), the breach branch was priced before selection (P3), and escalation triggers were named as falsifiable checkpoints — the v5 AI win is now a repeatable route rather than a one-off.
signals.learning_signal: When the assessment is closed and controls exist, the decision is absorbing a priced residual within constraints — the winning configuration is an adversary pass (vectors + quantified exposure + baseline-risk comparison) dual-routed with opportunity cost (all branches priced incl. failure, sunk-cost guard), gated by m003 inversion (ranked triggers), with the 'contract makes the kill-option infeasible' and 're-allocate the tail, don't fight the surface' reframes; the router's exclusion of the pure attacker style on decide signatures is the single highest-value trap-avoidance move in the KB.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m057 out of the top-3 on decide/adversarial/deadline signatures (trap routing holds); standardize the m019+m023 dual-route with m003 gate and tempo mode for closed-assessment risk decisions; install 'contract-infeasibility screen before generation' and 'insurance = priced transfer, never prevention; but the residual EV must be quantified before acceptance' as standing packet lines.

signals.key_gap: vs the human baseline: the baseline's winning moves (first-sight read of the export endpoint's presence-only lock, 'one leaked key opens every door') were one-pass by instinct; the v5 non-routed AI lost that pass and had to re-rank the export endpoint after an evidence walk. The v6 routed run makes the attacker-first ordering structurally forced by the m057 completion contract (assets/attack-surfaces/controls + exploitability realism + control prioritization), so the zero-privilege read and the secret-first fix order are produced before any ranking, and the m070 evidence-weighting pass plus the m003/m019 gates add ranked failure categories and a baseline-risk comparison (delta vs proper authN/authZ) the baseline only implied.
signals.learning_signal: On guarantee/adversarial signatures the threat-model completion contract converts 'think like an attacker' from an aspiration into a first-class pass: read the lock before attacking the vault, trace each hop at request level, rank fixes by cost-to-exploit vs control cost, compare against a baseline; the contract makes the killer find (presence-not-claims + leaked secret = zero-privilege full dump) unavoidable on the first pass, eliminating the re-rank cycle that cost the non-routed run its efficiency and first-pass insight.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m057 top-1 on guarantee/adversarial signatures, always dual-routed with m070 (evidence weighting kills checklist theater) and gated by m003 + m019; install the threat-model completion contract as the standing contract for all attack-surface deliverables, with the baseline-risk comparison (delta vs proper-auth baseline) as a mandatory packet line.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style priced a phantom option — staged EV $58.5M on fabricated 75%/80% (no base rates on a novel node), timeline compressed 25→18 months via a qualification overlap the design-freeze requirement forbids, and no audit of readout decision-relevance or of the exercise alternative (abandonment = company failure). The routed run reproduced the correct decision as completed contracts: m011's chain-sum calendar check before any EV, m006 provenance audit (posterior ≈ prior), the three-pre-conditions audit (time/information/exit), and m007's certain-ruin floor; the router's refusal to route the option style on a one_shot signature is itself the protective move.
signals.learning_signal: Real-options framing must run three pre-conditions before any EV: time to exercise (calendar check on the critical path), decision-relevant information (the readout must enter the posterior), and a real exercise alternative (abandon must not equal failure of the company). Option styles must not route one_shot/deadline signatures without these gates.
signals.suggested_improvement: Add a mandatory option pre-conditions audit (time / information / exit) before any staged EV on one_shot or deadline signatures (R3-class, m007-adjacent); keep m058 off one_shot routes — dual-route m011+m044 instead; make the m006 provenance audit fire on any unvalidated likelihood.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the style's signature moves (payoff-mix kill floor, dominant-failure-mode gate design, quasi-option read on C, triggered redeployment) perfectly; the non-routed v5 AI reached them only partially at REVIEW (blanket 15% floor, generic milestones, no quasi-option, descriptive redeployment). The routed m058 pass made all four first-class completed outputs, and the m007 ruin screen added worst-case survivability (max €7M Stage-1 loss vs €80M all-in commitment) and threshold stability the baseline left implicit.
signals.learning_signal: On staged-funding-option tasks the EV arithmetic is the floor, not the skill: the discriminating moves are payoff-mix-calibrated kill thresholds, decision-relevant gate design, quasi-option recognition, and triggered redeployment. A style pass that does not produce these outputs has not run.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the m058 staged-funding completion contract (information bought per stage, payoff-mix kill floor pre-committed before Stage 1, dominant-failure-mode gate design, quasi-option read, winners-first redeployment triggers) as a standing module on finance/strategy portfolio signatures; pair with the m007 ruin screen on high_stakes; probability floors may be a floor but never the primary kill rule.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the registry weakness - planning theater - at full fidelity: four elaborate futures with forces and signposts, the decision scheduled to the workshop calendar, the July 15 offer expired, 30% worse terms signed on August 28, and a monitoring framework gating nothing (2.4). The v6 route kept the trap style OUT of the top-3 and ran m089 optionality (sign-now keeps every real door open; delay closes the offer door permanently) + m020 pre-mortem + m023 opportunity cost with MANDATORY m003 inversion (7 ranked failure categories, un-mitigable residual, never/always reframing) and m007 ruin screen (one-shot: the expiry cannot be re-rolled; not-signing carries a certain 30% premium plus the uncovered-mandate tail; the contract IS the floor/Kelly bet) - the decision-sensitivity probe, tempo commit and closed-scope fast path compressed the loop to a 48-hour sign (4.9). The v5 AI reached the same verdict through framing alone (4.5); the v6 gates make it contract-forced.
signals.learning_signal: Scenario planning must be gated by decision-sensitivity before any future set is built: if a dominant need (inelastic winter demand, storage mandate, contract window longer than any plausible supply restoration) holds in every future, the exercise has ~zero decision value and must not sit on the critical path; a dated at-market offer is insurance, and the one-shot ruin check (expiry cannot be re-rolled) converts delay from 'prudence' into a certain ~30% loss. When scenario work is retained, bound it to 1-2 futures, run it in parallel off the critical path, and wire every signpost to a decision that exists AFTER the main action (storage-fill timing, hedge layers, crisis playbook) with threshold + owner; signposts with no gated action are theater, and the premium paid after the deadline is its price.
signals.suggested_improvement: Standing rule for deadline + guarantee signatures: (1) run the decision-sensitivity probe BEFORE any scenario build - enumerate 2-3 plausible futures and check whether the decision changes under each; if not, mark the decision scenario-insensitive and route to action via the closed-scope fast path; (2) hard expiry dates are first-class constraints - tempo mode commits at DO and the offer's one-shot status enters the ruin screen's floor computation; (3) guarantee goals always prepend the m003 inversion gate with >=6 ranked failure categories and the never/always reframing; (4) retained scenario work must run in parallel with a named owner and every signpost wired to an existing post-action decision; (5) log and defuse the 'foresight culture' pull explicitly in REVIEW - process-totalism is a priced delay, not a discipline.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline built the future set first-pass from two axes ranked by impact x uncertainty, discarded the implausible (conflict x open) quadrant, and operationalized every signpost (metric+threshold+cadence) in a lean trace (4.6); the non-routed v5 AI converged on the same 40/30/30 barbell and trigger table but recovered the off-axis F4 and the quadrant discard only inside its verification pass and left signposts without owners (4.3). The v6 routed dual pass (m059 scenario contract: 3-4 divergent futures each changing a decision-relevant quantity, signposts with metric+threshold+cadence+owner, robustness-across-futures decision, no single-prediction claim + m044 stakeholder pass) produced the architecture first-pass, attached owners to every signpost and trigger, and read the customers' dual-sourcing demands as early F2 signposts - evidence, not constraints (4.8). Residual baseline edge: trace leanness (efficiency 5 vs 4.5).
signals.learning_signal: For geopolitical capacity decisions, the future-set derivation is the product: rank driving forces by impact x uncertainty, discard internally incoherent quadrants rather than populate them, add an explicit off-axis force (technology/economics) so futures diverge in kind, and treat a future as incomplete until each signpost carries metric + threshold + cadence + NAMED OWNER and every threshold maps to a gated action ('a signpost with no action attached is furniture'). Route the scenario style first-class so the architecture is built in HOW, not recovered in verification; pair it with a stakeholder pass that reads market behavior (customers demanding dual-sourcing) as early signposts of the decoupling future. Assign no point probabilities; require the position to be acceptable in every future and reject concentrated bets with quantified reasons.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m059+m044 dual-route with m068 MECE synthesis for strategy/supply signatures; enforce the m059 completion contract as a packet gate: (a) 3-4 divergent futures each changing a decision-relevant quantity vs the others; (b) per future >=3 signposts with metric+threshold+cadence+owner; (c) a trigger table mapping every threshold to a named action BEFORE selection; (d) an explicit no-single-prediction statement; (e) a divergence check - any future that changes no decision-relevant quantity is cut. Add the stakeholder-evidence rule: stated requirements from powerful parties are market signals of the future set, to be monitored, not just satisfied.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline applied the composite mechanically (67.2 < 75 -> reject) and treated the candidate's verified, public, job-identical artifact — the open-source library Meridian's own production pipeline runs on, with 8 years of commit history including fixes to three Meridian-filed bugs — as 'narrative noise the base-rate filter exists to block' (2.6/5). The routed run holds and hardens the protective win (4.6 -> 4.8): the trap style is excluded at META (m060 out of top-3), the decision runs as a dual-route m018 steelman + m019 adversary on the deviation with m003/m007 gates — the deviation survives its own strongest rebuilt case (precedent erosion answered by an evidence-quality gate applied BEFORE the cutoff, < 5% bounded deviation class), the ruin screen prices both branches (90-day-review floor, no one-shot ruin), and the ceiling fallacy ('a rule that starves its own decisive evidence is a ceiling pretending to be a prior') is named as the failure the case was built to expose.
signals.learning_signal: The base-rate anchor is a prior for interpreting noisy signals, never a ceiling on decisive verified specific evidence: a composite cutoff built on contrived, tool-mismatched samples must be screened by an evidence-quality gate BEFORE it is applied — when verified, public, job-identical work product (the company's own production dependency, authored by the candidate) exists, it is the highest-fidelity work sample available and re-scores the composite, turning a mechanical reject into a documented, principled hire (0.50*95 + 0.30*74 + 0.10*50 + 0.10*60 = 80.7 >= 75); rigid-cutoff rejection is the style's documented weakness, and the protective route is to exclude the pure style on such signatures and gate the deviation's precedent risk, not to grant narrative exceptions.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the NEG trap-avoidance route (base-rate/hiring style out of top-3 on high_stakes + guarantee signatures) and pair every cutoff-application decision with m003 inversion (>= 6 ranked deviation-failure categories incl. precedent erosion and unverified-artifact re-scoring, residual named) and m007 ruin screen (distribution over both branches, floor/Kelly, probability provenance); install the evidence-quality gate as a standing clause before any composite cutoff — 'does any verified candidate evidence dominate the composite?' — with deviations logged and bounded (< 5% of pool); verify by recomputing the revised composite with the re-scored component and checking the deviation clause's evidence requirements (verifiability, job-identity, production dependency).
