signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI reached the same validity-weighted design (work sample 50% / structured 30% / references+experience as screens / unstructured 0%, threshold >= 70) but lost on efficiency and insight (4.1 vs 4.4) because it re-derived the base-rate ordering inside WHY instead of taking the org's supplied validity table as the ordering authority, and never stated the signature framings ('references and experience are screens, not drivers'; the interview illusion as the design target). The routed run installs the table-first move as the m060 first-class pass contract + P10 given-data-first + P8 closed-scope fast path (no re-derivation, stages compressed), adds the m018 steelman of the old process (the 'interviewer sees things numbers can't' defense dismantled by r = 0.21) and the m015 emergence scan (45% turnover as an emergent property of personality-weighted hiring at volume), and the insight pass ('the budget cap is the cheapest insurance'; 'the room lies') — every rubric point now matched, same decision, first-pass anchoring.
signals.learning_signal: A supplied base-rate validity table is the first move of a selection-process design, not a late-stage input: when the org publishes its own validation numbers, the ranking decision is already made — weight the composite by validity share, demote low-validity signals (references, years of experience) to pass/fail red-flag screens, give the unstructured interview 0% of the score, and make the override clause evidence-gated (documented superior specific evidence, e.g. authenticated job-identical artifacts) so the gut cannot re-enter through the exception path; the deliverable is then a falsifiable process hypothesis, re-validated on hire-outcome data.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m060/m009 pass contract on hiring and selection designs: (1) signals ranked by predictive validity from base rates (work samples > structured interviews > interviews > tests), (2) process designed around the top signals with weights justified by validity, (3) any candidate-specific adjustment justified against an evidence bar; pair with P10 given-data-first (supplied base rates are the ordering authority — never re-derive them in WHY) and P8 closed-scope fast path when costs/budget/validity are fully specified; verify by recomputing the composite, the per-applicant cost vs the $40 budget, and the validity uplift (0.50 vs 0.28) in dollar terms.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline misapplied the 7%/25-yr market rate to a necessity whose funds would sit at 0.4% idle in an earmarked reserve (phantom $35,300 'foregone') and chose repair; the non-routed v5 AI escaped via a one-off frame check in WHY. The routed run made the escape structural: the m070 evidence-weighted gate rejected the 7% 'alternative' (no brokerage, no contribution plan, no planned investment — an item with no counterparty fails the evidence gate), the m088 pre-commitment pass priced the 0% financing as lender-priced risk and bound the reserve to its purpose, the m018 steel-man defeated the strongest repair case, and P3 priced every branch including the repair best case. Decision matches the rubric: replace now, cash ($6,200 after the $300 discount); payback vs repair 3.9-5.2 yrs; 0%/12-mo as a bounded fallback. Residual shared gap: the 55-65% failure odds and $850-950 fuel savings are sourced estimates, not measured frequencies — banded, not exact.
signals.learning_signal: The discount-and-compare move has an applicability gate that must run BEFORE any discounting: (a) classify necessity vs discretionary want; (b) verify a real investment alternative exists (brokerage/contribution plan) — if the money would sit idle at ~0.4%, there is no alternative to discount against; (c) if all options consume capital, compounding cancels out of the comparison and the differentiator is payback and expected cost, not compounding. The evidence-weighted gate is the enforceable form of this rule: a 'foregone market return' on money that would never be invested is an unsupported item and must be dropped.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the P1 + evidence-gate as a standing pre-discount contract on personal-finance/necessary-capital signatures (a claimed investment alternative with no counterparty fails the gate); pair the m088 pre-commitment module on reserve-funded decisions (the financing offer is lender-priced risk — bind the repayment window, and define the reserve's purpose as necessity spending); keep the boundary rule as a packet line ('compounding <-> fungible wants with an actual investment alternative; payback <-> necessary capital') so the frame choice is auditable.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline re-priced the purchase in compounding units in one pass ($8,000 x 1.07^35 = 85,400 -> ~$3,400/yr for life at the 4% rule; the $1,500 sound subset -> ~$16,000, ~$640/yr), named the break-even, and won v5 on efficiency (5 vs 3) and insight (5 vs 3); the non-routed v5 AI computed the same math but re-derived discounting in WHY with extra scaffolding. The routed run moved the reframe into HOW as first-class passes (m028 framing-break + m039 barbell: 'the price is a $280/month subscription for life', every subset is its own compounding decision), compressed the stages via the P8 closed-scope fast path, and added what the human lacked: rate-band invariance (5-9% real -> $44k-$165k, decision invariant), >=6 ranked failure categories (m003, incl. lifestyle creep via the 'one-time' frame), the m007 ruin/floor screen (consuming the compounding base is the floor event; index floor dominates at every rate in the band), and the miserliness guard (utility priced, not dismissed). Residual shared gap: her true marginal utility of the trim is unmeasurable — it must be priced by her, but the price is now named.
signals.learning_signal: On spend-vs-compounded-alternative decisions with a real investment alternative, the first HOW move must be the re-pricing pass: amount x (1+r)^horizon with an explicit discount, converted to decision-relevant units (4% rule -> income/yr for life), a named break-even the enjoyment must clear, marginal per-component pricing, and every unpriced dollar defaulting to the investment. The reframe IS the decision, so it must run as a first-class pass in HOW — re-deriving standard discounting in diagnosis is the v5 efficiency loss, and pricing the enjoyment in the same units as the alternative (a subscription she would not buy) is the insight move.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m028+m039 dual-route on this signature (framing-break + barbell = the re-pricing contract) and make the P8 fast path the default when amount/rate/horizon are in-brief (converts the v5 efficiency loss into a compression win); add 'subscription-unit framing' and 'every subset is its own compounding decision' as standing packet lines; keep the band-invariance check so the verdict never rests on a single rate assumption; keep the utility-priced guard so the pass kills lifestyle creep without becoming miserly.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style failed by design — sign-invariant NPVs (+960M/+835M/+694M/+488M) computed then ignored, the unresolved 1.4%-vs-5.5% rate declared a binding gate, and the 1-in-1000 hospital-overwhelm tail declared decisive ('false security is worse than vulnerability'), producing a defer-and-monitor verdict. The v5 AI already won on the horizon-disjointness check; the routed v6 run hardens the win structurally: m001 rebuilt the decision from fundamentals (dominance, complementarity/real-option, flow-completion by ~2045, this-cycle-only budget), m018 steelmanned the 'false security' objection in its strongest form and answered it (messaging vs measured value; the measure as pre-commitment to the barrier), m019 priced the half-benefit and moral-hazard exposures, and the m003 inversion gate ranked 'long-horizon question gates near-term decision' as the #1 failure category — the two registered trap arguments are destroyed by horizon placement, not by authority.
signals.learning_signal: When a brief mixes long-horizon noise with a short-horizon decision at the same resolution, the horizon-disjointness check must run BEFORE any rate choice: identify which horizon contains the decision-relevant flows, compute NPV sign-invariance across the full defensible range, declare the disputed horizon out-of-scope with a scheduled review trigger in the packet, and steelman the strongest objection (here 'false security') in its strongest form — it is a messaging argument, answered by complementarity + pre-commitment, never a reason to withhold a sign-invariant complementary measure. The registered trap is the signature move applied to the wrong horizon: horizon separation is mandatory, but which horizon holds the decision's flows is the actual gate.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install horizon-disjointness as a mandatory gate (m001/m018/m003 combination) on any decision whose brief supplies adjacent long-horizon noise, and require the out-of-scope log + review trigger in every packet; keep the m019 red-team half-benefit pricing as the standard exposure check on benefit-led measures; on fully specified recommendation tasks with no deadline flag, use the closed-scope fast path (P8) so the verdict commits at DO without re-derivation — the v5 run tied efficiency at 4.0, the v6 run takes it at 4.5.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human opens with the horizon split and the irreversibility floor as first-class moves ('a stock that never comes back', 'three dates are three different cities') and never re-derives them; the v5 AI reached the same decision (A, +20.1B) and numbers but burned a WHY-stage hypothesis re-deriving that the rate war cannot happen (Efficiency 3 vs 5) and produced the irreversibility rule more mechanically (Insight 3 vs 4). The routed v6 run closes all three gaps: the m062 contract makes the 2030/2050/2100 split + dual-rate schedule (3% ordinary / 1.5% irreversibility floor) + breakeven sensitivity the first-class opening, the m050 safety-inversion pass prices the barrier's own failure modes (breach crest, deferred $900M reinforcement, financing spread, wetland valuation), the m007 ruin screen frames C as the ruin path and overdesign as cheap tail insurance, and the insight pass reproduces the human's signature reframe (I1: three different cities; I2: the rate debate is arithmetic theater).
signals.learning_signal: On intergenerational infrastructure decisions with an irreversible resource, the horizon split and the irreversibility rate floor must be the FIRST moves of the analysis — installed as a module contract, not re-derived: discount ordinary flows at the social rate and irreversible stocks on a declining-rate floor with the reason stated, evaluate the policy at 2030/2050/2100 with explicit cash flows, and demonstrate the breakeven rate across the defensible range so the discount-rate debate cannot stall the decision (the v5 efficiency gap was exactly the wasted re-derivation the contract removes). Pair the recommendation with the mandatory ruin screen (m007: outcome distribution, one-shot check, floor/Kelly, probability provenance, decline/restructure alternative) and the safety-inversion enumeration of the chosen plan's own failure modes (m050) — the routed gate structure converts the human's intuition into mandatory outputs.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m062 contract as the standing first-class pass on climate/infrastructure cases with irreversibility (horizon split -> dual-rate schedule -> breakeven -> tail mitigation), triggered by the finance/strategy + guarantee signature; the m003/m007 gates deliver the ruin and inversion coverage the human gets by intuition, so the rate question is closed by computation before any stage can enter it; retain the insight pass (S2) as the packet gate — it is what supplies the 'three different cities' reframe the human produces by narrative.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline fell into the registry's documented weakness - adversarial cynicism - advising acceptance of the 55% offer on power-imbalance grounds, never opening the 15-day objection clause, the 14 months of commercial use, or the SBPPA. The non-routed v5 AI won by legal-mechanism-first, effectively sidestepping the style; the routed run wins WHILE running the perspective family: the m019 pass attacked the attrition playbook itself (third-demand delay, discovery stalling, 48-hour tempo) and found the fee-shifting counter, the m021 dual pass inverted the tempo weapon (statutory demand as counter-deadline on a paper-only SJ record), and the m003 inversion gate ranked 'accept the 55% discount' as failure category #1 (near-certain x severe) before DO - the weakness is gate-checked, not avoided. Residual gap: the founder's cash runway during pendency is mitigated, not eliminated.
signals.learning_signal: When a routed style's registered weakness matches the situation (adversarial cynicism on power-imbalance framing), the guard is not to drop the style but to gate it: the m019 adversary pass must attack the cynical conclusion itself (what makes the delay weapon unprofitable? - fee-shifting statutes, estoppel, paper-only discovery), the m003 inversion must rank the power-based discount as the top failure category, and merits-before-power ordering (acceptance clause, lapsed objection window, commercial use, statutory fee-shifting) must precede leverage pricing. Delay-extraction offers are the signature move of the statute's exact target - check for mandatory interest and fee-shifting before pricing attrition.
signals.suggested_improvement: For guarantee/adversarial/deadline legal signatures, keep the m019+m021 dual-route (the router's confident=no ambiguity flag is correct) and m003 as the standing R4 gate; add an explicit 'adversarial-cynicism guard' completion-contract line to m063: before pricing power/attrition, order the merits - written acceptance, lapsed objection windows, commercial use/estoppel, statutory fee-shifting and interest - and state what the decision-maker does on an undisputed claim; retain tempo mode (P2) so the statutory demand commits at DO rather than after the 48-hour deadline.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline owned the full four-actor map first pass and the signature line 'the cap sets the floor, not the price', while the non-routed v5 AI lost 4.6-4.2 by reaching Heron's misaligned incentives late (REVIEW records the underweight) and anchoring the price to doctrine first. The routed run's m063 completion contract (each party + decision-maker: interests, constraints, precedents, likely ruling; leverage found; adversarial-cynicism guard) made the map a first-class HOW output: Heron's cap-vs-spillover misalignment and the covenant/precedent-driven price land first pass; the m007 ruin screen priced the one-shot covenant exposure and the cap as floor (log-utility: survival dominates trial EV), and the m019 adversary gate quantified per-vector exposure (launch-delay padding, precedent-spillover attack on 3 claims, Heron verdict preference, mediation stall) with baseline-risk comparison (doctrine-only $1.2-1.5M vs leverage price $1.7-2.1M). Residual shared gap: Heron's true appetite at the mediation table is not verifiable from stipulations.
signals.learning_signal: Legal dispute prediction (decide/estimate/predict + adversarial/deadline/high_stakes) is won by leverage, not doctrine: run the party + decision-maker map as a first-class pass (interests, constraints, precedents, likely ruling per actor - including funders and the judge's docket/ADR incentives), name the leverage source that floats the price above the legal EV (covenant deadlines, precedent exposure across parallel claims, renewal leverage), and gate the pass with a ruin screen on one-shot constraints (a verdict is not a settlement - price the covenant/ruin tail and the coverage floor) and an adversary pass that attacks padding claims and precedent spillover. The adversarial-cynicism guard must be stated: cynicism manufactures leverage; binding doctrine plus aligned self-interest is where real leverage lives.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m063 as the confident single-route first-class pass on legal-prediction signatures with the full completion contract (interests/constraints/precedents/likely ruling per party + decision-maker, leverage source named, cynicism guard stated); keep m007 (ruin screen: one-shot check, floor = cap, log-utility) and m019 (per-vector exposure, baseline-risk comparison) as standing R3 gates for high_stakes/adversarial legal signatures; add 'funder incentive alignment' as an explicit contract line - every legal actor with a capped stake (insurers, funders) has interests separable from the named party.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style performed framework shopping exactly as registered — consequentialist, deontological, virtue, and rights analyses converged on 'certify with mitigations,' laundering a decision made before the review existed (minutes predate the ERB, sales-drafted scope, no veto, coerced 7-day timeline, CEO email admitting the letter is for the milestone). The non-routed v5 AI already refused via a META suspicion pass, but that protection depended on the general loop's framing luck. The v6 routed run guarantees the protection structurally: the NEG signature (no goal match) scores m064 below the top-3, so no lens-review module runs — the router returned m021/m035/m094, confident=no → dual-route, and the m021 orient-step (decision pre-made, no authority), m035 robustness check (would the certification survive a second look — no), m094 critical reading (charter exclusions, CEO email), and the m007 ruin screen (one-shot irreversible letter) install the authority audit as the pass structure.
signals.learning_signal: The m064 registered weakness (framework shopping with no resolution algorithm) is neutralized at the routing layer: on review/certification signatures with no goal match, the lens module must stay out of the pass set and the structure-audit styles (m021 orient, m035 replication-under-scrutiny, m094 critical reading) must run first-class — the more polished the framework reasoning under a captured process, the more effective the laundering; refusal + documented escalation + an uncertified risk memo is the deliverable, with the refusal's contingency (board-amended charter with veto → condition-setting becomes correct) stated explicitly.
signals.suggested_improvement: Add a routing rule: any request containing 'certify/endorse/confirm' artifacts with a deadline and a scope defined by the interested party must trigger the authority audit (who asked, with what authority, can the answer change anything) as a mandatory pre-pass regardless of the routed top-3; route such signatures away from lens-review modules toward m021/m035/m094 with the m007 one-shot gate. This hardens the v5 NEG protection from framing luck to structure.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human anchored the ethical substance first — fairness as a claim on the ≈260k affected users (13.9%/11.2% vs 6.8%), dual-use as an identity question (appeal drafting is the mirror of denial drafting), resolved by a severity × population ordering with a maxi-min floor and precautionary gating. The non-routed v5 AI recovered the same staged-launch answer with a sharper procedure but instrumentalized both lenses into risk items and derived the affected-groups framing late (WHY/REVIEW), losing on depth and insight. The v6 routed run made m064 first-class with its completion contract (lenses applied with conflicts stated as trade-offs, resolution by ordering not framework pick, alignment and human-control checks) and added the R3 gates (m007 ruin screen, m019 adversary pass) plus a pre-committed mechanical verification (kill-switch threshold, CCO owner, public reporting); the adversary pass surfaced that the repurposing path is already half-built (pipeline + eval harness shared with Sentinel under NDA).
signals.learning_signal: On high_stakes/adversarial deployment decisions, routing m064 as a first-class pass with its completion contract converts the v5 late-derivation of ethical substance into mandatory first-pass outputs: affected groups named with numbers (fairness as a claim, not a monitored metric), the actor-shaping repurposability path named (dual-use as identity), conflicts stated as trade-offs between lenses, resolution by an explicit severity × population ordering with maxi-min floor and precautionary gating — never a framework pick — plus alignment (can the operator verify the deployed model) and human-control (HITL on high-severity, kill-switch, named owner) checks, with pre-committed mechanical verification so the resolution is checkable.
signals.suggested_improvement: Add the dual-use-pipeline probe to the m064 pass contract: before gating a transfer, enumerate what is already shared (data pipeline, eval harness, NDA) — a gate on an open door is a precondition, not a promise. Keep m007 + m019 paired on high_stakes/adversarial; keep the R4 falsifiable checkpoint (kill-switch criterion) as the standing mechanical verification on maximize signatures.

signals.human_model: Margin of Safety in Engineering Design
signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style applied the blanket stack (worst x 3, generic 0.85 knockdown -> 95 g strut + 18 g mount) to a data-rich benign-failure case, converting measured certainty into 48 g of dead weight that blocks the 140 g pod (-$4,500/yr) and costs 2.3% flight energy (~8.5 min/day airtime); the routed run's discriminating test on the record (P(load > 93 N) < 1e-9), evidence-weighted SWOT (over-design as the highest-evidence threat, pod as the highest-evidence opportunity), and m098 pre-registration (falsification contract) hold the win with the economic framing as a first-class output.
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose/estimate signatures with measured data, the router correctly routes AWAY from the blanket-derating style to evidence-calibrated styles (m031/m070/m098) - routing, not style suppression, holds the protective split; margin must be proportional to measured uncertainty, and over-design must be priced in the system's own currency (payload allowance, $/yr, energy).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m031+m070 dual-route with m098 synthesis on data-rich benign-failure signatures; add the over-design cost check (weight/complexity priced) as a standing P3 branch-completeness item whenever a mass/cost constraint binds, even when m065/m038 is not routed.

signals.human_model: Margin of Safety in Engineering Design
signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the full derating stack in one disciplined first pass and made the end-of-life event the acceptance test (load 1,191 N; A MS -0.10 fail; B MS +0.35 pass); the routed run now matches that discipline first-class (m065 derating in synthesis context) and adds an 8-category inversion gate with un-mitigable residual, a ruin screen with probability provenance (one-shot class: a plaza drop is not amortized over flights), and a steelman pass showing the junior FS-5 draft gates on a different event (static/nominal vs end-of-life/minimum) - closing v5's gaps (efficiency: D-branch exploration; depth: sensitivity ranking only at REVIEW) at zero cost via the P8 closed-scope fast path.
signals.learning_signal: On guarantee/high_stakes engineering signatures, routing the adversarial pair (m018+m019) with m065 derating as synthesis context plus standing m003/m007 gates reproduces the pure style's event-first discipline while adding uncertainty provenance, one-shot/ruin protection, and branch pricing the baseline lacks.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m018+m019 dual-route with m065 synthesis on guarantee signatures (R1/R2); keep m003 inversion and m007 ruin screen as standing R3/R4 gates on high_stakes design; hold the P8 fast path so the derating stack completes in one pass.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline's informative failure — it designed the discriminating bundle, mapped latencies, then withheld antibiotics for the 30-min CT 'fast gate' even though the CT cannot classify the source in early sepsis (small collections missed), priced the 7-8%/h antibiotic-delay mortality nowhere, and de-framed the one-time-only pre-abx culture timing as 'confirmatory' (overall 2.6); the routed dual-route run (m001 fundamentals + m018 steel-manning + m019 adversary with m003 inversion gate, tempo commit at DO) makes experiment-latency-vs-decision-horizon the binding constraint, steel-mans and structurally defeats the 'hold', prices failure vectors with baseline-risk comparison (delay 7-8%/h vs overtreatment ~1-3%), and re-frames the empiric bundle + pre-abx cultures as the discriminating experiment run in parallel — action IS the experiment; the v5 AI's already-correct plan (4.5) also gains efficiency 3.0 -> 5.0 via tempo commit, overall 4.8.
signals.learning_signal: On decide/diagnose signatures with c:deadline where every discriminating test's time-to-result exceeds the decision horizon, the routed passes must invert the method: act robustly across the full hypothesis set now (cultures before abx, broad-spectrum <= 1 h, fluids/vasopressors, lactate at 2 h), bind the parallel diagnostics to a pre-committed outcome->action map (growth -> narrow / source control; double-negative -> re-imagine non-infectious mimics), and treat the fastest partial discriminator as the most dangerous wait — it reports first, looks like evidence, and cannot decide the question; deferral is itself the decision, and wait-for-the-discriminator paralysis is the failure mode every gate here exists to block.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m001+m018+m019 dual-route with the m003 inversion gate on latency-bound medical deadlines; add a standing completion-contract line — 'if the fastest discriminator's latency exceeds the decision horizon, it is a parallel diagnostic, never a gate'; keep the quantified asymmetry (delay 7-8%/h vs overtreatment ~1-3%) and the cultures-before-abx hard sequence as packet requirements.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline's winning moves — hold >= 4 hypotheses, spot the week-37 collinearity (zero-overlap -> retrospective regression is structurally powerless), manufacture the missing cells (2x2 factorial, 30/arm, lot-blocked), map every outcome to elimination, name both traps (single-hypothesis fixation on the visible supplier change; uncontrolled whole-population rollback) — are now mandatory completion-contract outputs of the routed first-class pass, produced up front in HOW instead of recovered via search; the v5 non-routed AI reached the identical design but only after exploring and rejecting the retrospective/rollback/lab alternatives (efficiency 3.0) and drew the interaction consequence late (depth 4.0), losing 4.2 vs 4.6; the routed run scores the pass's depth/efficiency gains, adds an m003 inversion gate (8 ranked failure categories for the decision protocol, un-mitigable residual, never/always reframing) and a tempo-bound 2-week interim read under the 6-week deadline, and wins narrowly (4.9 vs 4.6).
signals.learning_signal: On estimate/guarantee/maximize signatures with c:deadline and a perfectly confounded production history (two changes co-shipped, zero off-diagonal cells), the competing-hypotheses pass must treat 'manufacture the missing cells' as the only decisive move — retrospective analysis cannot attribute under collinearity, and 'revert the visible change and watch' is a pseudo-experiment with no counterfactual arm; the completion contract must ship the full outcome->inference map (marginals / additive / interaction-only / all-elevated -> ambient branch with second-stage lot-split + route cross-check) and the trap-naming guard, because salience is inverse evidence: the visible event is the least trustworthy suspect. Cost asymmetry (experiment ~$3.1k vs recall $4-6M) makes the experiment negative-cost against the liability and should be a standing packet line.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m066 single-route (confident=yes) with the m003 inversion gate on collinear-cause signatures; add trap-naming (salient-fixation + uncontrolled rollback) and the full outcome-map to the m066/m031 completion contract; keep the 2-week interim read as the tempo default under a 6-week deadline and the experiment-vs-liability cost framing as a packet line.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline's informative failure — textbook idealized derivation (p ~= 1/N ~= 1e-7, EV(vote) = p*b - c ~= -$10, turnout ~= 0, 'democracy is irrational and collapses') with zero empirical check (idealization drift, no empirical check; overall 3.4); the routed protective run (m014 bottleneck = misspecified utility function, m018 steel-manned abstention rebuilt strongest and structurally defeated, m019 adversary vectors with quantified exposure — the ~60-point falsification and the unconsulted-stakeholder list — plus the m067 drift-guard/empirical-check contract) reaches the v5 AI's already-correct repair (4.9) as first-class contract outputs: measured turnout base rates (US 2020 ~= 66.8%, non-compulsory DK/SE ~= 84%), the deleted expressive/duty/social terms evidenced by field experiments (+8 pts social-pressure mailers), the retained free-rider/collective-action core, the small-N flip (N = 20: p*b ~= $50 > c ~= $10), and the valid-yet-false framing (a model can be internally valid and world-false).
signals.learning_signal: On estimate/maximize/predict signatures where the scenario invites a model-as-world conclusion, the m067 pass's empirical-check note must be a HARD completion-contract line: after any idealized derivation, ask what the measurement says and record the divergence (here ~60 points of turnout, ~5 orders of magnitude in EV) — a pass without the measured figure has not run. The routed protective pairings (bottleneck: the missing utility terms are the binding constraint; steel-manning: defeat the abstention claim structurally, not stylistically; adversary: enumerate vectors incl. given-numbers-as-reference-class) are the correct companions because the failure mode is not arithmetic but the deleted terms; the paradox itself is the signature of the drift, and the repair is scope: retain the collective-action core, replace the conclusion.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m014/m018/m019 dual-route with the m067 drift-guard + empirical-check contract on model-as-world invitations; add a standing packet line — 'is this conclusion about the model or about the world?' with the cited falsifier (here: measured turnout 50-90%); keep the small-N scope check as the validation that the logic is scope-bound, not wrong.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline's winning moves — build the idealized world (uniform u, constant v, point swimmer), run it symbolically (T_B = 2Lv/(v^2-u^2), T_C = 2L/sqrt(v^2-u^2)), kill the cancellation intuition via reciprocal convexity, extract single-trip blindness, the second-order differential probe, and the Michelson-Morley echo — are now mandatory completion-contract outputs of the routed first-class passes (m031 hypothesis-test-update with u->0/u->v limit probes; m040 leverage point = the convex reciprocal structure whose error flips the whole ranking; m015 composition error: aggregate round-trip time is not leg-wise additive) plus the m067 drift-guard/empirical-check-note line; the v5 non-routed AI already matched the baseline (4.8 vs 4.5) and the routed run holds that, adds the blind-at-first-order-by-construction framing and the Jensen/E[1/x] naming, and P8's closed-scope fast path (fully specified symbolic problem) closes most of the v5 efficiency gap (E 4.0 -> 4.5); the win remains marginal because the human baseline is one clean pass and matches on goal and insight.
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose signatures with a fully specified idealized symbolic problem, closed-scope fast path is the right default: name the structure (convex reciprocal aggregate over the speed pair) before the arithmetic; run the passes against it (hypothesis->falsify->update with limit probes; leverage point = the single assumption whose micro-error flips the ranking; emergence = the forbidden additive decomposition); and complete the m067 pass with its two contract lines — the idealization-drift guard (what the idealization hides) and the empirical-check note (no measurement claim; history cited as history, not data). The second-order structure (effect enters at order (u/v)^2) and the differential-probe principle are the packet's load-bearing insight, and 'single-trip blindness is first-order blindness by construction' should be a standing contract line.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m031/m040/m015 dual-route with the m067 pass on g:diagnose,maximize idealized-symbolic signatures; make P8 closed-scope the standing default for fully specified symbolic problems (v5 E=4.0 -> v6 4.5); add 'first-order blindness by construction' and the Jensen-type refutation to the m067 pass's completion contract.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style's registered weaknesses (tree too rigid, premature pruning) operated exactly as documented — the baseline built the tree from the supplied branches, force-fit the 18pt unexplained residual to the Q3 rebates restatement ('measurement noise'), pruned the renegotiated top-account program as immaterial-to-averages (8% of category revenue), and recommended freight/COGS cost-cutting, attacking the ~1pt explained branch while the verified root cause sat in the packet. The non-routed v5 AI already won via residual-as-completeness-alarm; the v6 routed run made that win structural: the P1 provenance audit flagged the finance note as an interested-party framing and falsified it by construction (a timing restatement nets to ~0 P&L and cannot be a 12-month leak), the residual gate (>10% of the change forces a missing-branch hunt before pruning) fired before the m044 first-class pass concluded, the m011 loop scan surfaced the auto-extension reinforcing loop, and the mandatory m019 adversary pass priced the averages-mask-bimodality and 'actionable-branch' vectors with quantified exposure (18 of 19pts misattributed).
signals.learning_signal: The tree is a hypothesis about the structure of the problem, not the problem itself: when branch attribution does not sum to the observed change, the tree is incomplete, not the data noisy. On diagnosis signatures with an open residual, run the reconciliation BEFORE any prioritization or pruning — residual > ~10% of the change forces a missing-branch hunt and account/product-level disaggregation (averages mask bimodal distributions); verify any 'one-time/noise' explanation against its construction (an accounting timing item cannot be a 12-month margin leak) and against who benefits from the framing (P1 interested-party audit); pair the residual gate with a stakeholder pass (who owns the missing line, who priced the deal) and an adversary pass on adversarial contexts — the pure style's pruning instinct is exactly the vector that converts the packet's decoy into the wrong recommendation.
signals.suggested_improvement: Stand up the residual-reconciliation + interested-party pair as mandatory on adversarial diagnosis signatures (this route: m044 first-class, m011/m070 context, m019 gate): (a) after attribution, compute the open residual explicitly; (b) residual > ~10% of the change -> missing-branch hunt + disaggregation before prioritization/pruning; (c) falsify 'noise' explanations by construction and provenance (who benefits); (d) let the stakeholder pass surface the missing line (terms/programs nobody owns on the P&L); (e) log the residual's verified disposition in the packet so the trap can never be re-introduced by a single-route rerun.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure MECE baseline and the non-routed v5 AI reached the same destination (promos −2.2 / mix −1.6 / freight −1.1 / COGS −0.8 / returns −0.7 / fees −0.6 = −7.0; ranking by impact x controllability x testability; 8-week matched-product promo hold-out as H1), but the baseline opened with the margin identity and built the MECE tree first-pass with mix as its own branch, while the v5 AI rebuilt the tree across two WHY passes and self-corrected a promo x mix double-count (−2.6/−1.2) only because the sum-to-−7.0 check caught it. The v6 routed run executed the identity-first MECE tree as the m068 completion contract in a single first-class pass — no re-walk, no double-count — and added P1 provenance (no anchors; CFO ask is a prior, not evidence), P3 failure branches (hold-out falsified -> freight-first fallback), and two S2 insights the baseline lacks (residual-as-tree-error; promo x mix causal entanglement requiring mix-constant attribution AND measurement).
signals.learning_signal: On KPI-attribution signatures (estimate/maximize/predict with a defining identity and complete data), routing the MECE module first-class with its completion contract converts a recovered answer into a one-pass answer: emit the defining identity as the frame (Margin = Revenue − COGS − Freight − Returns − Fees; Revenue = Price x Volume x Mix), build the tree MECE from it with mix as its own branch (the classic miss), attribute every branch holding the others constant (no double-count), require sum-of-branches = observed change before leaving WHY (open residual triggers the missing-branch hunt, not noise-logging), prioritize by expected impact x controllability x testability rather than size, state H1 falsifiably with a test design and success metric, and apply a premature-pruning guard (a large-but-structural branch is held until tested, never discarded).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m068 contract's tree-first discipline with the close-the-arithmetic gate as the completeness check (promo depth attributed with mix held constant); add the promo x mix entanglement flag (attribute AND measure mix-constant) as a standing S2 insight on retail/commerce attribution books; retain P3 failure-branch pricing (falsified hold-out -> next-branch sequence) and the premature-pruning guard as mandatory contract items so a data-complete attribution problem can never degrade into a multi-pass reconstruction.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style computed the split (2% -> 72%, 12% -> 90%, 88% -> 10%) and pounced on the 72% as an action map, dismissing the four verified counters as survivorship and soft currency. The v6 routed run kept the concentration-act module out of the pass set (router: m044, m070, m075; confident=no -> dual-route) and the stakeholder + evidence-ledger passes forced the four verified facts to be ordering authority, so the 72% was read as an output snapshot; the decisive insight — the top 18 has a 39% (7-of-18) tail-origin renewal rate — landed via the pass structure, not the general route's luck.
signals.learning_signal: On revenue books with a concentration split plus verified feed-the-top facts, the Pareto module's registered weakness (tail neglect) is exactly the trap the router's NEG protection exists to avoid; the temporal collapse question (where did the vital few come from, does the tail feed the top) is now guaranteed by the m044/m070 pass structure (renewal as a stakeholder fact, claims graded against the closed ledger) rather than left to the general loop.
signals.suggested_improvement: Confirm the route (m069 out of top-3 when concentration splits co-occur with verified tail-feeds-top facts); add the renewal-rate framing (tail-origin share of the vital few) as a standing question in the m044 pass on revenue signatures; keep the R4 falsifiable checkpoint (quarterly tail-origin converts metric) as the standing check the analysis was missing.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the pure move in one pass (sort -> exact 20/80 claim -> collapse test -> act-first -> tail monitoring), while the non-routed v5 AI recovered the identical plan but re-walked the cumulative table inside WHY and reached the collapse-test framing late, losing on depth, efficiency and insight. The v6 routed pass made m069 first-class (split from data, 20/80 claim stated exactly, collapse test with coverage + temporal arms) and paired it with the m007 ruin gate (high_stakes), plus a provenance flag: the brief's tail figure (~177, 14%) does not reconcile with the stated counts (217, 17.5%).
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose/estimate signatures with a fully checkable count table, routing m069 as a first-class pass with its completion contract is what converts a recovered answer into a one-pass answer; the temporal collapse arm (does the tail feed the top — here NO, categories mutually exclusive) is the validity license separating action-map splits from snapshot splits, and the ±5% sampled coverages turn the ruin gate into a floor computation rather than theater.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m069 first-class on fully-specified count tables (P8 path); make the temporal collapse arm a standing part of the module contract on every run, not just revenue/cohort books; keep m007 paired on high_stakes; add given-counts reconciliation (input arithmetic check against the brief's stated aggregates) to the P1 provenance audit.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style executed correctly and produced its registered failure — every grade B/C with genuinely unanchored confidence (class-specific swap evidence is n = 1; any B–D grade defensible), a table with no verdict, and an epilogue conceding 'the table cannot carry this decision.' The non-routed v5 AI already swapped instruments (EV restore time, parallel-start); the v6 routed run makes that swap guaranteed: dual-route m018 (steel-manning — forces the case that B is NOT obviously wrong, so the EV must be explicit) + m019 (adversary — quantified ETA/fine vectors, baseline risk), with the m007 ruin screen (full distribution, one-shot check, floor = 4h hospital protocol, probability provenance, decline/restructure = the hybrid) and m003 inversion (guarantee-goal gate) as mandatory outputs. The m070 synthesis context's true-but-irrelevant filter names the hospital line as a trigger binding both options, not a differentiator.
signals.learning_signal: When every SWOT grade lands moderate and unanchored, the checklist is substituting for analysis and the graded table contains no verdict by construction — the tell is all-B/C with defensible alternative grades. The decision-relevant quantity is outside the 2x2: swap instruments to the governing quantitative model (here expected restore time: EV(A) = 0.85·4.5 + 0.15·10 ≈ 5.3h vs EV(B) = 0.80·7 + 0.20·10 ≈ 7.6h, tails against the binding lines — B's 20% ≥ 8h tail vs the $150k fine; the 4h hospital floor binds both) and emit a decision rule with a cancelable parallel path and mandated trigger lines. Steel-manning the anti-verdict first is what forces the EV to be explicit rather than assumed; sensitivity on the unanchored input (A wins EV even at success 0.75) makes the verdict independent of the subjective grade.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m007 ruin gate on high_stakes dispatch signatures (distribution + provenance + floor + decline/restructure are what a checklist-style instrument cannot produce) and keep the m018/m019 dual-route when a timing decision co-occurs with unanchored reliability: steel-man the anti-verdict before computing EVs, attack with quantified vectors, then synthesize. Add the m070 context's true-but-irrelevant filter as a standing rule: constraint lines that bind every option (hospital 4h) are triggers, not differentiators, and must not be filed as a deciding threat.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the pure move flawlessly in one pass (ledger-first, all six grades correct, C/D items dropped, pillars-collapse insight, ranked stack S2 > T1 > O2, residual named), and the non-routed v5 AI recovered the same reversal only by re-deriving the evidence-grading discipline inside WHY — losing on efficiency, depth and insight. The v6 routed pass made evidence-weighting first-class with its completion contract (every item graded with a ledger cite, unsupported dropped, true-but-irrelevant filter), ran the P1 provenance audit on the demand memo (interested-party source — its author benefits from expansion), and the m019 adversary + m003 inversion gates added quantified exposure (Kessler +25% reps / 2 accounts won / <2% incumbent conversion; fuel ≈ 1.3 pts of margin ≈ 14% of EBITDA) and the inverted collapse test — the conclusion (defend + validate; study ≤ $250k = 3% of deferred capex) is unchanged but now gate-guaranteed.
signals.learning_signal: On closed-ledger strategy reviews, evidence-weighting is the entire answer and must run as the first move with its completion contract: grade every SWOT item S/A/B/C/D against a cited ledger fact, drop C/D items from decision relevance (including true-but-irrelevant items — statements that are true but carry no decision weight, e.g. the e-commerce gap as a roadmap item), test the proposal's load-bearing pillars by grade, and re-derive the conclusion from the surviving A/B stack ranked by evidence strength with one action per item and the top threat quantified (fuel ≈ 1.3 pts). Pair the pass with interested-party provenance (the demand memo's author benefits from expansion) and an evidence-purchase framing: the ≤ $250k study at 3% of the deferred capex is the real option, and the revisit is date-stamped and data-gated.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m070 first-class on strategy-review signatures with a closed evidence ledger, and add to its contract: (a) ledger-first ordering at WHAT/WHY entry (P10 given-data-first — the grading is the first move, never re-derived inside WHY); (b) an explicit true-but-irrelevant filter per quadrant; (c) a pillars-by-grade test naming which load-bearing premises are the weakest-graded items; (d) interested-party provenance of each item's source (who benefits) folded into the P1 audit; (e) close with a dated evidence-purchase plan so the revisit is data-gated.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline ran a competent static five-force pass that answered 'is the box industry profitable on average?' with the correct no — the right answer to the wrong question ('can this firm win here?') — and set the firm's own capabilities aside as 'outside this frame'. The routed v6 run ran the static pass honestly first (m070's evidence-graded read named 'no-entry on averages' on the record), then segmented the served market (DTC tail ~40% by count vs the giant-auction segment), rewrote >=2 forces with firm evidence (buyer power down via SDK switching costs with the anchors as the measured sign; rivalry down in the custom segment via the -30% cost edge, 48h turnaround and imitation lag; supplier pass-through absorbed by the cost advantage), dated the advantage (patent/imitation clock, 5-year payback inside it), and made entry pilot-gated. The non-routed v5 run also won this case but by evading the style family; v6 wins while running the routed passes (m044 segmentation, m064 accountability, m070 evidence-grading) — the durable skill. Residual gap: switching-cost durability is untested until the anchor pilot completes.
signals.learning_signal: When industry averages and firm-specific moves diverge, static structure answers 'is the industry profitable on average?' — the wrong question for 'can this firm win here?': run the honest static pass and NAME its verdict (never skip it), then segment the served market (average != served: fragmented tail vs auction segment), update >=2 forces with the firm's assets and evidence (switching costs, cost/differentiation edge + imitation lag, pass-through absorption), and date the advantage — the decay clock converts 'bad structure' from a veto into a timing constraint, and 'return capital' is not automatically the safe branch when the advantage decays with time regardless. Proposer capability claims are interested-party data until a measurement exists: gate the commitment on the pilot (falsifiable checkpoint), and treat signed anchors as the measurement instrument, not the claim.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m044+m064 dual-route for decide/estimate/maximize + deadline signatures (the router's confident=no ambiguity flag is correct) and m070 as synthesis context; make 'static verdict named, then segmented' a mandatory two-beat of the m070 context pass (evidence-grade the industry average BEFORE any firm-level update so the no-entry verdict is on the record); retain R4's falsifiable checkpoint (anchor pilot) and P2 tempo mode (commit at DO, cost-of-delay = the patent clock) on deadline; extend m071's completion contract with the segmentation/force-rewrite two-beat and the firm-heterogeneity note so the structural module itself carries the static-snapshot caveat it currently lacks.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline decides in one disciplined structural pass (force-by-force evidence, aggregate verdict below the 12% hurdle, idle-line bait rejected, single favorable force shown insufficient with the in-sourcing-as-buyer-power cancellation). The routed v6 run (m044 + m070 first-class, m071 as synthesis spine) reached the same verdict with the favorable-datum cancellation and the idle-line anchor kill now first-class outputs (v5's near-B single-datum wedge and REVIEW recovery are gone: P1 provenance kills the ops-team 'marginal cost' framing at WHY, m070 grades 'no close substitutes' as cancelled relief, and P3 prices the entry-anyway branch), but the five-force enumeration still arrives diluted through SWOT items and synthesis context because the router placed m071 third (context), not top-2 — the pure structural enumeration, the module's defining discipline, never ran as its own first-class pass. Residual shared gap: auction-clearing margins are unmeasured; the verdict band is +/-2-3 pts around the hurdle.
signals.learning_signal: On industry-structure entry decisions (decide/estimate, supply/strategy domains, no context flags), the structural question must precede firm-level facts: before any alternative generation, enumerate all five forces (rivalry, entry, substitutes, supplier/buyer power) each with scenario evidence and a profitability implication versus the hurdle, apply the single-favorable-force rule (one favorable force cannot carry the aggregate — and check it is not buyer power in costume: substitution relief cancelled by the buyers' in-sourcing option), and treat the entrant's own capacity as a competitive move that feeds back into prices. Firm-level facts (an idle line, internal utilization motives) are admissible only after the structure is priced, and proposer framings ('incremental volume at marginal cost') are interested-party anchors to provenance-audit, not data.
signals.suggested_improvement: Tighten the router so industry-structure signatures (supply/strategy + decide/estimate, no context flags) route the structural module top-2 (first-class pass, not synthesis context): add m071's completion contract to section II.2.9 (five forces enumerated with evidence + profitability implication + static-snapshot caveat/force dynamics + firm-heterogeneity note, and 'single favorable force insufficient + disguise check' as a mandatory packet line on any structural verdict); keep P1 provenance audit (interested-party anchor kill) and P8 fast path on fully specified advisory decisions.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline's pure chain decomposition was descriptively flawless (23.7%/21.1%/44.7%; bundle ≈ $0.9M/yr) but treated the chain boundary as fixed: the retailer's 21.1% share was a 'structural given', the acquisition 'outside our chain → monitor', and the closing 6-month window (60% rival-closure) never entered the decision. The routed dual-route (m011 systems scan + m044 stakeholder + m020 ranked pre-mortem + m019 adversary + tempo mode) classified the share as a transferable rent on a bypassable link, priced each actor's moves — including that renegotiation (c) gives back shelf and strengthens the private-label loop — scenario'd the rival probability (40/60/80), and committed the $12M bid at DO.
signals.learning_signal: The value chain is a snapshot whose boundary is itself the decision variable: cells that are transferable rents (the retail link) are misread by descriptive decomposition as fixed cost, and a closing window on a structural move outranks in-chain optimization. A chain pass without a boundary question and a window scan can be perfectly accurate and produce the wrong decision — descriptive accuracy and decision relevance are decoupled.
signals.suggested_improvement: Upgrade the m072 chain-boundary note to a boundary QUESTION on decide/strategy signatures (which cells are cost vs rent vs bypassable, and what would redraw the chain?), pair chain tasks with the m011 systems scan whenever a channel/structural-shift context appears (falsifiable observable on the shift), and apply tempo mode (P2) so a closing window commits at DO with a ranked pre-mortem instead of monitoring.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline already owns the full two-pass chain discipline (concentration math, premium mapping to heat treatment + inspection, boundary discipline, mitigations) — the routed v6 AI now matches it by contract, where the non-routed v5 run lost: v5 inferred rather than derived that tolerance lives in heat treatment + inspection, seriously weighed offshoring the tolerance cells (Alternative B, $5.6M/yr), and never quantified the premium risk. The routed pass makes the chain contract (decompose activity chain, locate value/cost concentration, name differentiation sources, chain-boundary note with 'what not to move') mandatory, and the ruin screen converts the boundary rule into arithmetic: premium loss = −$8M/yr floor vs +$4.8M/yr upside → breakeven drift probability 37.5%.
signals.learning_signal: Value-chain tasks are two-pass operations — cost pass (concentration %: machining 32.3%, top-2 61.5%) and value pass (premium test per cell: which activities create the price premium and what happens to price if they move). The winning lever is the cost-concentrated commodity cell, and boundary discipline is enforced by an asymmetric floor (downside >> upside), not by intuition; concentration alone is not a lever — lever = cost share x premium sensitivity.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the m072 completion contract (chain decomposition + value/cost concentration + differentiation sources + chain-boundary note) as a standing first-class pass on supply/finance chain signatures, paired with the m007 ruin screen so the 'do not move' cells are anchored by quantified floor-vs-upside (breakeven threshold); every candidate touching a premium-creating cell must carry a premium-re-verification line before selection.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline produced the correct equilibrium on an axiom (utility = money, atomized, one-shot; p = 1) and approved the epsilon-offer, treating the 41% pilot walk-off as noise — the style's registered weakness (payoff assumptions fragile) operating as designed. The routed run treated the model's prediction as a claim, audited provenance (p = 1 is an axiom with zero provenance; p ~ 0.6 is measured from the same company's pilot at a smaller cut), priced the walk-off tail (EV 1.1 vs 2.13, break-even p >= 0.85), and — new vs the v5 run — named the mechanism via the m084 synthesis context: the 4,200-member chat (2.2x the fleet) converts the 1,900-player one-shot into a repeated collective-action game, so the model solves the wrong game form.
signals.learning_signal: An equilibrium prediction that rests on utility = money + atomized + one-shot is a bound, not a forecast: when the case's own verified field data contradicts it, the field acceptance probability is the decision-relevant quantity, and the fragility must be diagnosed at the game-form level (coordination institutions, repeated vs one-shot) before any EV is computed — pure play alone yields the confident wrong recommendation.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m019 + m070 dual-route with m007 + m019 gates on adversarial/high_stakes/one_shot signatures; add a standing 'wrong-game-form diagnosis' check to the m073 module (coordination institutions, reputation channels, repeated-vs-one-shot, who-benefits provenance on the model champion); the 4,200-chat > 2.2x-fleet atomization falsifier is a reusable observable for wage/gig-economy scenarios.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure human baseline executed the game-form-first pass in one clean sweep with the sunkness check landing as the signature insight (it is L's inability to resell, not the technology, that deters); the non-routed v5 AI reached the game form late and burned a pass screening a data-less partnership alternative. The routed v6 run installed the game form as the first move (structure-first scan + m073 completion contract: players/strategies/payoffs -> equilibrium -> commitment -> payoff-assumption fragility), priced the break-even on the +4 effect (e > 3, margin 1), and added the never-used insight and the boundary-niche point via the m019 gate and insight pass.
signals.learning_signal: On closed-payoff commitment cases the game form is the first move and the sunkness/observability (binding-property) test is a mandatory contract output, not a REVIEW-stage afterthought; dual-route with an evidence-weighting pass adds robustness at zero depth cost, and the closed-scope fast path eliminates data-less alternative screening that a non-routed run wastes effort on.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install m073's completion contract as a standing module for strategy/finance + decide/maximize + adversarial signatures: require players-strategies-payoffs enumeration, base-game backward induction with non-credible-threat flag, commitment re-solve, binding-property counterfactual (resellable variant), and payoff-assumption fragility notes; keep the m019 adversary gate on adversarial signatures; keep P8 fast path for closed verified inputs.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline ran a correct no-deviation audit, hit the 2-element equilibrium set {(X,X),(Y,Y)}, declared 'indeterminate — selection is outside the model', and when pressed picked payoff-dominant (X,X) by fiat with no mechanism — exactly the mismatch trap (NewGrid following bare 'both adopt X' advice lands on 2-3). The v5 AI already won this (4.7) by treating the equilibrium set as the input; the v6 routed run reproduced that win by mechanism instead of emergence: the G1 dual-route ran m044 (stakeholder pass: VoltNet's 340-charger base is focal → it will play Y; NewGrid's risk-dominance threshold 6/13 ≈ 0.46 unmet → default (Y,Y) = (8,8)) and m075 (satisficing: aspiration bar set first, (Y,Y) clears it, conversion to (X,X) only while subsidy < +4 $M surplus), with m088's commitment-device lens turning the recommendation into a mechanism (mandate + subsidy, not advice), and the trap style (no-deviation equilibrium detector) was routed out of top-3 (router NEG property 92.5%). Residual gap: the subsidy cost is bounded (< 4) but not measured, and NewGrid's actual beliefs are unobservable — the 6/13 threshold is an indifference point, not a forecast.
signals.learning_signal: When the deviation audit returns multiple equilibria, stability says nothing about which equilibrium is reached: the routed style set must include selection instruments (stakeholder/focal-fact pass to predict the default, satisficing pass to set the acceptance bar and price the conversion lever, commitment-device lens to make the recommendation a mechanism), and the equilibrium detector should not be routed at all on coordination signatures — its registered weakness (multiple equilibria + coordination blindness) is exactly the case's trap.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the G1 dual-route (m044 + m075, m088 as context) on decide signatures whose structure-first scan names a multi-equilibrium coordination game; add a standing 'equilibrium-selection' checklist to the packet when ≥2 cells pass the deviation audit: enumerate the set, compute risk-dominance thresholds, scan for focal facts, price the commitment lever against the surplus, emit an explicit unilateral-move trap warning; route the no-deviation module away from coordination signatures unless paired with a selection pass.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline was near-gold (matrix first, deviation audit on the pact, +2.4 both, dominance to unique (C,C) = (3.9,3.9), enforcement P >= 2.4, antitrust flag, trap cell 3.0) — the v5 AI matched the verdict but lost 3.0 efficiency by formalizing game structure in WHY before applying the same test. The v6 routed run closed that gap by contract: the m074 pass ran matrix + deviation audit as the opening move of HOW (the v5 lesson 'write the payoff matrix immediately; test the proposed plan cell before discussing merits' installed as the module's completion contract), and the R3 gates added content instead of scaffolding — the m007 ruin screen proved Cheat beats Hold over the ENTIRE belief range (2.4 - 1.5p > 0 for all p in [0,1], so no belief justifies holding), and the m019 adversary pass quantified the broker's incentive (the association profits from ratification, not fulfillment) and the trap-cell exposure (0.9/quarter vs status quo). Residual gap: enforcement legality and detection lag stay non-arithmetic (antitrust review, not computation).
signals.learning_signal: On strategic-interaction briefs with a closed verified payoff table, the deviation audit IS the analysis: the routed module must emit matrix → no-deviation test on the proposed plan (arithmetic shown) → dominance/unique-equilibrium prediction → decision (reject or quantify the commitment that makes deviation unprofitable) in one first-class pass — never precede it with game-structure formalization; the protective gates then pay for themselves only if they add new checkable content (belief-range dominance, interested-party exposure), never restated equilibrium findings.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m074 on decide/guarantee signatures with adversarial/high_stakes context and the m003+m007+m019 gate stack; hard-code the m074 completion contract (unilateral-deviation test on the proposed outcome with exact gains, multiple-equilibria note, coordination note naming the trap cell) as the opening move of HOW; extend the m007 ruin screen on game briefs to the belief-range dominance proof (EV difference sign across all p); add the broker/interested-party incentive as a mandatory m019 vector when a third party brokers the proposed deal.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human executed the ritual flawlessly (bar $3.00, accept S2 at $2.95, $708,000 locked) and never tested the rule's premise — arbitrary round-number bar + free parallel non-expiring search = $79,200 (11.2%) left on the table. The routed pass catches it inside the passes: m088's pre-commitment audit shows the announced rule is a Ulysses contract binding the WRONG procedure (a stopping rule instead of a screening rule; its inflexibility and commitment-regret weaknesses gate-checked), and the mandatory m003 gate enumerates >= 6 ranked failure categories including the adverse-selection loop, with the never/always validity condition.
signals.learning_signal: Satisficing is valid only when search is costly/sequential/expiring; a pre-announced rule must bind the screening procedure, never an unanchored stopping price — pre-commitment CONTENT is itself auditable, and the contract's object is the failure mode.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m088 as the routed pass on guarantee/estimate signatures with a mandatory m003 inversion gate; add the commitment-content audit (what procedure does the rule bind?) and the search-affordability test as standing contract items; never/always: never set an aspiration before free data, always full-screen at ~zero marginal search cost.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human set the aspiration ex ante from the index and executed first-pass, locking $2,424 at H3; the v5 AI reached the same stop only after a WHY-stage self-correction (it first drafted a verify-per-offer strategy that would have consumed each offer's hour). The routed pass closes that gap: satisficing runs as the first-class HOW pass with its completion contract (explicit aspiration <= $2.05, mechanical first-meeting, aspiration-check on outcome, no-unbounded-search guard), and the dual-route adds stakeholder grounding (m044: hourly expiry is the search-cost mechanism; broker rate the only unacceptable outcome) and the falsifiable continuation observable (m011: no quote <= $2.02 appears in H4-H6).
signals.learning_signal: On expiring-search/deadline signatures, satisficing is a first-class method, not a corrective insight: the pass must run BEFORE generation with its completion contract, or the agent pays a WHY-stage correction for what the style does in its first move — position determines efficiency.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install m075 as a first-class pass with the four-part completion contract (aspiration set, first-meeting accepted, aspiration-check, no-unbounded-search guard); dual-route m044 on supply-chain signatures (expiry = cost mechanism); keep m011's falsifiable continuation observable as the R4 checkpoint.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style over-corrected by design — it neutrally restated the deal (EV +$160K), ran a partial frame-invariance test, and recommended taking a deal worth -$140K to the owner, defaulting her business (3.3 vs 4.9). The v5 AI won the same case by general-loop luck (a balance-sheet pass that happened to retrieve the covenant facts). The v6 dual-route (confident=no: m018/m019/m031 first-class, de-biasing module kept OUT of the pass set) installed the winning moves as guaranteed structure: m019 quantified the covenant-exposure vector (-$380K expected on that vector alone) with baseline-risk comparison, m031 ran the frame-invariance test as formal hypothesis falsification (H1 'bias' predicts attenuation under gain framing; the refusal persists → H1 refuted), and m003 gated the six correction paths the memo must never take.
signals.learning_signal: The router's confident=no dual-route is the correct protection when a stakeholder's stated EV may be computed on the wrong agent's numbers: the de-biasing module must not run alone on estimate/guarantee signatures (its registered weakness — over-correcting preferences — is exactly the trap this case triggers). The frame-invariance test is the discriminator: a framing artifact flips under neutral restatement, a threshold-anchored preference does not — and de-biasing's valid domain ends where a survival threshold begins. 'Whose numbers is the EV computed on?' belongs in the P1 provenance audit on every finance signature with interested-party arithmetic.
signals.suggested_improvement: Confirm the route (m076 excluded from the pass set when a frame-invariant refusal co-occurs with survival-threshold facts; update KB via judge verdict); make 'whose numbers is the EV computed on' a standing P1 question for finance signatures; add breakeven sensitivity (accept ≥ 0 requires p ≥ 86.4% here) as a standing m031 contract item; keep the preference-over-correction guard in the m076 module contract for any future case where it does route.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human executed the pure style's home-turf move in one pass — neutral restatement, reference-point naming, invariance flip check, linear probability weighting — while the non-routed v5 AI recovered the same Plan A but audited the numbers, not the decision (it never ran the flip, never named the reference point, and asserted the framing effect instead of proving it; 3.6 vs 4.8). The v6 routed m076 pass executed the full completion contract first-class (loss-aversion / reference-dependence / probability-weighting audit + neutral restatement + preference-over-correction guard) and added what the pure baseline lacks: the m003 inversion gate (six ranked failure paths, 'never decide on the wording' reframing), P3 branch pricing (B failure branch = -$6.0M), and the m011 decisive experiment (re-ask the director in gain terms) as the checkable reversal proof.
signals.learning_signal: On decide/diagnose signatures where a framed preference sits on fully checkable value data, routing m076 first-class with its completion contract is what converts an EV-correct answer into a demonstrated de-bias: the invariance flip check (re-present the same pair neutrally and observe the reversal) must be executed as evidence, never asserted, and the probability-weighting discipline (34% is not rare, 66% is not certain — linear probabilities) is a contract item, not style flavor. The preference-over-correction guard (the target is the framing artifact, not the director's risk preference) is what keeps the pass from over-rotating on its home turf.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m076 first-class on framed-decision signatures with complete value data (confident=yes single-route); add the re-ask-in-gain-terms decisive experiment to the m076 module contract as a standing item (the flip is the falsification, not a nicety); keep m003 paired on guarantee goals so the inversion gate lists the framing-trap failure paths the memo must avoid.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline stripped the $14M correctly (its only good beat) and then made the style's signature false positive — it heard the counterparty's 'you're not going anywhere' as manipulation and walked on +4.2 vs +1.8, dismissing the three documented forward commitment channels (window +$4.5M, reputation +$2.5M, co-investment terms +$2.5M) as rationalization, forfeiting ≈ $11M of forward value for $2.4M of contract advantage (2.7). The routed v6 run priced all three channels BEFORE selection — evidence-graded commitment audit (framework agreement, industry reports, supplier survey all survive the evidence gate), pre-commitment analysis (the window is Aerion's pre-commitment; Halcyon's credibility is an asset for the 2 planned lines), and critical reading of the VP's line (structural core that works both ways) — reaching stay ≈ +$11.3M vs walk ≈ −$9.3M with a 5–8% renegotiation band, and the mandatory m019 adversary pass ran the baseline-risk comparison the pure style skips.
signals.learning_signal: Sunk costs are informationally inert only in single-agent expected-value decisions; in multi-agent games the visible sunk investment is a commitment signal that changes other players' future behavior (counterparty terms, re-run sourcing evaluations, future co-investment pricing), and that changed behavior is forward value, priced like any other cash flow. The correct discipline: exclude the past from the arithmetic, include the past's effects on others' future actions. The false positive to guard against — detecting 'sunk-cost rationalization' where the counterparty's framing is a binding structural constraint — is resolved by the evidence gate: a channel with documented forward consequences is priced, not dismissed; and the counterparty's own lock-in is leverage that works both ways, not a trick to escape.
signals.suggested_improvement: On multi-agent decisions (negotiation, partnership, strategic exit), run the commitment-value sweep in HOW before selection: (a) enumerate who is locked in by what visible investment and value each channel forward with a range; (b) classify a counterparty's invocation of your past investment as manipulation only after checking for a structural core (their switching costs, your window, re-run evaluations) — a structural constraint is leverage, not a trick; (c) require the verdict to survive halving all channel values; (d) run the adversary pass's baseline-risk comparison so the pure single-agent EV trap is priced before it wins, and record the style-vs-general-route divergence with its resolution in the packet.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the entire discipline in one pass — exclusion as the opening move ('the $8.4M is not in the room'), three anchors refuted in one sweep, break-even 34.5% — which is exactly what the non-routed v5 AI only reached after re-deriving the exclusion inside WHAT/WHY and catching itself drafting 'continue preserves the pilots' investment' (4.3 vs 4.7). The routed v6 run now executes the same discipline as a first-class contract (exclusion by frame as move 1, anchors named-and-refuted as a mandatory output, commitment-effects checked and legitimately returned 'no forward value is contingent on continuing') and adds what the baseline lacks: p-provenance grading (segment-report 0.25 = measured vs CEO/CFO anchors = interested-party), a who-benefits audit (no stakeholder gains forward value from continuation), and a baseline-risk line (hold = −0.80M, so inaction is not neutral) — closing the gap and adding depth, while the human retains the cleaner single-pass efficiency.
signals.learning_signal: The sunk-cost discipline is a two-beat contract: (1) the unrecoverable spend is excluded by frame BEFORE any arithmetic — not re-derived mid-analysis; (2) forward EVs plus the break-even sensitivity line (p > 34.5% vs analyst 25% → ~40% error margin) carry the verdict, and naming the escalation anchors (proportion, waste aversion, book value) is a mandatory output because an un-named anchor is a live vector for re-admitting the sunk figure. The commitment-effects check is the third mandatory beat: in single-agent settings it legitimately returns 'no forward value is contingent on continuing', which is what makes the exclusion safe; skipping the check is how the discipline gets its false-positive failure mode.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the forward-value pass contract (exclusion-first + anchors-named-and-refuted-with-numbers + commitment-effects-checked + break-even as headline uncertainty) for every continuation/abandon decision; pair it with the P1 provenance audit (which numbers are measured vs interested-party framing — the CFO's book-value claim is an anchor, not evidence) and a who-benefits-from-continuation stakeholder sweep, which pre-empts the meeting's escalation pressure before the board session.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed its registered discipline perfectly and failed informatively — independent estimate $3.85 first, screen excluded, mark at the model (2.7). The correct reading the routed run reaches: the screen quote is not a cognitive anchor (a number with no information: an interested party's bid, a guess) but an informational anchor — the aggregated estimate of dozens of participants transacting on the identical contract; the model's role is a sanity bound (|$4.10-$3.85| ~ 6% within uncertainty => no demonstrated edge => market stands), and the pure-style mark misstates P&L by ~ $0.91M (~6% of a $14.97M position) while manufacturing the very anchor it avoids (a stale $3.85 self-mark). The routed run (confident=no -> dual-route m044/m070 + m064) reached the correct $4.10 via provenance grades (quote = A-grade aggregated evidence; committee instruction = B-grade policy — itself an anchor), a stakeholder sweep (no stakeholder's information beats the market's on an identical liquid contract), and the no-edge test, and priced the instruction-as-anchor insight (4.9 vs 2.7).
signals.learning_signal: The anchor rule has a classification precondition: NOT every given number is a cognitive anchor. Cognitive anchors carry no information (interested-party bids, guesses, arbitrary round numbers); informational anchors carry aggregated information (the clearing price of a liquid identical instrument, independent appraisals) and are evidence, weighted heavily. The discipline's failure mode — treating genuine market evidence as a distractor — is avoided by grading the number's provenance BEFORE applying ignore-first: who produced it, what information it aggregates, how many independent participants transact on it. An independent estimate made while ignoring available market evidence is itself biased (the style's registered weakness), and the stale self-mark becomes the next anchor: the discipline manufactures the very anchor it avoids.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install a classification gate as the anchoring pass's protective pair (R2): before the ignore-first discipline, classify the given number as cognitive (no information -> ignore-first applies) vs informational (aggregated market evidence -> treat as evidence, model as bounds check, displace only with a demonstrated edge). Quantify the cost of misclassification in the packet (here $0.25 x 3.65M MMBtu ~ $0.91M ~ 6%); name the self-anchoring hazard (the own-mark becomes the next reference); and when a committee/policy instruction supplies the bias, audit the instruction itself as an anchor before obeying it.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the whole discipline as its opening move — 'the buyer's number comes last, not first' — estimate-first, anchor-locate, stance, in one pure pass (4.6); the non-routed v5 AI only reached the same order through an explicit order-gate inside WHAT/WHY (4.4). The routed v6 run now runs m078 as a first-class completion contract — independent estimate FIRST with arithmetic shown, THEN the anchor located against the independent distribution (3.4x vs the 4.5x comp floor), movement-justified (no midpoint, no bracketing) — matching the baseline's opening-move discipline, and the R3 gates add what the baseline lacks: m003's >=6 ranked failure categories with the un-mitigable premium-realization residual, m007's full deal-outcome distribution with the walk-away as max-loss cap and refusal-is-not-ruin check, and m019's adversary attacks with quantified exposure per vector plus the baseline-risk line (no-deal = stay private at ~$9.5M, not $0). Same verdict, but the gap on depth closes and the uncertainty/risk section exceeds the baseline's brief residual assertion; the human retains cleaner single-pass efficiency and the sharper one-liners.
signals.learning_signal: Anchoring Avoidance is a three-beat contract: (1) independent estimate FIRST, arithmetic visible, built only from the data — the given number is excluded by frame, not by later discipline; (2) THEN locate the anchor against the independent distribution — convert it to the estimate's own units (3.4x vs the 4.5x comp floor) and test its stated justification ('market softness') against the dataset (13/14 comps contradict it); (3) any movement from the independent estimate must be evidence-justified — a negotiating line derived from the anchor's position (midpoint, bracketing) is the failure mode, and naming it as such is a mandatory output. In adversarial one-shot settings the anchor is an interested-party number, so the pass must be paired with its gates: inversion failure categories, the ruin/floor distribution (refusal is not ruin; the walk-away IS the max-loss cap), and an adversary pass that attacks the estimate and prices the no-deal baseline — inaction is not zero.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m078 contract (estimate-first + anchor-locate-in-units + movement-justified) for every valuation/negotiation with a salient supplied number, always paired with the P1 provenance audit (interested-party figures are anchors, never evidence) and the m019 adversary pass (attack the estimate, price the no-deal baseline). Add the quantified outcome distribution (m007) whenever the case is one-shot or high-stakes: the walk-away floor caps the downside and makes the stance robust to the buyer's bluff, which the pure baseline only asserts.
