signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style performed contrarian theater — four disconfirming artifacts collected, none graded, revised to 'inconclusive — do not roll back,' breaching the 05:00 SLA line; the v6 run's route (confident=no → m028/m033 dual-route, trap style out of top-3) plus the R4 m003 gate and tempo mode (P2) held the rollback decision: every disconfirming item was graded by (time-consistency, signature-match, weight) — the 03:10 clean bucket is a 5-min-granularity artifact, the LB tweak was reverted with no effect, the gateway report was retracted with clean logs, the soak is underpowered (2% load, 1/40th rows) — and all four failed the bar.
signals.learning_signal: On deadline signatures with an already-anchored belief, a disconfirmation hunt must run WITH an evidence-grading bar: an item that fails (time, signature, weight) earns a post-mortem note, never doubt; the instructive case is the LB null-revert — a concurrent change reverted with zero effect is a free control experiment that exonerates itself and reinforces the remaining cause, the exact inversion of the pure hunt's doubt reflex.
signals.suggested_improvement: Add the m079-NEG lesson as a standing gate: when a hunt is requested under deadline/tempo, prepend the falsification bar to the hunt module (m079 + bar = safe; m079 alone = theater); fold the 'concurrent-change-as-natural-control' reading into the m033 contract for incident signatures; keep tempo mode committing at DO so the SLA asymmetry (25-min reversible fix vs 2h+ investigation) prices the decision.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI reached falsification-first only inside WHY (depth 4 vs 5, efficiency 3 vs 5, insight 4 vs 5 — the human ran the kill-shot as move 1), while the v6 run installed the m079 pass first-class at HOW entry: disconfirmation designed before the confirming pile (grandfathered 3.5% vs new-tier 3.3% — belief dies), counter-data sweep lateral/temporal/compositional (grandfathered jumped to 3.5% in July too — the jump tracks the notification, not the billing; 8-of-11 price mentions cluster in the notification month), per-item falsification bar, plus P1 provenance (confirming pile = interested-party, ledger = measured), P3 branch pricing of the rollback failure branch, the m003 inversion gate, and the insight that the confirming stream and the disconfirmation share one data source (month-clustering).
signals.learning_signal: On decide/diagnose signatures with a closed ledger, routing m079 as a first-class pass with its completion contract converts a recovered answer into a one-pass answer; the meta-move — the falsification test is designed BEFORE re-reading the confirming pile — is what P6 (falsification-latency) must keep enforced, and the counter-data sweep (lateral/temporal/compositional) is what separates a trap diagnosis from a bare cohort contrast.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m079 first-class on belief-test signatures with closed ledgers; make the counter-data sweep and the per-item falsification bar (time-consistency, signature-match) standing parts of the module contract on every run; pair with the P1 provenance audit (who benefits) whenever the confirming pile belongs to the belief's holder.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline (human 2.9 / v6 routed 4.9): the baseline's registered weakness — counterfactual data genuinely missing — operated as designed and stalled the decision (withheld ratification, demanded evidence that cannot exist); the routed run executed the same inventory (treated failures 2/141 complete, counterfactual structural, pre-hospital unobservable) but the mandatory m006 gate (unmeasured context) converted the gap into a bound: 3 likelihood scenarios, posterior range, unreachable threshold flip, plus the stakeholder asymmetry (withholding's cost certain, expanding's monitorable) and the forward-data insight (the counterfactual can only be built by expanding). Residual gap: none material — tempo mode held the 48h clock; the true counterfactual stays unmeasurable and is named as such.
signals.learning_signal: When failure data structurally cannot exist, the survivorship move must end in a decision-bound rather than a refusal: weight the complete-cohort gradient + mechanism, demonstrate the threshold flip is unreachable at any decision bar, and manufacture the missing data prospectively; 'no counterfactual ⇒ no decision' is the failure signature, not the evidence.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m006 provenance gate on all unmeasured/decision-under-clock signatures and add 'counterfactual unobtainable ⇒ manufacture forward' as the mandatory closing step of the m080 contract, so the style's registered weakness is gate-checked on its own home turf; route m044+m011+m063 on deadline+unmeasured decide signatures as the asymmetric-stakes + delay-loop pairing.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline (v5 human won 4.6/4.3): the routed run now produces the baseline's canonical artifact — full-denominator demand, falsified headline (4 slow winners incl. 7.2x exit), 2x2 base rates (27% vs 40% vs 30% base rate), hidden cohort (22/30 = 73% of fast-launchers failed) — as first-class contracted outputs, and the P1 pass flags the partner's memo as interested-party before the math, m058 prices the rejected option (adopt now = option killed on salience), and the insight pass adds the self-amputating-mandate move (a 90-day mandate would delete the slow cohort whose 7.2x exit is the fund's best outcome) the baseline lacked. Residual gap: the human's one-pass failure-side opening is leaner (efficiency 5 vs 4); verdict, math, and decision (reject mandate, commission the discriminative analysis) are identical.
signals.learning_signal: On closed-ledger decide signatures, the failures-inventory + base-rate pass must run as first-class contracted outputs (full denominator, falsified headline, conditional rates vs portfolio base rate, hidden-cohort count), and the survivor-pattern claim is best killed by showing the mandate would destroy the very variation the data needs — a self-amputation argument no salience story survives.
signals.suggested_improvement: Add the m080 contract to II.2.9 (failures-inventory before trusting survivor patterns; conditional base rates vs portfolio base rate; hidden-cohort count; counterfactual-data caveat — or its explicit absence on closed ledgers) and require an interested-party provenance flag (P1) on the claim under review before any survivor-pattern endorsement; on fully-specified ledger cases the closed-scope fast path (P8) may compress stages but never the failure-side pass.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline executed the registered failure mode — it dismissed a genuine RCT as 'self-reported neatness', demanded a 12-month all-platform trial, and declined the decision (2.6). The routed route excluded the trap style and ran steelman (m018) + red team (m019) with the baseline-risk gate: the skeptic's strongest form survived only as monitorable external-validity risk, the attack vectors were quantified (mobile-only, novelty fade, drift) and capped by the do-nothing cost (≈ 2,000 churned users/month), and the decision committed with a holdout + revert trigger.
signals.learning_signal: On decide-signatures with genuine experimental evidence, never route pure narrative skepticism — route the adversarial-critical family (steelman + red team) with the baseline-risk gate so the attack is calibrated against the cost of inaction; randomization + pre-specified mechanism IS the counter-data the skeptic's lens demands.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m018+m019 dual-route (m028 context) on product/medical decide signatures; enforce the m019 completion contract (enumerated vectors, quantified exposure, baseline-risk comparison) as the anti-paralysis gate; treat the RCT control arm as the answer to 'what does the story leave out', and price the do-nothing branch before any postponement.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the non-routed v5 AI reached the right verdict but discovered the counter-data opportunistically — the temporal boundary check surfaced only at REVIEW (3.9 vs 4.9). The routed m081 pass turned the story-selection audit into a completion contract: all three counter-data classes (lateral: Region B +44.3% → differential +0.7 pp; temporal: both regions +35% at the launch boundary; compositional: Customer X = 69% of the delta) were demanded up front, and P1 provenance (memo author = interested party) plus the m084 org frame (replication as an attribution/adoption problem) added what the pure lens left out.
signals.learning_signal: On observational causal-claim signatures (finance/product decide+diagnose), a story-selection audit with three orthogonal sweeps (lateral control, temporal pre-launch, compositional concentration) demanded as a contract closes the opportunistic-discovery gap; the data-discipline clause (decompose the real growth, don't dismiss it) prevents over-claiming 'no effect'.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m081 top-1 on observational growth/verdict signatures; install the story-selection audit + data-discipline as a standing completion contract; pair every narrative audit with P1 provenance (who benefits from the story) and price the decision branches (replicate / hold / pilot) before DO.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline fell into the style's known weakness — cynicism (2.7 vs AI 4.6 in v5): it assumed the cost-saving proposal was motivated without verifying the incentive (bonus tied to on-time delivery, not the saving; $120K board-earmarked for safety equipment; the supporting audit predates the proposal), never tested the conclusion against the 96-quarter record or the regulator's biennial minimum, and rejected a sound, regulator-aligned change. The v6 routed run holds the v5 AI verdict (approve + re-escalation backstop) and adds what the v5 run only did emergently: the m082 SELF-AUDIT contract line (the detector's own 'cost bonus → suspicious' first move is a motivated reading that fails the same incentive-existence test), the m003 inversion pass (6 ranked failure categories of the annual decision with the un-mitigable rare-event residual named), and the m007 ruin screen (cadence is reversible — the ruin-averse floor is the monitoring backstop, not the cadence; the rejection branch has its own cost: $120K/yr foregone for safety equipment).
signals.learning_signal: Convenience of a conclusion is a screening trigger, not a verdict: (1) verify the incentive EXISTS and runs in the conclusion's direction (compensation link, earmarks, who commissioned supporting analyses and when) before flagging; (2) test the conclusion against the data and external anchors (regulator minima, independent audits predating the proposal) even when it looks self-serving; (3) SELF-AUDIT the detection: a blocking reading can be just as 'convenient' for the detector — the style's failure mode is cynicism, and its own suspicion must pass the same direction test it applies to the author; (4) price the rejection branch — blocking a sound change has a real cost (foregone earmarked safety spend), so verdicts need an uncertainty-appropriate backstop (re-escalation triggers), not blanket rejection.
signals.suggested_improvement: Add the self-audit as a standing line in the m082 completion contract: after the who-benefits audit, run the same test on the detector's own reading ('is my suspicion directionally loaded, and would the opposite reader's suspicion be symmetric?'), and pair every flag with (a) incentive-existence verification and (b) a 'could this be right anyway' data test; the flag fires only when the incentive exists AND the conclusion fails the data test. Keep the m003/m007/m019 gate set (with inversion failure categories and the ruin floor) on guarantee-goal + high_stakes safety signatures — the v5 human loss is the installed contract item (P3/P1, source case m082).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI lost this case outright (2.9 vs 4.7) — it accepted the supplied TCO model as an authoritative, direction-neutral frame, re-verified only its arithmetic, and recommended the lapse the model's author (promotion/headcount tied to Atlas adoption) wanted. The v6 routed run closed the gap as first-class contract outputs: who-benefits audit (Alex, policy 12.4), same-evidence-opposite-incentive reading (vendor rep / neutral CFO → renew), exclusion inventory (the model omits exactly the $240K/yr outage losses and $50K/yr scaling capex that favor the vendor), full-cost recompute ($540K vs $1.32M; claimed $1.2M saving reverses to ≈ $780K additional cost, ≈ $2.0M discrepancy in the author's direction), and a self-audit of the detector's own vendor-favoring reading. The m019 gate added the lapse branch's priced failure outcome the v5 tree never built. Residual shared gap: the human pure-style trace remains marginally more efficient than the routed machinery (margin 0.1 <= 0.3, J1 second-judge flag noted).
signals.learning_signal: When a decision frame (model, analysis, recommendation) is supplied rather than constructed, audit the frame before the arithmetic: (1) WHO-BENEFITS — if the author's compensation/scope depends on the conclusion, flag it (policy 12.4 makes it objectively checkable); (2) OPPOSITE-INCENTIVE READING — would the identical records be read differently by someone whose incentive runs the other way? Same records + opposite incentive → opposite verdict is the direction test; (3) DIRECTION-CHECK the omissions — inventory what the model excludes and which way each exclusion pushes; directionally loaded exclusions (failure windows, peak data, costs) are the empirical signature of motivated reasoning, and summary statistics that hide the stress window (annual average vs December peak split 12%/88%) are its signature move; (4) recompute with the full cost set, not the provided subset — the honest delta flips the sign; (5) SELF-AUDIT — the detector's own reading is also directionally loaded; document why the verdict does not depend on the auditor's bias.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the incentive-direction audit as the standing m082 completion contract for all supplied-model decisions: WHO-BENEFITS → OPPOSITE-INCENTIVE READ → EXCLUSION INVENTORY → FULL-COST RECOMPUTE → SELF-AUDIT, executed at the WHAT/WHY boundary before any verification of arithmetic; the packet gate fails if it concludes on arithmetic over a frame whose input selection was never audited. Add 'hidden summary statistic' (averages masking the stress window) as a mandatory direction-check line, and keep the m019 gate priced on the unpriced branch (here: lapse-and-fail at December peak) for every renewal/migration decision.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure principal-agent human baseline priced protection against a divergence it never verified — it applied the generic 2%/yr defection rate to a relationship whose 30% profit share co-aligns the agent's payoff derivative with the owner's residual, whose 9-year incident-free record and 90% retention contradict the prior, and whose pending equity grant closes the largest vector (portable client migration); its cost-benefit ($30k > $12k) excluded compliance time, the distrust signal, false-positive charges, and the outside-option loop that raises the defection probability the package prices. The v6 routed run held the protective verdict: router kept the trap style out of top-3, dual-routed m019+m039 with m003/m007/m019 gates, and ran the m083 alignment audit BEFORE costing any control — the divergence audit the pure-style baseline skipped, now installed as the P3 branch-completeness gate (source case m083).
signals.learning_signal: Principal-agent reasoning must be bidirectional: predict misbehavior where incentives diverge, verify alignment where they appear to converge. Before any monitoring decision: (1) run the payoff-derivative alignment audit (agent's marginal take of the principal's residual) as the FIRST step — never assume divergence a priori; (2) test base-rate transferability by separating inside/outside view (m097 reference class): a generic survey rate is not evidence about a relationship whose contract and record contradict it; (3) price the monitoring instrument's full cost line — direct, compliance time, signal cost (surveillance converts an intrinsically motivated agent into a compliance-minimizing one), false positives, and the outside-option loop; (4) recommend monitoring only if prevented harm exceeds the FULL line, otherwise deepen alignment (vesting, floors, succession).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m019+m039 dual-route with the m003/m007/m019 gate set on high_stakes + adversarial judgment signatures (the negative split is held); codify the divergence-audit-before-costing ordering as a standing m083 gate on ALL principal-agent and monitoring tasks, with the full monitoring-cost line (including the outside-option loop) as a mandatory packet line; retain the m097 reference-class transferability check inside the P1 provenance audit.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI matched the human's equilibria and fix but lost on depth — it never derived the firm's break-even discount (d = 20%), never located the conflict explicitly in the d >= 20% value-destroying region, and folded pay-neutrality into a single line. The v6 routed run closed all three gaps as m083 completion-contract outputs (break-even derivation, conflict-region statement, formal pay-neutrality verification) and added the m019 adversary pass's conflict-relocation finding (the profit share moves the seam to the cost line if costs become discretionary) plus the observed-quarter data-pin (the +45%/−$0.4M quarter implies d ≈ 22%, already inside the destroying region); residual shared gap: the human's pure payoff-math trace remains marginally more efficient than the gate machinery.
signals.learning_signal: For contract-redesign tasks, equilibrium arithmetic is not the endpoint: after computing the agent's status-quo choice, the m083 contract must output (1) the principal's break-even threshold derived from both payoff functions and the location of the conflict region (the value-destroying interval), (2) verification of the redesign by recomputing the agent's OWN optimum under the new contract (a formal check, not an assertion that 'incentives align'), and (3) a pay-neutrality check at the aligned point. The m019 adversary pass must then relocate the conflict to the next seam: every contract has one (here the cost line), and a sign-matched-derivative audit is the same check at the new seam.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m011+m023 dual-route with the m083 native contract on decide/estimate/maximize + adversarial signatures (router confident=no); make break-even derivation, conflict-region location, and pay-neutrality standing m083 contract items; add 'next-seam' (conflict relocation under the proposed contract) as a mandatory m019/m083 packet line so the adversary pass attacks the NEW contract's incentives, not just the old one's.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline executed the registered weakness (abstract; institution failure modes) exactly as designed — it saw the free-rider element (a skip saves 2h while the street stays mostly protected) and answered with fast-tracked formal mechanism design (acclamation ratification, sheet-at-barrier, post-event fines), never pricing stand-up cost against a 36-hour problem lifetime, never noticing its sanctions cannot fire before the crest, ignoring the 6-eyes monitoring already present and the crowding-out of intrinsic reciprocity by fines. The v6 routed run held the protective verdict with quantified machinery: m001 fundamentals+anchor (what does the charter add beyond six neighbors' observation/reciprocity? nothing in-window), m018 steel-manning that survives every design property and dies on every temporal one, m003 inversion's ≥6 ranked failure categories (evening lost, inert sanctions, crowd-out, false assurance, appeals-void, precedent), the m007 ruin screen (charter branch: 100% process cost + 0 deterrence), tempo mode pricing the lost evening, and the insight pass naming the meta-lesson 'the norm is the institution' with the n/horizon cost function.
signals.learning_signal: Institutional machinery has a cost function in group size, horizon, and transaction costs: before endorsing ANY proposed mechanism, run the stand-up test (steps × time vs problem lifetime — if stand-up cost > lifetime, the mechanism is the failure mode), the enforcement-latency test (can any sanction actually fire before the deadline? if not, it deters nothing), the redundancy audit (at small n with mutual observation, the formal monitoring layer adds cost and zero information), and the crowding-out check (does monetizing the act change its meaning and reduce intrinsic effort?). The cheap local action — one call, public roll-call, existing reciprocity — IS an institution and must be named first-class, not contrasted as 'no institution'; defer formalization until the horizon allows its cost to amortize (a post-crisis standing plan).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the dual-route m001 + m018 pass with the m003 + m007 gate set and tempo mode on deadline,high_stakes,one_shot + guarantee signatures (negative split verified protective for this family); install the stand-up test (stand-up cost vs problem lifetime, enforcement latency, redundancy, crowding-out) as a standing gate on ANY proposed institution whenever the signature carries a deadline; retain the m084 contract's norm/mechanism dichotomy — the cheap local norm IS the institution — as a mandatory packet line so formalization is priced as a deferred option, never as the default answer.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI matched the human's institution (contingent access, free endogenous monitoring, graduated sanctions) but lost 4.3 vs 4.6 on ordering and depth — it re-derived the pivotal-marginal logic inside its WHY stage while the human wrote the game down first and owned the equilibrium in one pass ('a shift pays only when I am the exact 8th commitment; the observed failures ARE the equilibrium'), and its institution-failure closure was asserted, not quantified. The v6 routed run closed both gaps as m084 completion-contract outputs: game-write-down first (threshold 8/12, cost 1 vs benefit 3, one-shot), the observed 3- and 5-shift seasons stated AS the equilibrium, efficiency gap 36 vs 8, and an institution-failure check with each vector closed concretely (board-log units, compliant-first sequencing, no-exemption clause); the m007 ruin screen priced the sure 36-forgoed floor and the m019 adversary pass quantified per-vector exposure (one exempted farm reopens the hole for all 12). Residual shared gap: the human's payoff-first trace remains marginally more efficient than the gate machinery.
signals.learning_signal: For recurring under-provision of a threshold public good, the m084 contract must output in order: (1) the game written down first — threshold, individual cost/benefit, one-shot vs repeated — with the observed failure pattern stated AS the equilibrium, never as motive ('laziness' is the payoff table's shadow); (2) the efficiency gap (8 cost vs 36 benefit) as the argument for institutionalizing; (3) mechanism design that changes payoffs, not rhetoric — excludability/contingent access converts a public good into a club good so contribution is a best response, with monitoring endogenous and free and sanctions graduated; (4) an institution-failure check with at least one vector closed concretely (measurement via board-logged units, sanction credibility via compliant-first delivery sequencing, collusion via all-member monitoring, capture via a written no-exemption clause); (5) the ruin floor: what each season costs if nothing is done.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m084 native single-route on decide/diagnose/estimate/maximize + adversarial,high_stakes,one_shot signatures with the m007+m019 gate set (router confident=yes); make the game-write-down the FIRST m084 contract line so the equilibrium claim precedes any alternative generation (the v5 ordering gap); add political capture / no-exemption clause as a standing m019 vector for access-based institutions so the adversary pass attacks the new rule's own seams, not only the status quo's.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human baseline fell into the registered trap (over-applied, excludes local norms) exactly as designed — it classified the estuary as open access ('unlicensed ⇒ open access'), dismissed 30 years of audited stability as 'luck, not governance' ('unwritten rules are not rules'), and prescribed the state takeover (40% quota + $15k license + no-entry park) that destroys the functioning commons (11/20 sell out, poaching 3×, stock −20%, monitor stood down). The v5 non-routed AI won this case only emergently — its general machinery happened to frame 'who has access today?' at WHAT. The v6 routed run makes the protection structural: the router held the trap style out of top-3 (KB neg_failure_rate), dual-routed m044+m070 with the m003 gate, installed the m085 over-application guard as the P3 branch-completeness gate (access check before any prescription — source case m085), and added the m097 reference-class falsification (neighboring lagoons had no entry restriction or monitoring — the collapse base rate does not transfer), the m070 evidence-graded SWOT (dropped 'unwritten rules are not rules' as C-grade against the audited record), and the m044 destruction mechanism (state jurisdiction voids the monitor — enforcement vacuum).
signals.learning_signal: Commons logic must verify open access before prescribing governance; existing local governance is a solution to the commons problem, not a failure of it. (1) The access-structure check — who accesses today, what constrains them, who enforces, how long the arrangement has held — is a mandatory pre-prescription gate on every shared-resource case: entry restriction + monitoring means a regulated commons, and multi-decade stability under local norms is evidence of functioning governance, not unmanaged luck; (2) reference-class discipline: a base rate (neighboring-lagoon collapses) transfers only within its class — verify the cited class's excludability/monitoring structure before importing the rate (m097 inside the P1 audit); (3) institutional-fit test: for each governance alternative, trace what happens to the existing enforcement authority (state jurisdiction voiding the community monitor is the destruction mechanism) and price the destruction path (sell-outs, poaching, stock decline) as a cost line; (4) when local governance functions, prescribe co-management (legal backing against outsiders, devolved enforcement, state technical capacity), never takeover.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m085 over-application guard as a standing P3 branch-completeness gate on ALL resource-governance signatures — it is the m085 contract's third line and must fire even when the router excludes m085 from top-3 (the style's registered weakness is the gate's trigger, not its presence); keep the router's trap-style exclusion (m085 neg_failure_rate learned from this case-class's v5 loss); add the m097 reference-class transfer check to the P1 provenance audit for any resource case citing neighbor/pilot base rates.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI produced the identical governance design (cap = recharge = 10,000 ac-ft/yr; 833/co-op or tradable rights with grandfathering; metering, penalties, transition compensation, drought ratchet) with identical depletion math (2,500 ac-ft/yr drawdown; 30,000/2,500 = 12 years to intrusion), but lost on ordering and ownership: it opened with a stock-flow budget problem and back-filled the commons structure only when the refusals forced it, so the human's signature moves ('the 11 refusals ARE the equilibrium, not bad faith'; 'quota without metering is a suggestion') outranked it on depth, efficiency, and insight. The v6 routed run closed the gap: the m085 completion contract made excludability/rivalry classification the S1 structure-first-scan output (overuse detected BEFORE arithmetic), the refusal-derived design a first-class output, and added the over-application guard (local norms check — verified open access), the m018 steel-man (explicit falsification of the voluntary path in its strongest form), the m019 design-attack (enforcement-capture vector), and the m003 gate (6 ranked failure categories incl. coalition capture). Residual shared gap: the pure human trace remains marginally more efficient than the gate machinery.
signals.learning_signal: For shared-resource governance cases the excludability/rivalry classification must be the structure-first-scan output before any stock-flow arithmetic, and the m085 completion contract must be order-enforced: (1) detect overuse — classify by excludability + rivalry and derive the predicted individual behavior (over-extraction) from the classification, stating observed refusals to restrain as the predicted equilibrium, not moral failure; (2) quantify depletion to the binding horizon (stock at risk / net drawdown) and use it as the decision clock; (3) run the over-application guard on EVERY shared-resource case — verify who actually has access today before prescribing (the same check that wins the negative case, so the guard doubles as the positive case's calibration); (4) design governance in order: aggregate cap = inflow rate (extraction = recharge → steady state), allocation (per-unit quotas or tradable rights + grandfathering), enforcement as first-class (metering, escalating penalties, ledger that survives transfers), transition (compensation or trade revenue for the cut), uncertainty (drought → ratcheting schedule); (5) state the success condition as horizon-removal — under the cap the intrusion line moves to never.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m085 single-route on decide/guarantee/predict + resource-governance signatures (router confident=yes), with the contract order enforced by the S1 scan; make the access-structure verification (who is excluded today, by what, enforced by whom) a standing second line of the m085 contract on every shared-resource case; keep the m003 inversion gate (≥6 failure categories of the NEW governance, including coalition/enforcement capture) and the m019 attack-on-the-design pass as packet lines so the adversary prices the fix's own seams, not just the problem's.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: both sides correctly refused the reductionist trap (v5 AI and human both signed the patch, deferred the council, gated residual levers — the human's margin was the aftermath pass: the AI mentioned freed capacity in one clause, never quantified it (8 × 90% ≈ 7.2 agent-equivalents; 45% cut frees ≈ 3.2), named no make-work or morale/hoarding loop, and had no redeployment ladder; its uncertainty handling was informal. The v6 routed run closed the aftermath gap as the m086 estimator-vs-structure output (data-first ordering: no loop map over the measured 45%; aftermath loops with falsifiable observables — new-process count and disposition-time creep; redeployment: OT → backlog → proactive) and exceeded both baselines on uncertainty: m006 provenance audit (3 likelihood scenarios 0.70/0.85/0.95 → posterior range 45 ± 10% removal → decision-threshold flip demonstrated) and m019's quantified delay vector (4 months × 540/wk ≈ 8,640 tickets ≈ 2,160 agent-hours left running); tempo mode (c:deadline) kept efficiency high while committing at DO; overall 4.7 human vs 4.9 AI, J1 second-judge flag noted.
signals.learning_signal: Estimator-vs-structure ordering is the reductionism guard for org analysis: (1) never draw a loop map over a measured cause — a loop 'explaining' measured volume via org dynamics is fabrication; the direct measured lever executes first, and loop analysis applies only to the change's aftermath and the unmeasured residual; (2) a mandatory aftermath pass after ANY change: quantify the capacity/stock released by arithmetic, name at least two signed response loops (make-work under freed capacity, morale/utilization cliff with hoarding and scope-expansion), attach a falsifiable observable to each, and specify a redeployment ladder — selecting a lever is not the end of the task; (3) under unmeasured context, run the provenance audit with ≥ 3 likelihood scenarios, a posterior range, and a demonstrated decision-threshold flip before any org-dynamics claim is licensed; (4) price the delay vector of any program against the measured lever it postpones (council cost = 8,640 tickets left running).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m019+m018+m026 single-route with the m006 provenance gate on deadline+unmeasured signatures (router confident=yes); install the aftermath pass (capacity arithmetic + named response loops with falsifiable observables + redeployment ladder) as a standing m086/m011 contract item on ALL change interventions, not just this case; add delay-vector quantification (program cost expressed in units of the lever it postpones) as a mandatory m019 packet line; retain tempo mode for c:deadline — commit at DO without silencing the scheduled post-fix re-measure (the day-14 gate that decides the residual levers).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI caught the structural infeasibility (20×33 = 660 > 480) and predicted gaming but then treated the HQ mandate as fixed and deepened monitoring — feeding the KPI-illusion loop instead of changing loop structure; it missed the support-bottleneck amplifier, gave no markers with timing, and its own REVIEW flagged the error it could not correct. The v6 routed run closed all three gaps as m086 completion-contract outputs (5 signed loops incl. R1 comp-attrition, B3 support-bottleneck, R2 KPI-illusion; policy resistance located in the time stock as a conservation law; a falsifiable observable attached to EVERY loop with Q2-Q4 timing), with m023 opportunity-cost pricing (keep-mandate options forfeit the outcome contract), m070 evidence-graded SWOT (drops the unbacked 'quota forces phone time' claim), m003 ranked failure categories of the redesign itself, and m088 pre-commitment framing of reset triggers; residual shared gap: the human's pure trace remains marginally more efficient than the gate machinery (human 5 vs AI 4.5 efficiency; overall 4.9/4.9, J1 second-judge flag noted).
signals.learning_signal: When a policy is structurally infeasible, the policy is a decision variable, not a constraint — and the m086 pass must prove resistance structurally: (1) state the mechanism as a stock-level conservation law (time/effort-budget arithmetic: 660 > 480, and 500 > 480 at zero admin); (2) map every loop SIGNED with a FALSIFIABLE OBSERVABLE attached per loop (a marker that distinguishes that loop from the others — timestamp clustering for gaming, median talk time for time-compression, attrition rate for comp-attrition, backlog for the bottleneck, paper-vs-real divergence for KPI-illusion); (3) generate at least one alternative that changes loop structure (remove the quota / rewire comp / add capacity) checked against the binding arithmetic, never just intensifying enforcement; (4) pre-commit reset triggers — rollback-by-design thresholds that bind the org's future self, treating the policy change as a Ulysses contract so rollback happens by design, not post-mortem.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m023+m070 dual-route with m088 context and the m003 inversion gate on estimate/guarantee/predict + organization-policy signatures (router confident=no); make per-loop falsifiable observables and reset-trigger pre-commitments standing m086 contract items; add the m070 evidence-graded-SWOT discipline (drop claims the historical record contradicts) as a checklist rule; retain the m003 failure-categories pass applied to the RECOMMENDED redesign, not just to the status quo.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the style's registered weakness to the letter — it strengthened its alternative (the style's own doctrine) with a fabricated Luminex $10.50/unit offer, computed the zone from the CLAIMED floor ([$10.50, $10.20] → false no-zone), and after the bluff collapsed (capacity 30k vs 100k; no quote) the anchor persisted: it rejected the buyer's final $9.00/unit, walked, realized the honest $8.50 spot (−$50k) and forfeited the 3-year framework (~$342k). The routed v6 run held the protective route: P1 provenance classified the claim before any zone math, the true zone [$8.50, $10.20] (midpoint $9.35) was recomputed from the honest floor, and $9.00 was accepted as the +$50k win it is — while m020's ranked pre-mortem explicitly named anchoring-on-the-collapsed-claim as failure #1, the exact trap the baseline fell into.
signals.learning_signal: The R3 pair (m019 adversary pass + m007 ruin screen) is the protective backbone on adversarial/high-stakes negotiation: m019 quantified the fabrication's cost (−$50k and −$342k vectors) and m007 priced the walk branch (−$50k − $342k) so 'walk' carries its full cost. The single decision rule that converts this case is the honest-floor acceptance test — 'does the offer beat what we actually realize if the deal dies?' ($9.00 > $8.50 → accept) — and the falsifiable observable ('offer exists in the market', broken by the capacity check) is what kills the inflation loop at its inflow.
signals.suggested_improvement: Promote m020 (pre-mortem, ranked) from routing context to a first-class pass on collapse-of-claim signatures — the corpus NEG lesson is anchoring persistence, and a ranked pre-mortem is the cheapest place to name it; add a 'claimed-alternative verification' output slot to the top-1 integrity pass so the falsification is a completed contract line (claimed vs verified, with the check that failed) rather than context. Keep the honest-floor acceptance test as the standing HOW selection rule for any negotiation where a claimed walk-away has failed verification.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline maps both walk-aways first and lands the two load-bearing insights in one dense pass — 'every price in the zone beats both walk-aways, so the negotiation is only the split' and 'a $13M cap shrinks THEIR zone, not mine' — with identical verdict (reject $12.5M, counter ~$15.0M, floor $12.0M). The routed v6 run now produces the same moves as first-class completed outputs (m087 contract: both walk-aways valued, zone [$12.0M, $17.5M] width $5.5M midpoint $14.75M mapped, leverage assessed, BATNA-inflation guard) and adds what the baseline asserts rather than demonstrates: m019 quantified exposure per pressure vector (~$2.25M surplus surrendered at the 9% opening share) and m007 floor/ruin math with probability provenance. Residual gap is efficiency: the human executes in one pass; the staged pipeline still spends a pass on scaffolding (m064/m094 context) before the zone math owns the decision.
signals.learning_signal: On negotiation signatures with documented alternatives, the walk-away-map contract (both floors valued, zone width + midpoint computed, leverage read, inflation guard) closes the v5 depth/insight lag — the surplus-share computation at the opening offer is the headline number, not an afterthought; pairing it with adversary-pass exposure quantification and the ruin-screen floor makes the surplus split auditable end-to-end. Dual-route with the stakeholder lens (m064) adds accountability without a second number — it resolves to the walk-away math and must not framework-shop.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m087 in the top-3 for decide/maximize + adversarial signatures and retain the m064 dual-route, but trim efficiency: give the m087 pass the first HOW slot with the zone math as a headline so the walk-away map lands before any scaffolding, and fold the m007 floor computation into the m087 pass (floor = honest walk-away) to avoid double floor derivation. Add the 'surplus share at opening offer' output as a mandatory contract line for all negotiation passes.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style executed its signature move correctly and catastrophically (2.9/5.0) — it read the verifiable family emergency as exactly the moment the binding exists for, invoked the delegated enforcer, and held the line at the price of an irreversible family outcome. The non-routed v5 AI already won (4.9) via an improvised purpose-check; the routed run makes the escape structural: NEG-protective routing held the binding-first reflex out of the lead (its registered inflexibility/commitment-regret weakness is the trap on this signature) and put m063 (contract-interpretation lens) first-class — the release-condition gap becomes a legal drafting finding, each option's precedent is priced (refuse: pledge now governs emergencies it was never built for; fly+pay+document: exceptions expensive/verified/visible; fly+waive: stakes optional), and the mandatory m007 ruin screen (high_stakes) prices the one-shot asymmetry (worst-case of flying is bounded and repairable; worst-case of refusing is ruin). Verdict unchanged and now structural: fly, pay the $10K as designed, document publicly, renegotiate the clause at calm.
signals.learning_signal: On high_stakes pledge-invocation signatures, the router must keep the binding-first style out of the lead and route to a purpose/contract-interpretation pass: classify the case against the contract's TARGET (the temptation it was built to defeat), not its letter — if the case is externally attested and the target premise is absent, the contract does not govern it; audit the instrument itself: a binding without a pre-specified release condition is a design defect, and the defect lowers (not raises) the bar for adaptive action; price the decision with the ruin screen — one-shot check, floor/ruin ordering, probability provenance (external attestation vs self-report); when un-committing, PAY THE STAKES as designed (the penalty IS the teeth; waiving destroys credibility), communicate with documentation, and renegotiate immediately so future exceptions are decided by a calm rule, never by crisis.
signals.suggested_improvement: Harden NEG-protective routing for pledge signatures: standing contract — every invoked pre-commitment must be classified target-present / target-absent with externally attested evidence before honoring; pair the lead pass with the m007 ruin screen whenever high_stakes is in the signature (one-shot asymmetry priced, floor/ruin ordering, provenance on the emergency); include the delegated enforcer as a party in the resolution plan (flying requires the partner's cooperation — bring the partner into the renegotiation); log every pledge case with a missing release condition as a curriculum item (the defect is a contract-design lesson, not a one-off).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 non-routed AI already produced the substantively identical contract (schedule temptation, bind at distance, fail-closed codes, accountant-held unlock + 72h hold, public teeth, pre-set valve, post-launch review) but lost 4.3/4.6 on ordering and ownership — it re-derived the akrasia model inside WHY before applying it (efficiency 3/5) and stated the style's insights later and more cautiously (insight 4/5). The routed run installs m088 as a first-class pass with an explicit six-part completion contract, so schedule-temptation-from-the-record → bind-at-distance → remove-the-option → teeth → pre-set-valve-with-external-reader → commitment-regret-check is the spine of HOW in-frame; m003 and m019 gates add >=6 ranked failure categories (valve mis-tune both directions, accountant override, refund-as-discount and bonus-stack leak channels, admin backdoor) with the un-mitigable residual ($6K/72h are estimates, not frequencies) and quantified exploit exposure in-frame; P1 flags the self-declared $12K panic threshold as interested-party provenance; verdict flips to an AI narrow edge on breadth with the human's core discipline fully matched.
signals.learning_signal: On decide/guarantee signatures with akrasia and a documented trigger, the contract-design ORDER is the deliverable and must lead the pass: (1) schedule the temptation from the record (trigger → window → act) before proposing any mechanism; (2) bind at distance — the design decision belongs to calm-Mira, the window to the contract; (3) remove the tempting option structurally (no pre-created codes, external unlock, hold period) so the temptation cannot execute; (4) add teeth (public stake, transferred authority) heavier than the itch; (5) pre-specify the release valve in data terms with an EXTERNAL reader (threshold + delay + documented demand-side cause) — a valve improvised in the heat of the moment is the temptation wearing a policy, and a valve-less contract gets smashed later; (6) gate the style's own weakness (commitment-regret/inflexibility) by giving the contract a rule-governed escape and a post-launch review with data.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m088 as a first-class contract pass on self-control/drift signatures with its six-part completion contract (temptation scheduled from record; binding at distance; fail-closed; teeth; pre-set valve with external reader; commitment-regret check); pair with m003 on guarantee goals (ranked failure categories incl. the valve-mis-tune residual) and m019 on adversarial contexts (enumerate leak channels: refund-as-discount, bonus stacks, admin backdoor, accountant collusion) with quantified exposure; treat self-declared thresholds ($12K) as interested-party provenance (P1) — the threshold is data, not fact.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style trace executed its documented failure — dithering rationalized as optionality (deadline dismissed as pressure, 'expensive != closed' applied to a door that expires in 10 days, the protected door never tested for survival under commitment). The routed dual-route (m044 incentives + m063 contract structure) plus the m019 adversary gate caught the expiry asymmetry structurally: the protected door (Honkoh) survives signing; the door deferral closes (Nordik) is certain, time-limited, and irreplaceable in the window.
signals.learning_signal: On deadline signatures with an optionality-flavored framing, run the DOOR-INVARIANCE test: does the door being protected stay open under commitment? If yes, non-commitment is option-destroying, not option-preserving — commit-with-escape (a contract clause) beats non-commitment; price the deferral branch (negative here) and treat expiry as a fact, not a pressure tactic.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the door-invariance test as a mandatory sub-check of the m089 guard and of any optionality-framed case routed elsewhere (m089 was correctly absent from top-3 here); on deadline+adversarial signatures dual-route m044+m063 with the m019 adversary pass quantifying the deadline — keeps the trap-exit structural rather than emergent; add 'expiry class' (now-or-never vs evergreen) to the router's context triggers.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human trace is near-gold — doors counted first, priced as p x impact, meta-door named, deferral premium and cost-of-optionality stated — and the routed m089 pass matched every move first-class (the v5 AI's gaps: door inventory after the cost model, meta-door late, mechanical insights). Residual gap: the door values rest on documented-but-estimated probabilities (no measured frequency data), and the 12-month-or-first-trigger checkpoint is a judgment, not calibrated.
signals.learning_signal: Optionality is a first-class analytical move on decide/guarantee signatures with priced future scenarios: count the doors FIRST (before any cost arithmetic), price every door as p x exposure, count the meta-door (deferring the decision itself), state the cost of optionality, and bind the optionality with an exercise checkpoint — a door without an exercise plan is hoarding, which is exactly the board-history risk the case punishes.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m089 on decide/guarantee signatures with deadline/high_stakes context, paired with the R3 m003+m007 gates; add 'meta-door count' and 'cost of optionality stated' to the m089 completion contract (the two signature human moves the v5 AI missed); make the exercise checkpoint a contract output, not a suggestion.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style executed its core move correctly and failed on it (MVP theater) — hypothesis formed, smallest experiment run, pre-committed bar beaten (80% ≥ 40%), 'validated, commit' — but the pilot gated the LOWEST-risk assumption (clinical adoption) while the gating facts (EMR integration certification, security, HIPAA, production false-alarm rate) were never testable by any small experiment, and the reflex at the real commitment was another un-testable sandbox pilot that blows the 5-week board gate and slips go-live ~10 months. The v6 routed run held the v5 win and made the anti-theater guard mechanical: the m033 experiment-design contract proves the sandbox pilot has no control (sandbox ≠ production), no outcome measure (certification is an audit fact), and no decision-changing result; the m094 critical-reading pass names the COO's validate-first slogan as the rhetorical trap (it smuggles the premise that a small experiment CAN validate this commitment); P2 tempo mode prices the 10-month slip and commits at DO (deposit + reviews now, parallel instrumentation, staged rollout with a pre-committed false-alarm-rate stop gate as the real experiment).
signals.learning_signal: On deadline/decide signatures with a pilot result in hand, the gating facts are often not falsifiable within the window: the smallest responsible unit is the commitment itself, and the production rollout — staged cutover with a pre-committed monitoring gate — IS the experiment. Install the anti-theater gate before approving any new pilot: (a) does it have a control, a measured outcome, and a result that could change the decision within the horizon? (b) is any gating fact an audit/lead-time commitment that no experiment can produce? if either fails, the pilot is a stall priced at the window; pair the experiment-design contract (m033) with critical-reading (m094) on validated-vendor adoption signatures, and keep tempo mode on deadline signatures so commit-at-DO beats the experiment reflex.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the anti-theater gate as a standing module: before any pilot is approved, require (1) control + blinding + exact outcome measure, (2) a result that can change the decision within the window, (3) a testability partition naming which gating facts no experiment can produce (those become commitment items, not evidence gaps); pair m033 with m094 on vendor-adoption signatures (rhetoric detection of 'validation' claims); keep P2 tempo mode on deadline signatures so the decision commits at DO with the experiment staged into the rollout.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: both produced the identical decision rule (fake-door first, 2 wks/$2K, ≥120/800 or ≥20% CTR vs baseline; concierge second, 3 wks/$12K, ≥40% weekly-active; $450K build gated on both; not-tested set declared) — v5's gap was ordering and ownership: the AI generated a full alternative set before the smallest probe was obvious, reached the insight only in REVIEW, and scored 3/5 efficiency vs the human's 5/5. The v6 routed run closed that gap in-pass: the m070 evidence-graded SWOT dropped the 71% survey as a strength in-frame (opinion, not behavior), the m073 strategic-interaction pass made the fake door the first countermove to the VP's commitment move, and the m019 adversary gate added a calibration the human asserted but did not ground — CTR read against the firm's baseline email-open rate, not the raw 800, so a 20% CTR is ~50% of openers. The human retained the efficiency edge (one first-pass move vs routed machinery) and ownership of the signature line; the routed AI retained the uncertainty/calibration edge.
signals.learning_signal: On decide/maximize product signatures with stated-preference evidence, routing an evidence-graded SWOT (m070) + strategic-interaction pass (m073) with the m019 adversary gate converts 'smallest behavioral probe first' from a REVIEW repair into first-pass output, and adds threshold calibration (CTR vs baseline engagement) the pure style asserts: pre-commit bars BEFORE the email sends, grade every SWOT item by evidence strength and drop unsupported ones (a 71% stated-intent survey fails the bar), and keep the test-vs-product declaration (what the probe does NOT test + the earned second loop) as a packet line.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m070+m073 dual-route on product/decide signatures (router confident=no, m084 synthesis context); make baseline-rate calibration (CTR vs baseline open/click rates on the reachable population) a standing m019 contract line whenever thresholds are set against a reachable list; keep the m090 contract — smallest experiment producing a learning signal on the core assumption + MVP-theater guard — as a mandatory packet line on assumption-gated commitments.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style trace executed its registry-listed weakness (feedback-dependent, plateau-focused) at full fidelity — it framed 14 incidents as a skill plateau, chunked debugging skill into drills, accepted truncated log excerpts as drill fidelity, never audited the feedback channel, and never named tooling or the cross-shard design smell (human 2.3). The routed m028+m018+m019 route caught the trap structurally: lateral escape from the practice frame, steelman of the regime's strongest form (still fails), adversary quantification of the truncation vector, and the m003 gate. Residual gap vs the v5 AI (4.9): the conclusion is unchanged — v6's gain is structural (quantified exposure per vector, branch-priced verdict incl. failure branches) rather than a new finding.
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose/decide signatures where a practice/plateau framing is offered, run the FEEDBACK-VALIDITY AUDIT before prescribing more practice: is the practice signal true and complete? (truncated failing statements + no telemetry + 45-min build → drills' verdicts are built from a corrupted signal); then discriminate plateau-vs-ceiling with the evidence (9/14 incidents sharing one root cause that was mis-diagnosed twice because logs truncated it makes skill deficit implausible); fix tooling/design first (structured logging with full statement capture, lock-wait/query-timing telemetry, CI fast-feedback, deterministic repro harness), then RE-GATE practice on the clean channel — drills resume only if a skill gap is then demonstrated.
signals.suggested_improvement: When the router detects a practice/plateau framing (m091 family triggers), route the escape style (m028) + adversary (m019) into top-3 and make the feedback-channel provenance audit a mandatory first-class pass — the practice trap is the model's documented NEG failure mode; add 'feedback-channel provenance checked before prescribing practice' to the m091 completion contract; keep the m003 inversion gate (ranked failure categories) on guarantee signatures.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style human trace is near-gold — baseline probe before planning, chunk hierarchy with per-chunk measurable mastery bars, a quantitative 70-85% edge band, prediction-then-check feedback with an error taxonomy, plateau detector wired from week 4 — and the routed m091 pass matched every move first-class (the v5 AI's gaps: numeric edge band and designed-in plateau detector deferred to REVIEW, losing 4.7/3.9). Residual gap: the band thresholds (70-85%, <15%/2wk) and the C3 (statistics/join order) two-week allocation are standards, not learner-calibrated — the Friday pass/fail gates are the calibration mechanism, and the human does not supply empirical learning-rate data either.
signals.learning_signal: Skill-acquisition planning on decide/guarantee signatures is computable when four contract outputs are first-class: (1) chunk decomposition with a measurable mastery bar per chunk, dependency-ordered; (2) practice-at-the-edge as a numeric success band with adjustment logic (above 85% raise difficulty, below 60% drop, hold inside) — never 'hard problems'; (3) immediate specific feedback (prediction-then-check before EXPLAIN ANALYZE + per-session error taxonomy + weekly mentor reconciliation); (4) plateau detection designed in from week 4 with a trigger metric and named contingencies — never 'practice more', always re-diagnose the failing chunk. The bars and the band are one system: the bar says which chunk to push, the band says how hard.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m091 on decide/guarantee signatures with deadline context, paired with the R3 m003 gate; add 'baseline probe of current ability before planning' (m031 context move) and 'plateau detector wired from week 4 with named contingencies' as explicit m091 contract items — the two moves the v5 non-routed AI reached only at REVIEW; on deadline signatures keep tempo mode (P2) with week-level pass/fail gates as the commit structure.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style executed its own machinery flawlessly (500 cards, 1-2-4-7-14-30, ~28 of 30 h) and produced day-21 recall ~90% with zero transfer — its registered weakness fired on schedule. The routed run avoids the trap structurally: the router's history ref (m092-NEG-01) keeps m092 off this signature and routes m031 (scientific method) probe-first, steel-mans the SRS plan in its strongest form before rejecting it, and applies the m092 contract's comprehension-not-retention caveat as a blocking gate (cards for un-understood endpoints = transcription). Residual gap: the plan still trusts the team's data and the day-1 probe's validity as a discriminator; the probe outcome is a genuine priced branch (pass → facts-lead with SRS as co-lead) that remains unresolved at decision time.
signals.learning_signal: The failure mode is SRS theater — a perfect expanding schedule on a comprehension bottleneck. The protective route is hypothesis→experiment→update: (1) run a cheap discriminating probe of the PREDICTOR skill (trace/apply/use) before scheduling anything; (2) partition material into fact-like items (SRS-eligible) vs understanding (not decomposable — recall of isolated cards does not compose into a model); (3) price overhead explicitly — hours consumed by the schedule vs hours left for the binding activity; (4) tie the plan's metric to the transfer metric, never recall; (5) on learning-plan signatures, pair any SRS-style pass with the comprehension-not-retention caveat as a blocking gate.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m031 (+m015/m018 context) on learning-plan signatures, with m092's known failure as the protective route's reason; add to the m031 pass contract: (a) a one-hour probe of the predictor skill as the mandatory first experiment, (b) an overhead line in the alternatives table (schedule hours vs binding-activity hours), (c) the fact-like vs understanding partition as a blocking gate on card production — transcription is not encoding; record the probe result as a priced branch in the packet (pass → facts-lead with SRS co-lead).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: identical schedule and arithmetic (A 0/0.99, B 0.94/0.40, C 0.77/0.58, max-min 0.58) — the routed pass runs the schedule-first move the v5 signal prescribed: every candidate scored at every binding deadline BEFORE any preference, the mechanism (final-review placement dominates; gaps double as h doubles) and the single-date subtlety as first-class HOW outputs rather than REVIEW afterthoughts, and the packet carries h-provenance, a skip rule, and the degradation envelope (worst-case-is-B). Residual gap: the human still owns the mechanism in one un-staged first pass with zero machinery ('decay is the only enemy, and I know its shape — placement, not effort, decides'); the routed run reaches the same answer through contract plus gates, and the h-doubling model itself is trusted, not validated against the cohort.
signals.learning_signal: On fully-specified placement problems with a given decay model, schedule-first computation IS the method: score every candidate at every binding deadline before any preference, choose max-min over binding dates (never the single-date optimum), and make last-review-placement + degradation envelope packet lines — the completion contract converts the style's one-pass elegance into a reproducible output at no scaffolding cost when combined with the closed-scope fast path.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m092 on diagnose/guarantee/maximize signatures with c:deadline,high_stakes; require the completion contract (spaced items with expanding intervals + retrieval-based review + comprehension-not-retention caveat) to emit in order: (a) per-candidate retention at EVERY binding date from the curve before any selection; (b) a last-review-placement line and a binding-minimum line; (c) a skip-recovery rule and degradation envelope in the packet; run the m003 top-5-capped inversion gate and the m007 ruin screen as confirmations under the closed-scope fast path so the pass lands in one pass.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline executed its signature move and it backfired — it wrote the simple story ('just add more retries — computers are fast, extra requests are nothing'), read it back through the child's question ('doesn't that make it MORE struggling?'), smoothed the objection over ('it's busy, not broken'), and declared the explanation complete because it explained simply, validating elegance instead of truth (approving Dana's rule). The v5 AI already won this on the three-fact check (saturation = amplification, non-idempotent = double-settle, rising timeouts = persistent). The v6 routed run hardens the win: the m028 pass breaks 'retries are free' as the first move and lands the honest one-liner ('Trying again is also work — and some tries can't be undone'); m018's steelman shows Dana's rule fails in its strongest form; m019's vectors quantify double-settle, herd, and retry-storm; and the mandatory m003 (6 ranked failure categories incl. double-settle, un-mitigable residual named) and m007 (blanket retries ruin-adjacent with a one-shot double-charge branch; floor = retry less, telemetry-anchored) gates convert the rejection into a priced decision.
signals.learning_signal: The Feynman failure mode is validating explanatory elegance instead of correctness — the method checks 'can I explain it simply?' and has no step that checks 'is the simple explanation true against the actual system?' — and the v6 routing answer is the oversimplification guard as a deliverable contract: on 'simple-answer' cases the routed assumption-break (m028: break 'retries are free' -> trying again is work, some tries can't be undone) supplies the honest simple sentence, and the mandatory protective gates (m003 on g:guarantee, m007 on c:high_stakes) force every clause of the simplified rule to survive the operative constraints (saturation = amplification, non-idempotent = irreversible, rising timeouts = persistent, not transient). A simplified answer is safe only where the load-bearing complexity is named in plain words and kept — 'what the simple version erases' must be an explicit line, and comprehension of a child is the acceptance test only when the constraint check has already passed.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m028/m018/m019 routing with m003+m007 gates on high_stakes guarantee signatures (trap-avoided; negative split held, T3 protected); add 'what the simple version erases' as a mandatory decision-packet line (rule 36-style completion contract: the load-bearing complexity named in plain words — here: each retry is new work on an overloaded machine and some retries are irreversible); extend the m028 pass contract with the flip move (under saturation retry LESS, not more) for capacity-symptom signatures, and record the retries-as-commons insight (herd = tragedy of the commons with a machine; the shared protocol is the institution) as a standing m019 baseline-risk check.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: both sides produce the identical correct explanation (heat-mover loop: refrigerant boils inside absorbing heat, compressor squeezes it hot, back coils condense it releasing heat to the room; pump does work; insulation slows the leak) and both name the same gap ('the fridge makes cold' treats cold as a substance; the child's 'where does the cold come from?' cuts the story at 'makes'). The v5 AI loss was timing and instrument: it reached the break only after generating and rejecting alternatives in HOW, while the human used the child's question as a first-pass scalpel on the naive sentence ('cold isn't a thing to add, it's a leak to fight'). The v6 routed run closes it: the m028 assumption-break pass breaks Priya's own sentence as the FIRST move (cold-as-substance assumption -> heat-mover), the m044 stakeholder pass finds the hidden requirement (a one-line truth so sales cannot revert to 'makes cold'), and m084 reads the stall as a free-rider tell (everyone profits from the shared shallow story; nobody owns the gap). The break is now first-class instead of post-hoc, at a small efficiency cost (dual-route + packet vs the human's single pure pass).
signals.learning_signal: On explanation tasks the diagnostic instrument is the naive sentence in the user's own words, and the routed assumption-break pass (m028) is the correct first-class move: enumerate the assumptions the on-table claim makes ('cold is a substance the fridge produces'), break the load-bearing one, and the breakdown point IS the learning target — name it precisely (cold = absence of heat; the fridge moves heat out, it does not manufacture cold) before any alternative generation. The child-level questions ('where does the cold come from?', 'why is the back warm?', 'why doesn't it leak back?') are the acceptance test, and the oversimplification guard is the re-explanation's completion contract: plain words must carry the mechanism (evaporation absorbs, compression heats, condensation releases, insulation slows), never a cold-as-substance phrasing. Stakeholder and coordination passes add the non-reasoning half of the win: the one-line truth is the deliverable that stops a sales team free-riding on the shallow story.
signals.suggested_improvement: Make the naive-claim assumption-break a standing first move of the m028 pass for explanation/understanding tasks (contract: enumerate assumptions of the on-table claim, break the load-bearing one, name the gap as the learning target, re-explain and accept the user's own questions); require the decision packet to contain the one-line plain truth (m044 hidden-requirement output) and the acceptance-test questions as verification evidence; keep the dual-route (m028+m044, m084 context) on simple-concept/high-stakes-signature explanation cases where routing confidence is low.

signals.human_model: Critical Reading / Socratic Questioning of Texts
signals.key_gap: the v5 human baseline failed its own style's registered weakness ('can miss the forest'): it applied a science-publication evidence bar to a time-sensitive operations decision — discounted the records-corroborated n=1 anecdote and the Bridge-M fingerprint as 'analogy and anecdote', treated the $300K-vs-$60M asymmetry as rhetorical 'catastrophic framing', and demanded the 4-week FE analysis as a precondition, keeping the bridge open. The routed v6 run (unconfident → dual-route m018 steel-man + m019 adversary, with m003 inversion and m007 ruin gates) classified the decision class first, verified the anecdote against the maintenance records, priced the negative branches (break-even p = 0.5%; delay cost $0.6–12M for p ∈ 1–20%), closed for 72h with FE parallelized, and downgraded 'will collapse' to a non-dismissive calibration note.
signals.learning_signal: Critical-reading passes under decision pressure must be gated by decision-class fit: the evidence bar belongs to the decision (time-sensitivity, reversibility, downside asymmetry), not the genre; a corroborated anecdote + analog fingerprint can be decision-grade when the action is cheap and reversible and the downside catastrophic; an unquantified probability is a reason to reason in provenance-backed bands, never a reason to refuse action; tone and overstatement are calibration findings about the messenger, not grounds to invert a cheap-to-verify, catastrophic-to-ignore claim.
signals.suggested_improvement: When routing is unconfident on high_stakes signatures, dual-route away from pure text-critique styles toward steel-man + adversary with mandatory m007 ruin screen and m003 inversion (R4 guarantee prepend); install the forest-vs-trees guard (m094 contract) as a STANDING gate on all text-analysis passes — classify close-or-wait/act-or-study before any evidence critique, ask 'is this critique decision-relevant?' and 'what does waiting cost in expected value?' per critique, and require an expected-value line in the packet whenever NEEDS_EVIDENCE/APPROXIMATED is considered.

signals.human_model: Critical Reading / Socratic Questioning of Texts
signals.key_gap: vs the v5 human baseline: the baseline won v5 on flaw PRIORITIZATION (load-bearing arithmetic falsified by the flat contract before weighing rhetoric), an explicit inversion move, and the $25K-trip/Friday-deadline treated as a weighted decision input. The routed v6 pass installed all three as completed first-class outputs (m094 contract: impact-ranked claims/evidence/premises/rhetoric/omissions with graded evidence; P1 who-benefits scan in WHY; deadline-as-pressure-lever in the frame) and added ruin/adversary gates (m007 outcome distribution + provenance; m019 pressure vectors with quantified exposure) that the baseline lacked; the recompute is identical (+$2.15M vs the memo's $5.7M claim).
signals.learning_signal: On persuasion-typed text audits the style's edge over a raw audit is not more flaw-finding (both found all 8) but flaw prioritization and incentive weighting: identify the load-bearing assumption whose failure flips the recommendation, verify it by the cheapest decisive check (the docs' arithmetic), rank rhetoric as corroboration, and treat deadlines/incentives as weighted decision inputs; graded evidence quality and a who-benefits scan make this a completion contract rather than a REVIEW afterthought.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m094-first routing on adversarial+deadline+high_stakes signatures with the impact-ranking contract (flaws ordered by effect on the verdict, top flaw re-verified by an independent route); make the P1 who-benefits scan and deadline-as-pressure-lever check standing WHAT-frame items for persuasion documents; keep the m019 adversary pass paired so pressure vectors carry quantified exposure and baseline-risk comparison.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline executed the style's core move (pilot re-check, tree kept) then failed as designed — it treated the cohort's cue collapse as a sampling problem, demanded the 6-week validation study as a gate, and refused the re-fitted interaction model as 'in-sample overfit theater'; the v6 run converted the trap into a checkable flip point: the single-cue hypothesis test (best cue 26/40 = 65%, interaction 34/40 = 85% => no cue >= threshold => signal is combinatorial), the P2 tempo price on the stall (6 weeks vs 2-week peak, ~1-2 atypical MIs per shift), and steel-man/confirmation-bias checks (m018/m079) before adopting the re-fitted rule with an observation net and an n=60 monitoring gate.
signals.learning_signal: Cue-selection fragility is the tree style's registered failure mode: when top-cue validity breaks mid-wave, pure frugality has no in-window recovery and its transparency does not substitute for evidence — a mandatory cue-collapse hypothesis test on current data, a combinatorial-signal fallback (interaction acceptance with a pre-committed monitoring gate), and tempo-mode cost-of-delay turn the trap into an explicit, checkable decision point.
signals.suggested_improvement: Pair every one-cue-at-a-time tree pass with (a) a single-cue validity hypothesis test on the CURRENT data before any keep/re-order decision, (b) a combinatorial-signal fallback rule (accept the interaction model with an n=60 revert gate, ST-positive observation net), (c) tempo-mode commit on deadline signatures so a validation study is priced as a gate candidate, never accepted as one; keep the m003 inversion gate and route m091+m018+m079 on regime-shift signatures (verified protective: NEG split held).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline owned the count-first move and the 'extra cues are last year's noise' mechanism first-pass; the v6 routed run matched it by running the frugal-rule completion contract (one-cue-at-a-time hand count, cue-decay audit, FN/FP asymmetry framed as the decision) and the m003 inversion gate, and added a dominated-branch price (3-cue variant C, 35/40) and an uncertainty packet (n=40 SE, quarterly re-audit) the pure style left implicit. Note: the router did not route the tree style itself for this home-turf case (top3 m013/m024/m039) — a recall miss to log as a curriculum item even though the decision was correct.
signals.learning_signal: On rule-selection signatures (medical/product, decide/diagnose/guarantee), count-first verification of the minimal rule must precede any trust in the complex model, and the decision should be framed by error DIRECTION (FN vs FP) before any accuracy comparison; every extra cue is one more chance to misfire, and that is checkable arithmetic, not an opinion.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the frugal-rule pass (hand-count the minimal rule, cue-decay audit, FN/FP asymmetry first, stop when the decision is clear) as a standing completion contract on rule-selection signatures even when the tree style is not top-3; keep dual-route m013+m024 with the m003 inversion gate; add the router recall miss (tree style absent from top-3 on its own home-turf case) to the curriculum gap log.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline executed the style's core move and failed on it — saw nine of ten converging at +/-2.8%, priced convergence as confidence, averaged to 211.8M (error 27.8M, +15% vs the 184M actual), and its robust-mean reflex would have absorbed or trimmed the one correct signal (I's 186M, error 2M); it never read the provenance. The v5 AI already ran the dependence audit; the v6 run converted the trap into gate-checked machinery — m019 red-team made the shared leaked-IMS document and the draft-sharing group enumerated vectors with quantified exposure (~27.8M), m018 steel-man collapsed the herd's case AND the outlier-robust reflex, and the m003 inversion gate forced >=6 ranked failure categories + never/always reframes the v5 packet lacked. Router recall miss logged: m096 itself was NOT top-3 on its own NEG home-turf case (top3 m018/m019/m024) — protective here, but the herding check should be routable from inside the style.
signals.learning_signal: Herding blindness is the ensemble's registered failure mode and the trap is doubled: a tight spread under a shared input is the inverse of confidence (correlation mimics precision), and the 'outlier-robust' reflex trims exactly the structurally independent estimate that is the signal. The dependence verdict (enumerate named inputs, flag shared documents and draft-sharing groups, treat tight-spread-without-audited-independence as a red flag) must precede any mean; the packet must state whether error cancellation applies — when it does not, forecast from the independent channel with a widened interval and reject the herd mean with its shared-error reason.
signals.suggested_improvement: Add the ensemble style to routing on dependence-auditable aggregation signatures for NEG cases too (router recall miss: m096 absent from top-3 on m096-NEG-01 — the herding check should run from inside the style, not only via m018/m019); keep dual-route m018+m019 with the m003 inversion gate (verified protective: NEG split held); install the dependence verdict as a WHY-stage gate on every aggregation task so the trap fires before the mean is computed.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline and the routed run produced the identical forecast (mean 3,105, SD ~216, 95% band 2,675-3,535, truth 3,100) with the same independence audit and no-trim stance; the baseline's v5 edge was landing the audit as the FIRST move and owning the signature lines first-pass ('whoever's closest is luck, the average is structure'; 'if they all read the same report, averaging is herding and the spread is a lie'). The routed m096 pass made those first-class completion-contract outputs (collect -> independence audit -> average -> spread -> dependency/herding check) at S1, so the v6 run states them on the same pass the arithmetic lands, and adds packet-level uncertainty (hidden-common-input risk, staffing off the upper bound 3,537) the pure style left implicit.
signals.learning_signal: On aggregation/forecast signatures, the ensemble move is fully specified by its completion contract: (1) audit independence BEFORE any arithmetic — enumerate each source's data channel, check shared feeds and draft-sharing, emit a verdict; (2) average and state the spread (SD/range) — the mean without the spread is a lie; (3) report aggregation stability (mean ~= median ~= trimmed) as the fingerprint of independence, in one line; (4) do not trim a structurally real channel — trimming is cherry-picking; (5) declare the failure condition (shared input -> herding) in the packet. When the routed style IS the method, the pass must produce these as first-class outputs — the mean must not be reached before the precondition is stated.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m096 as the primary route on independence-auditable aggregation signatures (home-turf hit: router routed m096 top-1, confident, on its own POS case); make the five-step contract (audit -> mean -> spread -> stability fingerprint -> failure condition) the S1 mandatory outputs; the closed-scope fast path (P8) with alternatives-after-the-fact (median/trimmed as stability confirmation only, not opening moves) is what closed the v5 efficiency gap (3 -> 4).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style executed its core move and failed on class selection — it adopted the industry survey (n=412, surface label 'e-commerce project') over the firm's own 9-build history, ported the 1.9× factor across classes, and forecast 9–12 months against a true 5–7-week class (2.9). The routed run never routed the outside-view module (router historical evidence: style loss on this signature) and reached the same verdict the v5 AI found emergently — narrow class as the forecast basis — through dual-route m044+m070 (consultant-incentive provenance, feature-match ledger grading) plus the divergence rule (6× gap flags misclassification, not bias) as a standing gate; the trap is now avoided at routing level, not by luck.
signals.learning_signal: Reference-class forecasting's dominant failure is class selection, not distribution reading: two candidate classes with opposite distributions in plain view are decided by structural membership features (platform, team, spec status, integration novelty), never by sample size or surface label — and the router should treat the style's loss record on a signature as evidence against routing it, converting the trap into a protective gate.
