signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the outside-view module OUT of the route on signatures whose historical record shows the class-selection trap (m097-NEG-01), and install the class-selection gate as a standing protective check: name the deciding structural features, grade each candidate class against them, refuse cross-class factor porting (P10), and apply the divergence rule (inside estimate far outside a candidate class flags misclassification, not bias). Add the re-test trigger on scope change to the m044 pass checklist.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure outside-view baseline is the gold standard here (class named, distribution read, plan placed at 3rd percentile, Aurora reclassified as 2/60 tail, deal structured on the class, adjustment bounded by the team's own ceiling) — the routed dual pass reached full content parity first-pass and added what the pure style leaves implicit: a P1 input-provenance audit (Marta's deal-shaped incentive, vendor commitments as the forecast's most interested parties), the weakness-gate class-selection test, and a priced failure branch (fixed $1.5M price vs 21-month reality kills the vendor). The non-routed v5 AI lost this case 3.6–4.9 by factor-calibrating the anchor (16 mo) instead of forecasting from the distribution; the routed pass closes that to parity.
signals.learning_signal: On estimate/predict tasks with a checkable base-rate distribution in frame, the distribution must be the forecast basis — a completion contract forcing class-named / base-rate-stated / inside-outside-separated converts the pure style's move into a reproducible first-class pass and kills the factor-on-anchor failure mode; provenance of the inside estimate (who benefits from the number) is what lets the agent refuse it without appearing contrarian.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the outside-view pass routed on estimate/predict signatures with given base rates (dual-route with m044); extend its checklist with (a) interested-party provenance on the inside estimate (beneficiary named per input), (b) the class-selection test as a standing weakness gate (structural membership features + adjustment bounded by the team's own ceiling), and (c) percentile placement of the plan (z-score AND empirical count) stated in WHY before any alternatives are generated — the percentile placement is what the v5 WHY missed.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style trace executed its documented failure — full pre-registration before acting (10 live minutes, ≈$120K of ritual) restored service at T+15 ($180K) against the routed run's T+6 ($72K); the v6 run's dual-route (m031 hypothesis-as-mitigation + m044 stakeholder incentives) plus tempo mode (P2) and the R4 m003 inversion gate (ritual-latency = failure category #1) make the trap-exit structural, while the m098 contract is fully served by the parallel retro-forecast (decision; E[recovery] ≈ 6 [5, 10]; falsifier = errors not < 5% in 10 min → redeploy + escalate) written while the fix runs.
signals.learning_signal: Pre-registration's value is post-hoc learning, not action precedence: on deadline/cost-per-minute signatures the journal must be written around the action (timeboxed ≤ 2 min before, or a retro-forecast in parallel) with the falsifier for the action's theory registered before that theory's outcome is confirmed — a falsifier written while the fix runs preserves every learning property (hindsight armor, base-rate update) at zero latency cost; the full ritual adds only avoidable loss, and the m031 move (the mitigation IS the discriminating test when it is cheap and reversible) collapses hypothesis-testing and response into one action.
signals.suggested_improvement: Make tempo mode (P2) mandatory on any signature with deadline context: cost-of-delay computed at META, commit at DO, and the m098 pre-registration degrades to a parallel/timeboxed journal containing (1) the action, (2) expected-outcome interval, (3) falsifier + branch action — never blocking the action; keep the R4 m003 inversion gate with 'ritual latency' as a ranked failure category on urgent signatures, and record the retro-forecast fields (interval + falsifier) explicitly in the decision packet so the timing advantage is structural, not incidental.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure pre-registration baseline is near-gold — falsifier tied to the 1.5-pt break-even, pre-committed disable+revert, unhedged HIT verdict, base rate 7/11 — and the v6 routed run matched every graded item first-class (falsifier anchored to the cost threshold, not the forecast; hit-branch pre-committed; verdict exactly HIT with a hindsight audit; base-rate update) while adding the m003 inversion gate (7 ranked failure categories) and the m070 evidence-graded SWOT. Residual gap: the expected range [1.0, 5.0] is a judgment blend and the 7/11 update is arithmetic — nothing substantive separates the runs (margin 0.2, contested per J1).
signals.learning_signal: Pre-registration is a first-class module, not a narrative flourish: on estimate/guarantee signatures with a later verifiable outcome, the completion contract (decision + expected-outcome distribution + falsification criteria written BEFORE the outcome + hindsight-bias armor + post-hoc-drift guard) must run before the reveal — the falsifier threshold derives from the decision's economics (break-even), never from the expectation range (self-flattering anchoring); the post-reveal verdict must cite the pre-registered text and issue exactly HIT/NO-HIT with a hindsight audit, and the learning updates the base rate, not the confidence; the CI's width (0.9 ± 0.6 = a clean kill) shows the threshold, not the point estimate, decides.
signals.suggested_improvement: Install the m098 pass with its completion contract on any signature with a later verifiable outcome (estimate/predict/guarantee): pre-register before the outcome exists — decision, interval expectation, economics-derived falsifier, pre-committed hit-branch — then at reveal issue the verdict against the pre-registered text (outside the interval is HIT, never 'directionally consistent'/'close call') plus a base-rate update; pair with the R4 m003 inversion gate and m070 SWOT evidence grades to keep the falsifier economics-anchored and the packet free of unsupported optimism.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human executed the style's registered weakness (measurement politics) perfectly — it computed a clean update (prior 0.65 -> posterior ~0.01) on a gamed likelihood (engineers self-code tickets and are paid on closed-ticket count; rework is re-logged as NEW tickets with the re-open field never instrumented, so rework is invisible BY DESIGN; the Region A pilot's dispatcher routed hard jobs away) and mandated the company-wide rollout, where the anecdote channel (veterans' direct observation, 45% vs 8% callbacks) was the honest one. The non-routed v5 AI already caught this via a discovered channel audit; the routed v6 run makes it structural: the P7 measurement audit fires automatically because metrics drive pay, the m019 adversary pass contract forces the baseline-risk line and quantified exposure per attack vector, and the m003 inversion gate ranks rollout-now as the top failure — the update is HELD with NEEDS_EXPERIMENT status, prior-weighting toward the honest channel, and pre-committed reversal thresholds.
signals.learning_signal: A Bayesian update is only as good as its likelihood, and the likelihood only as good as its measurement channel: when a metric drives compensation, the channel audit (who codes the outcome, what the metric excludes by design, whether the pilot was clean) must precede the update and gate the rollout — updating garbage likelihoods with full discipline is disciplined garbage (GIGO), and an honest anecdotal channel can outrank a gamed metric.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m034/m099 measurement-audit (P7) trigger 'metrics drive pay/policy' as a standing WHY gate alongside the m006 provenance audit; require a likelihood-provenance line (who coded the outcome, what is invisible by design, pilot integrity) in every update packet; and admit NEEDS_EXPERIMENT as the packet status for unverified likelihoods, with pre-committed reversal thresholds before any posterior-driven rollout.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human's winning sequence was first-move economy and insight ownership — elicit the org belief as a prior WITH provenance, define the measured outcome by its likelihood before the data arrives, update (prior odds 1:3 x LR e^24 -> posterior ~10^10:1), license policy by effect size, and land the said-vs-did channel line ('churn must be measured, not heard'; 'update, don't discard') in one pass; the non-routed v5 AI reached the identical posterior and policy but generated an alternatives set before the update was obvious (efficiency 3 vs 5), and landed the channel insight only via machinery (depth/insight behind). The routed v6 pass (org belief as prior + measured-outcome update + evidence-quality gate + org-calibration note in WHY, m003 inversion gate, closed-scope fast path) installs the human's first move as a structural first-class pass: prior-with-provenance stated before any generation, likelihood defined before the data, checkable arithmetic, and an org-calibration note ('the org's 0.75 carried less information than noise') the human merely implied.
signals.learning_signal: For org-belief decision problems the org's stated belief must be elicited as a prior WITH provenance as the first move of WHY — not as one alternative among alternatives — and the update (prior odds x full-data LR, posterior stated, calibration note) must precede any policy generation; the said-vs-did channel downgrade (exit interviews = stated preference, cohort = behavior) belongs in the provenance gate, and policy must be licensed by effect size with a pre-committed re-measurement.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m006/m099 org-belief pass contract (prior+provenance -> likelihood-before-data -> checkable update -> effect-size policy -> quarterly re-measurement with segment control) as a standing first-class pass for decide/estimate signatures with org/finance domains; apply the closed-scope fast path (P8) whenever the measurement is fully specified in the task — the update is the first move, not the last; and require an org-calibration sentence ('what the org believed vs what the data licensed') in the packet.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline's registered weakness operated exactly as designed — the double pass manufactured elasticity/COGS/fixed-cost attacks on a closed-scope arithmetic request, hedged the verdict ('depends on elasticity >= 3.6'), and blew the 5-minute deadline. The routed v6 run spent the dual route (m018 steel-man + m019 adversary) attacking the PROPOSAL with quantified exposure (break-even 5,455 units, 5% cushion, elasticity >= 3.6 bound), ran the m003 inversion gate, and the P8 closed-scope fast path + tempo mode delivered the direct number in-window.
signals.learning_signal: On closed-scope + deadline signatures there is no hypothesis to rebuild and nothing to falsify — the answer IS the computation; a falsification pass aimed at given inputs manufactures scope. Protective passes must attack the decision/proposal, not the arithmetic; the P8 fast path must compress the stages under tempo; the deferral of out-of-scope sensitivity is a packet line, not a hedge.
signals.suggested_improvement: Route m018+m019 dual-route with the m003 gate on estimate/guarantee + deadline arithmetic signatures (router confident=no), always paired with P8 closed-scope fast path; add 'quantified exposure vs baseline (break-even distance, cushion %, threshold bound)' as the m019 completion contract line; keep the post-call sensitivity deferral as a mandatory packet line so scope discipline never suppresses a needed follow-up.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 AI reached the right plan (20 vans + 8 drivers, ~$1.4M) but ran its falsification as a post-selection premortem, while the baseline ran the attack pass first-class (utilization-as-headroom, norm constancy, cap flexibility — each tested with recorded outcomes, the norm attack revising the rebuild upward). The routed v6 pass makes that contract first-class (falsifier per load-bearing claim, pass may revise the rebuild) and closes the gap; residual baseline edge: first-pass naming of the trap (efficiency).
signals.learning_signal: On capacity/pool-constraint signatures the combo's value is the ORDER of the passes: rebuild the binding-pool arithmetic (min(vans, drivers, docks, pick) x deliveries/van-day), then attack each load-bearing claim with a stated falsifier and recorded outcome BEFORE finalizing — the falsification pass must be allowed to change the rebuild (norm-degradation attack -> margin + re-measure point), and utilization/headroom evidence must be provenance-graded as interested-party reading.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m100 first-class on decide/estimate/maximize + deadline capacity signatures (route confident=yes); make 'falsifier per load-bearing claim + tested outcome, pass may revise the rebuild' the standing m100/m032 completion contract; grade utilization/headroom evidence by provenance (who benefits) at WHY via the P1 audit.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the v5 human baseline won this case on depth (derived-constant 15.7 kg/m2 verification) and calibrated uncertainty (priced range); the routed pass installed the calibration anchor and the m007 ruin screen (distribution, floor, provenance, decline/restructure) as first-class contracts, and steel-manned the labor-dominates counter-position, closing both gaps while staying compact.
signals.learning_signal: On fully-specified estimate signatures, the fundamentals calibration anchor plus a ruin screen convert the human baseline's two winning moves (independent-route verification, provenance-carrying uncertainty) from REVIEW-stage afterthoughts into HOW-stage mandatory outputs.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m001+m018 dual-route with m007 gate on high_stakes estimate signatures; make the derived-constant cross-check a standing contract item; consider quoting in per-kg terms so price volatility re-prices instantly.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline spent the 20-min window deriving the energy chain and blocked the reset on a borderline cold-winding insulation reading (pump off at T+27); the routed pass reframed derive-from-scratch as probe design (cheap-fix-as-decisive-experiment), regret-ranked the ordering, and the m003 inversion gate enumerated six window-killing failure categories pre-DO with a priced re-trip branch (T+19 still inside) and a defined follow-up contract for the 5% residual.
signals.learning_signal: On deadline diagnosis signatures, measured base rates are ordering authority (P10) and an inversion gate must price the failure branches (window overrun, over-certification) before DO; tempo mode commits at the probe plan, never the full diagnosis.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m011+m024 dual-route with m003 gate on deadline signatures; retain reset-as-decisive-experiment and the re-trip follow-up contract in the packet; never let a cold-winding borderline reading block a reset without a load observation.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-inversion baseline was near-gold (8 categories in one pass, ranked, P/D/R-tagged, residual named, NEVER reframed), but the dual-route pass matched it first-class and closed the v5 AI's two gaps by contract: category-complete enumeration now lands in WHAT/HOW in one pass (the v5 AI needed a second sweep to reach stocking/governance), and the NEVER reframe to a bounded SLA moves from REVIEW into WHAT. Residual gap: category distribution rests on industry base rates only (no site-specific incident data), and the upstream-stocking residual is monitor-only — prevention stops at the pharmacy boundary.
signals.learning_signal: Guarantee-goals with a never-mandate are inversion's home turf; dual-routing m003 with m031 (scientific method) converts the enumeration into a shipped test plan — every failure category names its own discriminating probe, so the strategy carries its monitoring suite as evidence and an update rule, which a pure one-shot enumeration lacks.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep dual-route m003+m031 on guarantee/diagnose signatures with the R4 full-strength inversion gate; add mandate-to-SLA conversion (interested-party provenance on goal phrasing) to the m003 pass checklist; make the trust-boundary residual statement (detect-only beyond our boundary) an explicit packet field; attach probe-per-category to the packet evidence.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: strict inversion produced the registry-predicted flatline (12 equal-weight workstreams, no wedge, no activation metric, no checkpoint). The routed run reached the v5 AI's winning structure by mechanism: evidence-weighted SWOT graded every adoption lever by telemetry strength and selected the wedge (analytics-heavy PM/ops, ~600 teams), and the R4-capped m003 gate (top-5 + falsifiable checkpoint) kept the baseline's best causes — incl. its only genuine catch, IT/security procurement friction (baseline item 9) — as bounded defense after the bet. Remaining gap: no new-feature activation data; the week-1 cohort gate and week-4 pivot rule are the only arbiters.
signals.learning_signal: On maximize goals the inversion move must be capped and run post-bet; routing evidence-weighted SWOT as the first-class pass produces selection from measured data that pure inversion structurally cannot, and R4's cap converts inversion's completeness pressure from a bug into a bounded risk pass with a falsifiable checkpoint.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep single-route m070 on maximize/decide signatures with the R4-capped m003 gate; add an IT/security procurement pre-clearance item to the bounded risk pass on SaaS/enterprise launches (the m003-NEG-02 baseline's only surviving insight); extend the checkpoint contract to require a priced pivot branch (share of budget sunk + assets preserved, not just a trigger).

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline produced every checkable number (2/13, 17/28, joint, reversed-path, population decomposition, 2%-prior sensitivity) in one lean trace (5.0); the v6 AI matched it point-for-point only through the routed m010+m030 dual pass (calibration band over 0.5%-5% priors → 43.5%-89%; constraint-driven joint computation as the no-data decisive experiment) + m031 synthesis with the m006 completion contract (order-invariance recomputation, decomposition to the 11/28 residual, decision-threshold flip prior 1/154 ≈ 0.65%, B- negative branch ≈ 2.9%) — closing the non-routed v5 run's 1.0-point gap (4.0 → 4.9). Residual baseline edge: efficiency (pure linear trace 5 vs 4.5; the routed contract stack costs lines).
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose/predict signatures with fully-specified probabilistic inputs, the calibration + constraint-creativity pairing turns 'correct numbers' into 'calibrated numbers': report every posterior with its band over plausible priors, demonstrate order-invariance and the joint/LR-product cross-checks as mandatory moves (never assert independence), and price the negative branch — a B- after A+ returns the posterior to ≈ 2.9%, the mirror of 'two positives ≠ near-certain' (39.3% residual). The decision-threshold flip (prior ≥ 1/154 for a ≥ 50% posterior) is the packet entry the non-routed run lacked.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m010+m030 dual-route with the m006 contract for fully-specified probabilistic cases; enforce that the P8 closed-scope fast path may compress stage narration but never the contract deliverables (reversed-path recomputation, population decomposition, formal prior band, flip prior, negative-branch pricing); every posterior in the packet must carry its range — a point estimate without its band is an overconfident packet.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the baseline audited the likelihood as an unknown parameter in one disciplined pass (3 scenarios → [5%, 100%], VOI argument, no-treatment decision; 5.0); the v6 AI reached the same verdict only through the m006 provenance gate completing BEFORE any update + the m019/m023 dual pass (adversary vectors with quantified exposure: SAE 4.0% of treated under the claim vs 7.6% under truth on a 95%-healthy class; opportunity-cost dominance of confirm-first) + the m003 inversion gate (8 ranked failure categories; un-mitigable residual: true accuracy unknowable without the study) — the exact structure the non-routed v5 run lacked (it refused a point estimate, then stopped with generic NEEDS_EVIDENCE; scored 4.0). Residual baseline edge: efficiency (5 vs 4.5).
signals.learning_signal: On adversarial/unmeasured signatures, the likelihood-provenance audit is the gate that precedes any update: parameterize the unvalidated accuracy (noise 50/50 → 5%, claimed 95/95 → 50%, 99/99 → 84%, perfect → 100%), report the posterior range, and demonstrate the decision-threshold flip algebraically — treat iff LR ≥ 38/3 ≈ 12.7, so five points of claimed accuracy (LR 19 vs 9 → 50% vs 32%) decide whether a patient is treated; decompose the positive mass (only 5% of T+ are diseased under truth) so the SAE risk is attributed to the healthy; terminate SOLVED-with-anchored-decision (no empirical treatment; gold-standard first), never NEEDS_EVIDENCE, when the evidence set is complete for the decision.
signals.suggested_improvement: Standing rule for unmeasured-likelihood cases: (1) the m006 provenance audit completes before any posterior is reported, with >=3 accuracy scenarios + range + flip threshold in the packet; (2) the R3 m019 adversary pass enumerates exposure per vector with a baseline-risk comparison (act-on-prevalence vs treat-on-assumption) always priced; (3) the correct terminal is SOLVED with the anchored decision and the named decisive probe (gold-standard test as the cheap discriminating experiment), reserving NEEDS_EVIDENCE for decisions that genuinely wait on missing data.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline solved the fully specified problem exactly in one pass (EV B 0.9 vs C 0.8 vs A 0; posteriors 8/11, 1/7; EV(launch|Low) = 0 exactly; breakeven test price $0) — nothing to correct in the arithmetic; the v5 AI already tied with an efficiency gap. The v6 routed run (m023/m050 dual-route + m070 SWOT + m003 inversion gate, closed-scope fast path) kept the same one-pass arithmetic and added what the pure style cannot produce: flip thresholds with error magnitudes (p* = 1/7, a 64% downward error on the prior; a* = 0.80 breakeven test accuracy — the test pays only above 80%), the parameter-cancellation structure (the zero-information-value result holds exactly at the stated (a = 0.80, p = 0.40) pair: P(High|Low signal) = 1/7 makes EV(launch|Low) = 0 exactly, so the signal policy replicates always-launch), and the opportunity-cost reframing (the test adds zero EV, so its opportunity cost is its full price — buying it is a pure transfer).
signals.learning_signal: On fully specified risk-neutral EV problems the pure style's arithmetic is exact and unbeatable on numbers; the v6 win comes from (a) the closed-scope fast path closing the efficiency gap, and (b) the routed opportunity-cost/inversion/SWOT passes converting the sensitivity section into provable robustness — flip thresholds with exposure magnitudes, the parameter pair where the non-obvious result holds, and identification of which input actually carries the decision (the prior, not the test). The zero-info result is a coincidence of the stated parameters, and stating why it holds is the non-obvious increment.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the closed-scope fast path for fully specified EV signatures (P8); make 'decision collapses to which statistics' a standing move (EV(B) = 3.5p − 0.5 depends only on the prior; test value depends only on accuracy); require a flip-threshold line (parameter, error magnitude, breakeven) plus a 'where does the non-obvious result hold' statement in the packet whenever an opportunity-cost/adversary/inversion pass runs on a numeric decision.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the pure-style baseline executed the documented trap — internally correct EV (0.90 x 200 = $180M > $100M, 'take the bet', 'wide margin of safety' on p) that stops at the mean: no $100M floor screen (every s > 0 has a 10% breach probability; only s = 0 admissible), no ruin/log-utility check (−∞), no one-shot/LLN check, no provenance (p = 0.90 is the counterparty's self-serving claim). The v5 AI already declined (win) by thoroughness; the v6 routed run (top-1 m024 regret + m011/m018 context + mandatory m007 ruin gate + m003 inversion gate) makes the catch structural: constrained minimax-regret independently selects keep (expected regret mirrors the EV trap — 10M vs 90M favors the bet — but the constrained catastrophic branch is unbounded), the steelman survives only in its escrow version (restructuring), and acceptability requires p = 1.0 (a guarantee), not p > 0.5.
signals.learning_signal: For one-shot all-in offers above a hard floor with an absorbing state, the decision is not about probabilities at all: acceptability requires a guarantee (p = 1.0), not EV-positivity (p > 0.5) — the mean, the mode, and the floor tell three different stories. The 'stop at the average' failure is frame-invariant (it reappears in expected-regret) and the constraint resolves it identically in every frame; the steelman's strongest rescue is escrow, and the counterparty's refusal to post it is evidence. Divergence agreement across regret/ruin/systems passes is what makes the verdict robust rather than lucky.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m007 ruin screen as the standing R3 gate for high_stakes/one_shot signatures and extend it to any hard-floor or absorbing-state decision even without one_shot; require a provenance line for every probability that dominates an EV table (interested-party claim vs measurement; acceptability threshold vs EV breakeven — they are different numbers); add the over-Kelly computation (fraction demanded vs Kelly) and a constrained-minimax-regret line to the standing packet for all-in stake offers.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline named the mechanism (user equilibrium vs system optimum, fix-backfires structure) at first sight and aimed the lever at the flow's price (25-min-equivalent toll), while the non-routed v5 AI reached the same verdict only through its verification machinery and lost on structure-at-first-sight/insight (36 vs 37.5). The v6 routed run closed the gap with the m011 contract (falsifiable observable = all 4,000 on the shortcut at 85 min; local-data-first = model reproduces the observed 65-min state; cheap-fix-as-decisive-experiment = microsimulation/priced pilot) and added the quantified everyone-gains adaptation transient (~54 min at c≈1,000 before settling at 85) — sharper than the baseline's 'oscillate during learning' note. Residual shared gap: stochastic demand changes magnitudes not direction; overshoot depth unquantified without simulation.
signals.learning_signal: On network-equilibrium decide/predict signatures with a proposed link, equilibrium arithmetic is necessary but not sufficient: after computing both equilibria the m011 contract must also output the falsifiable observable (unique all-on-shortcut state at 85 min), the local-data-first check (model reproduces the observed steady state before predicting), the cheap decisive experiment (simulation or priced pilot before the 0M), and the transient behavior mode — the adaptation phase shows an everyone-gains dip below 65 min first, so post-change monitoring initially CONFIRMS the linear narrative before the worse equilibrium lands.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep m011+m044 dual-route on adversarial network-change signatures (router confident=no, already configured): pair m011 with the m019 R3 adversary gate to price the camouflage window (V2) and the interested-party capacity claim; add 'transient behavior mode before equilibrium' as a standing m011 contract line on any change-to-a-network task; retain m020 pre-mortem RANKED (never the unranked NEG trap) to price the build-and-toll failure branch.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline substituted a causal-loop diagram for measurement — dismissed the 50 printer as a symptom, re-read r≈0.97 and the maintenance flag as downstream noise, and prescribed an 8–12-week structural redesign; the non-routed v5 AI won (37 vs 20) on its evidence gate. The v6 routed run makes that win structural: m011 is held OUT of top-3 (KB trap pairing on this signature) and m031/m004/m014 run first-class with the mandatory m003 inversion gate — the failure-mode check is guaranteed by routing, not emergent. Residual gap: causal confirmation still requires the 1-week re-measurement; no faster read exists.
signals.learning_signal: On diagnose/guarantee + deadline signatures with station-level data, the router must keep the over-modeling style out of top-3 and pair the empiric styles (m031 hypothesis → cheap decisive experiment, m004 simplest-consistent-explanation, m014 constraint-first) with the m003 inversion gate: enumerate >=6 failure categories RANKED by likelihood x impact (including the management-narrative/redesign-budget branch priced before DO), name the un-mitigable residual (printer may not be the whole story → escalation rule), and state the never/always reframing (never treat the local fix as terminal evidence; always re-measure one week after).
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m031/m004/m014 + m003 pairing for equipment-failure diagnoses under deadline (router confident=yes — single route suffices, already configured); extend the m003 contract to require pricing the interested-party branch (redesign budget) as a numbered failure category; generalize 'fix-as-decisive-experiment + 1-week gate' as the standing m031 pattern for correlational evidence with a cheap intervention.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: both found all 4 planted flaws and the farm arithmetic; the closed gap is the v5 AI's — it deferred the sequential-code enumeration vector (F2) to a follow-up check and conditionally approved. The routed m019 contract (guessable-format enumeration with identity gates, per-vector quantified exposure, baseline-risk comparison, LxI-ranked objections) made F2 a mandatory pass output, and the m003/m007 gates added >=6 LxI-ranked failure categories, an outcome distribution, and a threshold-flip stability argument, flipping the verdict to block-as-written with a redesign. Human craft moves (press story, honest-referrer crowding) are matched by the routed run's insights (referrer-pays-the-adversary; metric-as-product).
signals.learning_signal: On adversarial plan reviews the difference between flagging and finding an exploit vector is the contract: guessable formats and identity gates must be enumerated as vectors with a cost-to-exploit per vector (sequential code: $0 per extra code) and quantified exposure, not deferred to follow-up — the completion contract converts the strongest human move into a structural requirement.
signals.suggested_improvement: Keep the m019 exploit-vector contract as written; add a cost-to-exploit line per vector to the contract (exploit cost, not only dollar exposure) and a mandatory threshold-flip sentence in the packet for the key unmeasured parameter; verify by re-reading the plan for formats and gates line by line.

signals.key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline is the style's trap executed — every hypothetical at full severity, inaction treated as risk-free while an EOL mainframe with two unpatched critical CVEs (RCE, privilege escalation) continues. The routed run prices inaction first (do-nothing-loss line), rejects >=3 manufactured/already-mitigated objections with their rejecting evidence (rollback test, SLA, multi-AZ fallback, canary-as-productionization), runs m006's 3-scenario range (5/25/55%) with a threshold flip at ~15% that kills the delay branch, m007's ruin screen (the ruin tail lives in the delay branch), and tempo mode's cost-of-delay line (~$1.25M/month carry), reaching a reversible staged go-live with named abort criteria. The v5 AI reached the same verdict; v6 makes the delay-cost sentence, scenario range, and abort criteria structural rather than emergent.
signals.learning_signal: Red teaming without calibration is hazard theater: could-happen is not a blocker where the baseline is already failing; the completion contract's baseline-first rule, reject-objections-log, and threshold-flip demonstration are what convert attack into decision — the decision compares baseline risk vs mitigation risk, never absolute safety.
signals.suggested_improvement: Dual-route m019+m018 on go/no-go signatures (attack vs steelman, divergence resolved by branch completeness + calibration); keep m003 never/always reframing (delay is a decision), the m006 threshold-flip, and m007 floor/abort-criteria as standing R3 gates on high_stakes reversible decisions; require a cost-of-delay sentence in every deadline-mode packet.
